content.title: W7: Pair the remaining shell and Settings neutral badges with a symbol

nodes.body:
**Revision:** 1 **Supersedes:** none **Replan report:** none **Payload digest:** `sha256:31155003796cca6b44c62de356858c537c552d36907be56d2bdac83f6dea0933` ## Implementation plan **Issue:** https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/issues/1044 **Planned against:** `main` at `b2d7a2b489444d9e477477d07418c81f7d864086` **Publication mode:** Autonomous **Local state:** Clean **Epoch closure:** null ### Approach Reuse W1's mechanism: `StatusBadge` (`web/src/components.tsx`) already pairs a lucide symbol with the word for the warning, error and success tones. Add an `idle` tone (the existing slate `secondary` variant) that renders a symbol too, plus an optional `icon` prop that overrides the tone's default symbol. Then move every neutral **state** badge in the shell and the Settings, Recovery and setup screens from `neutral` to `idle` with a fitting symbol. The `neutral` tone stays symbol-less and is kept for count and label badges, as the issue requires. The sidebar's Paused project badge changes from `warning` to `idle` with a pause symbol. Browser assertions guard that no state badge in these screens lacks a symbol. `design/DESIGN.md` Implementation status is updated in the same change. ### Guardrails - Presentation only: no SPEC.md behaviour, API, contract or safety rule changes; badge words, `getByText` selectors and existing tests stay. Update a selector only where markup truly changes, and never delete a test. - Colours stay as they are, except the Paused project badges (sidebar, Settings index, project configuration, Recovery task row), which become idle (DESIGN.md Tokens: "Waiting, paused, queued…"). The canvas also draws Enabled/Available/Configured in emerald and Revoked in rose (artboards 114, 118, 123, 134). This slice deliberately pairs symbols only, as issue #1044 scopes, so those tone changes are out of scope (see Planning decisions). - Count and label badges stay symbol-less `neutral`: `page-header-count` ("N unresolved"), "Matches ", "New repository link", and every neutral badge on screens owned by other slices or outside this scope (Inbox request kind in `inbox.tsx`, `inspection-changes.tsx`, `task-files.tsx`, `local-review.tsx`, `retained-evidence.tsx`, `question-response.tsx`, `task-composer.tsx`, `task-views.tsx`). - Do not touch the files owned by in-flight #1040, #1041 and #1042 (see Task graph). Do not add an Ensemble badge component, a state-to-symbol registry or new dependencies; `lucide-react` 1.55.0 already exports every symbol named below. - Continue routine implementation, integration, test, fixture, CSS, documentation and CI repairs within unchanged requirements, coverage, architecture and authority; record the correction and renew affected evidence. These ordinary repairs do not consume the plan-mismatch budget. Only a wrong approved-plan seam or repository assumption (for example `StatusBadge` not being the shared badge for these screens, or a listed file not rendering the named badge) is a factual plan mismatch: it allows one focused diagnosis and at most two repair cycles. Investigate unknown overlap; stop for material design or contract changes or exhausted grants. - Reuse the existing delivery record and valid checks and reviews. Use an integration amendment only for a changed published integration decision requiring durable consumption. ### Planning decisions - **Badge classification.** A state badge reports the state of a thing (paused, enabled, configured, active, available, synced, held, revoked, "not enabled"). A count, label or identity badge does not. Evidence: the issue names "2 unresolved" and "Matches " as non-states; `StatusBadge` call sites inventoried at base are listed under the slices. - **Mechanism.** `idle` is a new `StatusBadge` tone mapped to `variant: "secondary"` with default symbol `Circle`; `icon?: LucideIcon` overrides the symbol for any tone. `neutral` is unchanged. This keeps W1's single `badgeTones` table, avoids a per-site `Badge` rewrite and lets the browser guard select on the existing `data-slot="badge"` plus an `svg`. - **Symbol table (idle tone, one decision for all sites).** Paused and Project paused: `CirclePause`. Enabled, Available, Active, Synced hh:mm, Configured: `CircleCheck`. Disabled, Not enabled: `CircleSlash`. Partial: `CircleDashed`. Unavailable and Couldn't check (an unknown read): `CircleQuestionMark`. Everything else idle (Not configured, Unconfigured, Inactive, Not synced, Not active, Not recorded, None reported, Review execution evidence, No unresolved hold reported, New · inactive, Not started, Optional): the default `Circle`. These follow the canvas where it draws a symbol (pause II, hollow circle for Not started, Not checked, Unconfigured, question mark for Not known, half circle for Partial). - **Revoked.** Settings index shows "Revoked" as `neutral` while the profile page shows it as `warning` (already symbol-paired). Align the index to `warning` so both show the same badge. The canvas draws a rose cross; recolouring it is not part of this slice (flagged for the controller as a deviation, not a blocker). - **Sidebar fit.** Adding a 12px symbol widens the trailing Paused badge in the 232px sidebar and the phone drawer. `.nav-link` already uses `min-width: 0` and the project label wraps; check with the screenshots. Only if a long project name pushes the badge out of the row, add the smallest rule in the `.nav-link` / `.nav-count` block of `web/src/styles.css` (about lines 344-385). - **Assumption check, settled by evidence.** `StatusBadge` is the only badge used for these state words in the in-scope files (grep at base: `settings-index`, `project-config`, `profile-config`, `source-config`, `sync-placement`, `recovery`, `readiness`, `add-claude`, `app.tsx`), plus `Badge` directly in `getting-started.tsx`. `operator-settings-presentation.test.ts` asserts hold-pill labels and values only, not tone, so changing `HoldTone` is safe. No proof task is needed. - **Evidence, not CSS selectors.** Assert one `svg[aria-hidden="true"]` inside each state badge and the idle colour through the badge's class (`text-(--idle)` in `web/src/ui/badge.tsx`). Do not assert lucide class names. ### Implementation context - **Existing:** `web/src/components.tsx` — `badgeTones` and `StatusBadge({ children, tone, className })` render `` with a `CircleAlert`, `CircleX` or `CircleCheck` for warning, error and success; `neutral` renders none. Also used by `PageHeader` (count badge) and `TopBar` (connection badge, already symbol-paired). - **Existing:** `web/src/app.tsx` — the project rows in the navigation (`link(... trailing: p.paused ? Paused : …active)`, about line 221) serve both the 232px sidebar and the phone drawer. - **Existing:** `web/src/settings-index.tsx` (project row about line 164, selection observation about line 202, profile row about line 280, routing row about line 318), `web/src/project-config.tsx` (status line about line 100; credential `row()` badge about line 386, "Configured" or "Unconfigured"), `web/src/profile-config.tsx` (about line 350), `web/src/source-config.tsx` (selection "Will be removed", "Active" or "Inactive" about line 239; "New · inactive" about line 261), `web/src/sync-placement.tsx` (observation and Active or Inactive badges about lines 249-253), `web/src/recovery.tsx` (runtime harness badge about line 361, task row about line 404, assignment status about line 483, hold pills about line 522), `web/src/settings-view.ts` (`HoldTone`, `holdPills`), `web/src/readiness.tsx` and `web/src/add-claude.tsx` (`status` tables, `Not configured`), `web/src/getting-started.tsx` (`badges` table, `Not started`, `Optional`, `Checking`, `Couldn't check`). - **Follow:** `web/src/components.tsx` `badgeTones` for the tone table; `getting-started.tsx` for `CircleCheck`/`CircleAlert` placed beside a `Badge`. - **Test seams:** `test/fixtures/operator-settings.ts` — `seedSettingsWorld` (Atlas, Relay paused, Fieldnotes empty, seven profiles with Reviewer revoked), `startSettings(journey, path, viewport)`, `desktop`, `phone`. `test/operator/operator-settings-layout-browser.test.ts` already screenshots `1366-settings` and `390-settings` via `captureBrowserEvidence`. - **New:** `test/fixtures/operator-settings.ts` — `unpairedBadges(scope: Page | Locator, allowed = /^(Matches |New repository link$|\d+ unresolved$)/): Promise` returns the text of each `[data-slot="badge"]` under `scope` that has no `svg[aria-hidden="true"]` and does not match `allowed`. Tests assert it equals `[]`. ### Implementation slices **Task graph and parallelism:** T1 -> {T2, T3} -> T4; acyclic. T2 and T3 own disjoint source and test files and can run concurrently once T1 lands; both import only the T1 `StatusBadge` and fixture helper. The one shared source file is `web/src/settings-view.ts`, with disjoint hunks (T2 adds `observationSymbol` after `observationLabel`; T3 changes `HoldTone`/`holdPills`); concurrent owners must merge those hunks, otherwise run T2 then T3. T4 edits `design/DESIGN.md` and evidence, so it runs after both. In-flight overlap: none of these files appear in #1040 (Inbox files, `overview-attention.tsx`, the `app.tsx` Inbox `PageHeader` hunk near line 968, the `styles.css` inbox block, the DESIGN.md "Not yet adopted" bullet and Inbox rows, and the ui08 Inbox and shell rows), #1041 (task detail files, `task-views.tsx` `stateIcons`) or #1042 (`tasks.ts`, `task-views.tsx`, `work.css`, work, task-detail and responsive browser tests, the DESIGN.md Board bullet). Shared files are limited to three hunks that do not overlap: `web/src/app.tsx` lines about 219-224 (the project row `trailing` badge, in the navigation component; #1040's hunk is the `PageHeader` call near line 968); `web/src/styles.css` only if the sidebar fit rule is needed, in the `.nav-link` / `.nav-count` block (not the inbox block); and `design/DESIGN.md` in the "Visual direction" **Implemented** bullet (the sentence "non-neutral badges add a symbol", about line 1561) and the "Settings, profiles, routing, runtime and recovery" section (about line 1792 onward), neither adjacent to #1040's "Not yet adopted" bullet or Inbox rows. Do not edit `test/operator/operator-shell-browser.test.ts` (candidate ui08 shell row for #1040); the sidebar assertions go in the Settings layout test instead. #### 1. Idle tone with a symbol, and the sidebar Paused badge **Task ID:** `T1` **Depends on:** `none` **Prerequisites:** none **Files and symbols:** `web/src/components.tsx` (`badgeTones`, `StatusBadge`); `web/src/app.tsx` (project row `trailing`, about line 221); `test/fixtures/operator-settings.ts` (new `unpairedBadges`); `test/operator/operator-settings-layout-browser.test.ts`; `web/src/styles.css` only if the fit check fails. **Test:** In `operator-settings-layout-browser.test.ts`, extend the index test ("Settings index lists projects…", 1366) and the phone test ("Settings index is one column…", 390), both already built on `startSettings` and seeded with paused Relay. Desktop: `const sidebar = page.getByRole("navigation", { name: "Operator navigation" })` (the `
` in `app.tsx` line 169); assert the Paused badge in Relay's row has exactly one `svg[aria-hidden="true"]`, its class contains `text-(--idle)` and not `text-(--attn)`, and `await noPageOverflow(page)`. Capture `captureBrowserEvidence(page, "1366-sidebar-paused-project")`. Phone: open the drawer with the "Projects and navigation" button, assert the same badge and class inside the drawer, assert no horizontal overflow, and capture `390-drawer-paused-project`. Sensitivity: with the old `tone="warning"` the class and symbol assertions fail. **Implementation:** In `badgeTones` add `idle: { variant: "secondary", Icon: Circle }`. Add `icon?: LucideIcon` to `StatusBadge` props and render `const Symbol = icon ?? Icon` (exported type from `lucide-react`). Keep `neutral` as is. Add `unpairedBadges` to the fixture. In `app.tsx` change the sidebar badge to `Paused` (import `CirclePause`). Apply the Sidebar fit rule only if the screenshot shows the badge overflowing or clipping the label. **Validate:** From the checkout root with Node 24.21.0 first on `PATH`, after `npm ci`, run `npm run typecheck && npm run build && node --test dist/test/operator/operator-settings-layout-browser.test.js`; expect type checking to pass and all tests in the file (the original four, with the extended assertions) to pass. **Complete when:** the sidebar and drawer Paused badge is idle with a symbol, `unpairedBadges` exists, and the screenshots `1366-sidebar-paused-project` and `390-drawer-paused-project` look correct. #### 2. Settings index, project configuration, profiles, routing and sync **Task ID:** `T2` **Depends on:** `T1` **Prerequisites:** T1 merged in the working branch (`idle`, `icon`, `unpairedBadges`). **Files and symbols:** `web/src/settings-index.tsx`, `web/src/project-config.tsx`, `web/src/profile-config.tsx`, `web/src/source-config.tsx`, `web/src/sync-placement.tsx`, `web/src/settings-view.ts` (new `observationSymbol` beside `observationLabel`, about lines 183-192); tests `test/operator/operator-settings-layout-browser.test.ts`, `operator-project-config-browser.test.ts`, `operator-profile-config-browser.test.ts`, `operator-settings-browser.test.ts`. **Test:** (a) Settings index, 1366 and 390 (layout test, extend the same two tests as T1): `assert.deepEqual(await unpairedBadges(main), [])`, so every project, selection-observation, profile and routing badge has a symbol; assert Relay's project badge reads "Paused" with `text-(--idle)`; Reviewer's profile badge reads "Revoked" with `text-(--attn)`; the Atlas routing "Disabled" badge has a symbol. (b) Project configuration, general tab (`operator-project-config-browser`, at the existing wait for `.settings-status` "Paused" about line 183, and on the unpaused read): `unpairedBadges(page.locator("main"))` equals `[]`; paused reads idle. The credential references show Configured/Unconfigured with symbols. (c) Profile page (`operator-profile-config-browser`, at the existing "Revoked" and "Available" waits): `unpairedBadges` is `[]`. (d) GitHub source and Sync and placement tabs (`operator-settings-browser`, where existing tests already load Source and Sync tabs, for example `openSync`): `unpairedBadges` equals `[]` with the default allowlist; the "New repository link" label badge remains allowed. **Implementation:** Per the symbol table: settings-index project `paused ? idle+CirclePause "Paused" : idle+CircleCheck "Enabled"`; selection observation badge idle with `CircleCheck` for Synced, `CircleDashed` for Partial, `CircleQuestionMark` for Unavailable, default `Circle` for Not synced (pick the symbol from the same `observationLabel` result, in `sync-placement.tsx` and `settings-index.tsx`; export one small `observationSymbol(o)` from `settings-view.ts` next to `observationLabel` and use it in both files; not a shared registry); profile `revoked ? warning "Revoked" : idle+CircleCheck "Available"`; routing `enabled ? idle+CircleCheck "Enabled" : idle+CircleSlash "Disabled"`. `project-config.tsx` status line uses the same Paused/Enabled mapping as the index; credential `row()` badge is idle with `CircleCheck` (Configured) or `Circle` (Unconfigured). `profile-config.tsx` uses the same Revoked/Available mapping as the index. `source-config.tsx`: Active idle `CircleCheck` or Inactive idle `Circle`; "Will be removed" stays `warning`; "New · inactive" idle `Circle`; "New repository link" stays `neutral`. `sync-placement.tsx` Active and Inactive badges likewise. Words are unchanged. **Validate:** From the checkout root, after T1's setup, run `npm run typecheck && npm run build && node --test dist/test/operator/operator-settings-layout-browser.test.js dist/test/operator/operator-project-config-browser.test.js dist/test/operator/operator-profile-config-browser.test.js dist/test/operator/operator-settings-browser.test.js`; expect all pass. Screenshots `1366-settings` and `390-settings` (already captured) show a symbol on every state badge. **Complete when:** no Settings index, project configuration, profile, source or sync state badge is without a symbol and the four test files pass. #### 3. Runtime, recovery, readiness and setup badges **Task ID:** `T3` **Depends on:** `T1` **Prerequisites:** T1 merged in the working branch. **Files and symbols:** `web/src/recovery.tsx` (runtime harness badge, task row, assignment status, hold pills), `web/src/settings-view.ts` (`HoldTone` = `"warning" | "idle"`, `holdPills` tone), `web/src/readiness.tsx` and `web/src/add-claude.tsx` (`status["not-configured"].tone = "idle"`), `web/src/getting-started.tsx` (`badges` table: give `Not started`, `Optional`, `Checking` and `Couldn't check` a symbol beside the `Badge`, keeping `Done`, `Needs attention` and `Next` as they are; `project-setup.tsx` has no state badge, so it needs no edit); tests `test/operator/operator-harness-status-browser.test.ts`, `test/execution/operator-runtime-recovery-browser.test.ts`, `test/operator/operator-readiness-browser.test.ts`, `test/operator/operator-add-claude-browser.test.ts`, `test/operator/operator-setup-browser.test.ts`. **Test:** Runtime page (`operator-harness-status-browser`, where the existing tests wait on the runtime rows, "Available" and "Disabled in Settings" at about lines 58 and 231): `unpairedBadges(runtimesPanel(page))` equals `[]`, including a "Not enabled" badge. Assignment recovery and Recovery destinations (`operator-runtime-recovery-browser`): `unpairedBadges(page.locator("main"))` equals `[]` for the hold pills (Not active, None reported, and so on) and the status badge. Readiness and Add Claude (`operator-readiness-browser`, `operator-add-claude-browser` at the existing "Not configured" waits about lines 104 and 191): the "Not configured" badge now has a symbol; `unpairedBadges` equals `[]` for the check rows. Getting started (`operator-setup-browser`, on its home or page view): a not-started row's badge has a symbol; `unpairedBadges` equals `[]` for the checklist. **Implementation:** `recovery.tsx`: harness `state` `available` stays `success`, `unavailable` stays `error`, and the remaining "Not enabled" state becomes `idle` with `CircleSlash`; task row badge `held` stays `warning`, "Project paused" is idle `CirclePause`, "Review execution evidence" is idle `Circle`; assignment status "No unresolved hold reported" is idle `Circle`; hold pills use `tone: "idle"` (absence is shown, never described as a release). `readiness.tsx` and `add-claude.tsx` switch `neutral` to `idle` for "Not configured". `getting-started.tsx`: render a symbol inside the badge for `not-started` and `optional` (`Circle`), `checking` (`Clock`, if not already imported) and `unknown` (`CircleQuestionMark`) alongside the existing `CircleCheck` and `CircleAlert` conditionals; do not change variants or words. **Validate:** From the checkout root, after T1's setup, run `npm run typecheck && npm run build && node --test dist/test/operator/operator-harness-status-browser.test.js dist/test/execution/operator-runtime-recovery-browser.test.js dist/test/operator/operator-readiness-browser.test.js dist/test/operator/operator-add-claude-browser.test.js dist/test/operator/operator-setup-browser.test.js dist/test/operator/operator-settings-presentation.test.js dist/test/operator/operator-getting-started-model.test.js`; expect all pass. **Complete when:** no Runtime, Recovery, readiness, Add Claude or getting-started state badge is without a symbol and the listed files pass. #### 4. Documentation and evidence **Task ID:** `T4` **Depends on:** `T2, T3` **Prerequisites:** T2 and T3 complete. **Files and symbols:** `design/DESIGN.md` (Implementation status: the "Visual direction" **Implemented** bullet; the "Settings, profiles, routing, runtime and recovery" section); new `docs/evidence/ui-workbench-badges.md` with its PNGs under `docs/evidence/ui-workbench-badges/` (a dated record is permitted under `docs/evidence/`). **Implementation:** In the Visual direction **Implemented** bullet, replace "non-neutral badges add a symbol" with a statement that every state badge pairs a symbol and a word (idle states use `Circle`, `CirclePause`, `CircleCheck`, `CircleSlash`, `CircleDashed` or `CircleQuestionMark`), and that count and label badges carry none. In the Settings section add one bullet: Paused project badges are idle with a pause symbol in the sidebar, drawer and Settings; Enabled, Available and Configured stay slate with a check and Revoked stays amber rather than the canvas's emerald and rose; project setup has no state badge. Add the evidence record (base SHA, Node, viewports, the checks run, a table of the four screenshots: `1366-sidebar-paused-project`, `390-drawer-paused-project`, `1366-settings`, `390-settings`). Copy the PNGs from the test evidence directory (`ENSEMBLE_TEST_EVIDENCE_DIR`) after the final run. **Validate:** From the checkout root, run `npm run format:check && npm run lint`; expect pass. Open the four PNGs and confirm a symbol on every state badge and no overflow. **Complete when:** DESIGN.md Implementation status matches the implemented behaviour and the evidence record lists the four screenshots. ### Acceptance coverage | Acceptance criterion | Slice | Verification | | --- | ---: | --- | | Sidebar and phone drawer Paused project badge uses the idle tone with a symbol | 1 | T1 test: sidebar and drawer badge class and `svg` assertions | | Settings index state badges (project, observation, profile, routing) pair a symbol with the word | 2 | T2 test (a): `unpairedBadges(main)` is `[]` at 1366 and 390 | | Project configuration, profiles, sync and placement, and GitHub source state badges pair a symbol | 2 | T2 tests (b), (c), (d) | | Runtime, recovery, readiness and Add Claude state badges pair a symbol | 3 | T3 tests | | Project setup and getting-started state badges pair a symbol (project setup has none) | 3 | T3 getting-started assertion; no `StatusBadge` in `project-setup.tsx` at base | | Count and label badges ("2 unresolved", "Matches ") stay as they are | 1, 2 | `unpairedBadges` default allowlist; the existing inbox count assertions in `operator-shell-browser` and folder-picker tests still pass | | SPEC.md behaviour and existing tests are kept; changed selectors updated, none deleted | 1-3 | Full existing files in the Validate lines still pass; `npm run check` | | Screenshots of the sidebar with a paused project and the Settings index at 1366 and 390 | 1, 4 | `1366-sidebar-paused-project`, `390-drawer-paused-project`, `1366-settings`, `390-settings` in the evidence record | | `design/DESIGN.md` Implementation status updated in the same change | 4 | Reviewed diff of the two DESIGN.md sections | ### Final validation - From the checkout root with Node 24.21.0 first on `PATH`, after `npm ci`, run `npm run check` at the integrated delivery candidate (type checking, lint, format, build, all tests); expect pass.
