nodes.body:
<!-- to-plan:implementation-plan:v2 -->

**Revision:** 1
**Supersedes:** none
**Replan report:** none

## Implementation plan

**Issue:** https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/issues/1039
**Planned against:** `main` at `c10d9dbc55529935dfed1be09bd7dd6ebce8094a`
**Publication mode:** Autonomous
**Local state:** Clean
**Epoch closure:** null

### Approach

Replace Overview's request rows with a stat strip and "Needs you" cards, and re-frame the work list as a panel beside Projects and Completed work panels. Everything is `web/` presentation over reads the shell already holds (task list, workspace, whole-Inbox read). The only new reads are per-card and use existing endpoints: the question read and the task read the Inbox already uses. A single-choice question is answered in its card by mounting the Inbox's own `InboxQuestion` → `QuestionResponse`, so the command, validation, stale/conflict/unknown handling and shared draft state are the Inbox's, not a copy. Approvals and interventions only link (to `item.destination`), as in the Inbox. No `src/` change.

Order: T1 pure model and tests → T2 stat strip and cards with link responses → T3 in-card answering → T4 work panel, Projects and Completed work → T5 docs, responsive-matrix coverage and evidence.

### Guardrails

- SPEC.md owns behaviour; this slice changes presentation only (epic #1035 Boundaries). No change to `src/`, commands, contracts, endpoints, Inbox ordering/filters, approval authority (the Overview never approves or denies; an approval card only links to `item.destination`), Stop/Resume or hold semantics. Keep Haze untouched.
- Out of scope: Board layout (W5 #1042), three-pane Inbox (W3 #1040), task detail (W4 #1041), composer (W6 #1043), neutral badges (W7 #1044), List route restyling, new polling on Overview, short identifiers (Q-204, AP-17), a task "Updated" time, GitHub sync time, result excerpts. None exist in a read model; do not invent or derive them.
- Keep every existing test. Update selectors that change (listed per slice) rather than deleting; add browser tests for each new behaviour. Non-browser cases stay independently runnable (Node 26 service CI has no browser).
- Plan-mismatch vs ordinary repair. A factual plan mismatch (one diagnosis, at most two repair cycles) is only a wrong seam or repository assumption in this plan, namely: (a) `InboxQuestion`/`QuestionResponse` cannot be mounted in an Overview card without changing the Inbox's command path or its shared `QuestionResponseStates` behaviour; (b) the shell's task-list, workspace or whole-Inbox reads lack a fact the card, stat strip or Projects panel is specified to show; (c) `TaskViews` cannot receive `client`, `session` and the question states from `app.tsx` as planned. Ordinary in-scope work stays with the ticket owner and consumes no budget: selector and fixture updates, CSS and responsive tuning, test setup, lint/format/typecheck, documentation, CI flake and baseline-equivalent path or command corrections. Record such corrections briefly in the delivery record; stop for a material design/contract change, changed authority, or unknown overlap.
- Reuse the existing delivery record and valid checks/reviews. Use an integration amendment only for a changed published integration decision requiring durable consumption.

### Planning decisions

- **Phone has no Overview artboard.** The issue's "phone Overview artboards" do not exist: `project/canvas.json` lists boards `01-attention-overview`, `800a-tablet-overview-list` and `47-phone-task-overview` (a task page), and DESIGN.md Implementation status already states "no phone Overview or phone List frame; both phone layouts are composed from the shell and desktop frames". Compose phone from `01-attention-overview` reflowed by the DESIGN.md Layout rules (one column, 44px controls, stat strip as a 2×2 grid) and compare against `09-phone-inbox-queue`, `ds-domain-components` (phone headers) and `800a-tablet-overview-list`. Not a blocker; T5 records it.
- **Read-model gaps are resolved by the epic boundary, not by new data.** `taskListSummarySchema` has no timestamp and `domain_tasks` has no updated column; no endpoint lists results or per-project sync. So: omit the Updated column; the canvas "Recent results" becomes a "Completed work" panel (count, link, up to three completed task links, no recency or excerpt claim; region name unchanged); the Projects panel shows lead, activity counts and "N from GitHub" or "No imported tasks" with no sync time; an intervention card's evidence is the recorded list facts (lead, execution state, reasons) rather than the canvas's "last observation". T5 documents each in DESIGN.md Implementation status. A real column, strip or sync time needs a separate read-model ticket.
- **Ordering.** The Inbox read is already urgency then oldest (`src/standalone/operator-api.ts` sort: interventions first, then questions and approvals by `createdAt`). The Overview applies a stable partition so interventions whose task `isUncertain` precede other interventions, then keeps the server order. It can differ from the Inbox only among interventions.
- **Cap and overflow.** Three cards (the canvas grid is three columns; the old row cap was three). Remaining requests collapse into a dashed row: "N more · <Project / Task>, <Project / Task> · Inbox →" naming up to two, linking `/app/inbox`. A request answered in a card stays in place as its confirmation (below), in addition to the three.
- **Stats are installation-wide and ignore the Project filter.** Needs you is `inboxSummaryOf(requests)?.count` (absent, shown as "—", unless the whole Inbox was read and the last read succeeded, as the sidebar does). Uncertain counts active tasks with `isUncertain`; Active tasks counts `isActiveColumn(taskColumn(t))` (Draft included, as `taskRouteSubtitle`); Running turns is `tasks[0].capacity.globalUsage / globalLimit` (absent with no tasks, the sidebar `CapacityMeter` limit).
- **In-card answering gate.** The Inbox item has no form, so each question card reads `/api/operator/tasks/:taskId/questions/:interactionId` (`questionReadSchema`). It mounts `InboxQuestion` only when status is `pending`, `form.questions.length === 1` and that question is `single-choice` (custom text, when allowed, renders through the shared component). Grouped, multiple-choice and free-text forms, non-pending statuses, a failed gate read and a loading gate show the request with an "Answer question" link into the Inbox (loading shows "Loading question…" first). `QuestionResponse` repeats the same GET once when mounted. shortcut: one duplicate small read per inline card, upgrade by letting `QuestionResponse` accept a preloaded read if it ever matters.
- **Confirmation stays visible.** Inbox guidance keeps a recorded confirmation instead of selecting the next request. The card list remembers `{item, index}` when `onRecorded` fires and keeps rendering that card (which now shows `QuestionResponse`'s recorded card with its hold lines) while the refreshed Inbox read drops the request. No `onBack` is passed, so there is no "Back to Inbox" button. State lives in the Overview component and clears when it unmounts.
- **Approval and intervention evidence.** Approval cards reuse the Inbox's `useInboxTask` task read, the exact action/target/version `dl` and `holdNotices(task)` lines ("Approval does not clear it"); they never claim a decision is available in place. Extract those pieces from `inbox-detail.tsx` so Inbox markup is unchanged.
- **Placement.** The stat strip is the first element of the Overview content, under the shell `PageHeader` (a `PageHeader` slot would crowd the phone header). Keep section names where tests and the Search/Settings flows use them ("Across your projects", "Completed work"); rename the attention region to "Needs you".

### Implementation context

- **Existing:** `web/src/task-views.tsx` — `TaskViews` renders, for `overview`, `AttentionSection` then the toolbar and `TaskRow` list in `.task-list[data-density="compact"]`, then `CompletedWork`; non-overview routes render `AttentionBar` and are unchanged. `TaskRow`, `TaskStateMark`, `TaskFacts` are shared with `/app/tasks` and project routes; `TaskBoard` is W5's.
- **Existing:** `web/src/task-attention.tsx` — `AttentionSection` (rows, `shown = 3`, "N more in the Inbox", "N unresolved" badge, coverage and `ResourceStatus` handling), `CompletedWork`, `AttentionBar`. Keep `AttentionBar` and the failure/partial-read copy ("Requests are unavailable. Try again.", "Queue coverage is incomplete. Unavailable requests may remain.", "Nothing needs your attention.", "No requests visible in available coverage.").
- **Existing:** `web/src/inbox-detail.tsx` — `useInboxTask` (private), `InboxQuestion` (reads the task for `holdNotices(…, "answer")`, takes `observedAt`), `ApprovalDetail`, `InterventionDetail`. `web/src/question-response.tsx` — `QuestionResponse` (private `QuestionHolds`, posts `question.native.answer` | `question.answer` | `question.form.answer`, owns Retry answer / Refresh request / conflict / unknown outcomes) and `web/src/question-response-state.ts` — `QuestionResponseStates` (`forQuestion`, `recordedHere`), created once in `web/src/app.tsx` as `questionStates`.
- **Existing:** `web/src/tasks.ts` — `taskColumn`, `isActiveColumn`, `isUncertain`, `taskNext`, `taskReasons`, `columnCounts`, `taskDetailHref`; `web/src/request-presentation.ts` — `requestHref`, `requestActionLabel`, `requestMeta`; `web/src/inbox-presentation.ts` — `ageLabel`, `clockLabel`, `holdNotices`; `web/src/inbox.tsx` — `inboxSummaryOf`.
- **Existing:** `web/src/app.tsx` mounts `TaskViews` for `/app`, `/app/tasks` and project routes with `requests={inboxSummary.state}` (the whole-Inbox read; refreshed on mount and by "Refresh tasks"/`refreshAll`, not polled), and already holds `client`, `session` and `questionStates.current`. `web/src/work.css` holds `.work-attention`, `.work-request*`, `.work-tile`, `.work-completed` (all replaced here), `.task-row` grid and the 759px/760–1120px media blocks.
- **New:** `web/src/overview-model.ts` — pure `overviewStats`, `orderAttention`, `furtherRequests`, `interventionEvidence`, `projectRows`, `completedWork`, `inlineAnswerable`. **New:** `web/src/overview-attention.tsx` — `OverviewStats`, `NeedsYou`, request card variants, `ProjectsPanel`, `CompletedPanel`. **New:** `test/operator/operator-overview-model.test.ts`; `test/fixtures/task-summary.ts` (the `summary()` builder moved out of `test/operator/operator-work-presentation.test.ts`).
- **Follow:** `web/src/inbox-detail.tsx:ApprovalDetail` and `InboxQuestion` for data and copy; `test/coordination/operator-question-browser.test.ts` (failed-send and unknown-outcome routing around `page.route("**/api/operator/commands")`) for the in-card failure checks; `test/operator/operator-work-browser.test.ts:start` for fixture, sign-in, viewport and `shot` helpers; `test/fixtures/questions.ts` (`seedOwnQuestion(f, choiceForm, title, project)`, `seedOwnApproval`, `seedOwnIntervention`) and `test/fixtures/question-data.ts:choiceForm`.
- Run commands from the implementation worktree root with Node from `.node-version` after `npm ci`. Baseline was proven at `c10d9dbc`: trusted CI run 38775102741 passed all jobs, and a local `npm run build` then `node --test dist/test/operator/operator-work-presentation.test.js` (8 pass) and `node --test dist/test/operator/operator-work-browser.test.js` (7 pass, about 9 s) passed on Node 26.9.0. Rebuild (`npm run build`) after every source edit before running a `dist/` test.

### Implementation slices

**Task graph and parallelism:** T1 → T2 → T3 → T4 → T5, acyclic. Not safe to run concurrently: T2, T3 and T4 all edit `web/src/work.css`, `web/src/task-views.tsx` and `test/operator/operator-work-browser.test.ts`, and T3 needs T2's merged card components. No concurrent set; run in order.

#### 1. Overview model

**Task ID:** `T1`
**Depends on:** `none`
**Prerequisites:** none.
**Files and symbols:** new `web/src/overview-model.ts`; new `test/operator/operator-overview-model.test.ts`; new `test/fixtures/task-summary.ts` (move `summary()` and `Overrides` from `test/operator/operator-work-presentation.test.ts`, which imports it afterwards; no test removed or changed).
**Test:** `operator-overview-model.test.ts` (node:test, no browser) using `summary()` from the fixture. Cases: (1) `overviewStats` over tasks {Running, Uncertain, Done, Draft} and a whole-Inbox read of 5 items returns needsYou 5, uncertain 1, active 3 (Done excluded, Draft included), running `{used, limit}` from the first summary; a partial (`complete:false`) or errored read gives needsYou `null`; an empty task list or `undefined` tasks (not loaded) gives uncertain, active and running `null`. (2) `orderAttention`: items [question t=20, intervention for non-uncertain task, approval t=10, intervention for uncertain task] return uncertain intervention, other intervention, approval t=10, question t=20. (3) `furtherRequests` with 5 items and 3 shown returns count 2 and the two `"Project / Task"` names; with 3 or fewer returns null. (4) `interventionEvidence` names the lead (`"<name> · lead"`, or "Lead unavailable"), includes `taskReasons`, and flags `ownershipHeld` only when `isUncertain`. (5) `projectRows` gives per-project active counts in column order (uncertain first), paused flag, lead name from profiles or null, imported count from tasks with `source` and 0 when none. (6) `completedWork` returns count and at most three Done tasks, honouring a project filter. (7) `inlineAnswerable` is true only for status `pending` with one `single-choice` question; false for two questions, `multiple-choice`, `free-text`, `stale` and `form: null`.
**Implementation:** Pure functions only, typed from `contracts.ts` types; reuse `isUncertain`, `isActiveColumn`, `taskColumn`, `columnCounts`, `taskReasons`, `inboxSummaryOf`. No React, no I/O.
**Validate:** From the worktree root, after `npm run build`, run `node --test dist/test/operator/operator-overview-model.test.js dist/test/operator/operator-work-presentation.test.js`; expect all pass (presentation still 8 pass). Also `npm run typecheck`.
**Complete when:** the model and its unit test pass, and the presentation test is unchanged in behaviour.

#### 2. Stat strip and Needs-you cards with link responses

**Task ID:** `T2`
**Depends on:** `T1`
**Prerequisites:** T1 merged into the working branch.
**Files and symbols:** new `web/src/overview-attention.tsx` (`OverviewStats`, `NeedsYou`, `RequestCard` with question/approval/intervention bodies, dashed overflow row); `web/src/inbox-detail.tsx` (export `useInboxTask`; extract `ApprovalFacts({task, item})` from `ApprovalDetail`, which then renders it; markup, copy and Inbox tests unchanged); `web/src/question-response.tsx` (export `QuestionHolds`); `web/src/task-attention.tsx` (remove `AttentionSection`, keep `AttentionBar`, `Requests`, `InboxRead`); `web/src/task-views.tsx` (overview branch renders `OverviewStats` then `NeedsYou` where `AttentionSection` was; unchanged for other routes); `web/src/work.css` (replace `.work-attention`/`.work-request*`/`.work-tile` blocks with `.overview-stats`, `.overview-needs`, `.overview-cards`, `.overview-card`, `.overview-overflow`; phone variants in the existing `max-width: 759px` block); `web/src/app.tsx` (pass `operator` to `TaskViews` only when `pathname === "/app"`, built as `{client, session, questions: questionStates.current}`; `TaskViews` takes it as an optional prop, used by the approval card's task read here and by question answering in T3).
**Test:** Update `operator-work-browser.test.ts` "overview attention rows read the Inbox and cover its failure and partial states" and the Overview block in `operator-task-browser.test.ts` (`.work-request`, "Needs your attention", "View inbox"): region `Needs you`; cards `.overview-card` (at most 3); each card text matches `Question|Approval|Execution uncertain|Intervention`, a `HH:MM` or "Age unknown", "Responsibility unknown" or the requester, no UUID; each card has exactly one response control (link named `Answer question`, `Review material & decide` or `Inspect execution`) carrying `aria-describedby` to its headline; the question link href is `/app/inbox?task=<id>&request=…`, the intervention link `/app/tasks/<id>`; header link `Open Inbox · N`; `Needs you` stat equals the sidebar `.nav-count`; the fourth-request check becomes a dashed row `1 more ·` naming project and task and linking `/app/inbox`; Inbox-unavailable and partial reads keep their copy and show `—` for Needs you and no "unresolved" text. New tests in the same file: (a) stat strip values for the seeded catalog (Uncertain equals the number of seeded list rows that read "Execution ownership is uncertain", Active tasks equals the `.task-row` count at the default State, Running turns `n / limit` equals the sidebar meter text); before the task list loads (route the task-list read until released) Uncertain, Active tasks and Running turns read "—"; (b) card order puts the intervention first then oldest by `createdAt`, with an approval from `seedOwnApproval` and its card showing the exact action, target, `version N`, a hold line when present, no Approve/Deny control, and the destination link `/coordination/task/<taskId>#<interactionId>`; (c) intervention card shows lead and recorded reasons and "Ownership stays held" for the uncertain task and no invented observation text.
**Implementation:** Card anatomy from recorded fields only: badge (symbol + word: Question and Approval in attention tone, "Execution uncertain" in risk tone for an uncertain intervention else "Intervention"), right-aligned mono `HH:MM · age` via `clockLabel`/`ageLabel` ("Age unknown" when `createdAt` is null), context line `Project / Task title`, headline h3 (question: first form label when known else `item.reason`; approval: `approval.action` when read else `item.reason`; intervention: `item.reason`), "Requested by <name>" or "Responsibility unknown", an evidence block (approval: `ApprovalFacts` and `QuestionHolds` over `holdNotices(task)`; intervention: `interventionEvidence`; question: "Task evidence" link to `item.evidence`), and one response control. Header: h2 "Needs you", hint "Execution uncertainty first, then oldest", link "Open Inbox · N →" (no N when the summary is absent). When the task list has no entry for an intervention's task (not loaded or failed), omit its evidence block rather than show a placeholder, and treat it as not uncertain for ordering. Keep `ResourceStatus`, the coverage alert and empty-state copy exactly. Responsive: grid 3 columns at 1121px and wider, 2 columns 760–1120px, one column on phone; stat strip `dl` right-aligned on desktop and a 2×2 grid on phone; controls 44px on phone. Tone uses `--risk*`/`--attn*` tokens; never colour alone.
**Validate:** From the worktree root, after `npm run build`, run `node --test dist/test/operator/operator-work-browser.test.js dist/test/operator/operator-task-browser.test.js dist/test/operator/operator-inbox-browser.test.js`; expect all pass (Inbox markup unchanged). Also `npm run typecheck && npm run lint`.
**Complete when:** Overview shows the stat strip and ordered cards with link responses, the dashed row and unchanged failure/partial states, and the three files above pass.

#### 3. Answer a single-choice question in its card

**Task ID:** `T3`
**Depends on:** `T2`
**Prerequisites:** T2's card components and the `operator` prop are in place. Boundary evidence: the Inbox's own question browser tests must still pass before T4 starts (hold T4 if they fail).
**Files and symbols:** `web/src/overview-attention.tsx` (question gate hook reading `questionReadSchema`; `QuestionCardBody`; answered-card retention in `NeedsYou`); `web/src/work.css` (`.overview-card` form variants); `test/operator/operator-work-browser.test.ts`.
**Test:** New browser tests in `operator-work-browser.test.ts` (seed `seedOwnQuestion(f, choiceForm, "Overview choice", "Overview project")`; the shared fixture also holds the plain catalog question): (1) the single-choice card shows the question label, its two options with descriptions as radios, `Submit answer` and no "Answer question" link; the mixed-form catalog question and a `guideForm` question show the "Answer question" link and no radios; a failed gate read (`page.route` 500 on the question GET) falls back to the link. (2) Validation: click Submit with no option; expect the shared field error beside the question (`role=alert`), focus on the first invalid control and zero POSTs to `/api/operator/commands`. (3) Same command as the Inbox: answer one seeded single-choice question in its card and an identical second one in the Inbox; capture each POST body with `request.postDataJSON()`; expect equal `type`, equal shape of `answers`, numeric `expectedRevision`, a UUID `key`, and the same "Answer sent. It reaches the requester on its next turn." copy; `f.service.coordinationView().readTask(id).questions[0].status` is no longer `open` for both. (4) Confirmation stays: after the card answer the Inbox read drops the request, yet the card remains in place showing the recorded confirmation and any hold lines, `Needs you` count decrements, no other card opens or steals focus; reload shows no card for it. (5) Failure paths follow `test/coordination/operator-question-browser.test.ts` (refuse with 400, then abort after fetch): the card shows "Couldn't send the answer: the service didn't accept it. Your answer is still here.", then "Retry answer", then "We couldn't confirm your answer was sent. Your answer is kept until you check." with "Check whether it saved"; the choice is retained. (6) Draft sharing: choose an option in the card, navigate to the Inbox request, the same choice is selected (shared `QuestionResponseStates`).
**Implementation:** In `QuestionCardBody`, run `useOperatorResource(\`${session.csrfToken}:overview-question:${taskId}:${interactionId}\`, loader)` with the same GET as `QuestionResponse`; render "Loading question…" while loading, the link on error or when `inlineAnswerable` is false, else `<InboxQuestion client session taskId interactionId states={questions} requesterName={item.requesterName} compactContext observedAt={requests.fetchedAt} onRecorded={…}/>` with no `onBack`. `onRecorded` stores `{item, index}` in `NeedsYou` state and calls the existing `retry()` (the `refresh` prop). Render order is the fresh cards with each remembered card re-inserted at its index when absent from the fresh list; use `key={item.id}` so a poll or refresh keeps typed input and focus. No change to `QuestionResponse` behaviour. If mounting `InboxQuestion` needs a change to its command path or state ownership, that is a plan mismatch (Guardrails).
**Validate:** From the worktree root, after `npm run build`, run `node --test dist/test/operator/operator-work-browser.test.js dist/test/coordination/operator-question-browser.test.js dist/test/coordination/operator-question-cards-browser.test.js dist/test/operator/operator-inbox-browser.test.js`; expect all pass in Chromium and WebKit where the existing files use both.
**Complete when:** a single-choice question is answered in its card with the Inbox's command and outcomes, other forms link to the Inbox, and the confirmation stays visible; the four files pass.

#### 4. Work panel, Projects panel and Completed work

**Task ID:** `T4`
**Depends on:** `T3`
**Prerequisites:** T3 complete (shared `task-views.tsx`, `work.css`, work-browser test file).
**Files and symbols:** `web/src/task-views.tsx` (overview branch: bordered panel around the toolbar and compact list; a hairline column-label row; side column with `ProjectsPanel` and `CompletedPanel`; `TaskFacts` marks "Next: you" with `data-operator="true"`); `web/src/task-filters.tsx` (toolbar unchanged behaviour; Overview keeps heading "Across your projects", List/Board `aria-pressed` buttons, Project and State selects, Refresh tasks, More filters); `web/src/task-attention.tsx` (remove `CompletedWork`); `web/src/overview-attention.tsx` (`ProjectsPanel`, `CompletedPanel`); `web/src/work.css` (panel, label row, side column, amber Next, project dot, phone stacking).
**Test:** In `operator-work-browser.test.ts`: (a) Overview region "Across your projects" is a panel with column labels Task, State, Next, Lead (labels `aria-hidden`; no "Updated" column), the toolbar still has Project, State, List and Board on one row (the existing toolbar test keeps passing on `/app/tasks`; add the same row check on `/app`), List/Board switch keeps filters and sends no command (existing behaviour), and `.task-row` pitch and `data-task-id` hooks are unchanged. (b) "Next: you · answer question" rows carry `data-operator="true"` and an amber computed colour; other rows do not. (c) Projects panel region "Projects": one link per project to `/app/projects/<id>` with name, `Lead · <name>` (or "No lead configured"), activity counts equal to `projectRows` over that project's active tasks (uncertain first, then nonzero columns as lowercase words), "Project paused" for the paused project and `N from GitHub` for the imported-task project (seeded in `seedCatalog`) or "No imported tasks"; it contains no request, result excerpt or sync time. (d) "Completed work" region: `1 completed task · no decision needed`, up to three completed task links (href `/app/tasks/<id>`) and "View completed" to `/app/tasks?state=Done`; absent when there are none (existing "overview without requests or completed work" test unchanged). (e) Phone 390×844: no horizontal page scroll, column labels hidden, panels stacked, `.work-toolbar` controls ≥44px (existing assertion on `/app/tasks` extended to `/app`).
**Implementation:** The work table keeps the shared `TaskRow` (title+project/identity, state mark, next+reasons, lead, chevron) so `/app/tasks` and project routes are untouched except for the `data-operator` attribute. Label row sits above the compact list at 760px and wider only. Side column beside the panel at 1121px and wider, below it otherwise. Project dot is a small square from a fixed three-colour cycle by project order, never a state colour. Board view inside Overview still renders `TaskBoard` unchanged.
**Validate:** From the worktree root, after `npm run build`, run `node --test dist/test/operator/operator-work-browser.test.js dist/test/operator/operator-task-browser.test.js dist/test/operator/operator-responsive-browser.test.js dist/test/operator/operator-shell-browser.test.js`; expect all pass (responsive covers Chromium and WebKit at 390, 759, 760, 1024, 1121 and 1366 including `/app`).
**Complete when:** Overview shows the work panel beside Projects and Completed work at desktop widths and stacks on phone, with the four files passing.

#### 5. Documentation, matrix coverage and evidence

**Task ID:** `T5`
**Depends on:** `T3, T4`
**Prerequisites:** T3 and T4 complete.
**Files and symbols:** `design/DESIGN.md` Implementation status (see below); `docs/design/ui08-foundation.md` row for `/app`, `/app/tasks`, `/app/projects/:id` (the Overview sentence "Overview attention is one row per Inbox request…" becomes the cards, stat strip, in-card single-choice answer, dashed row, work panel and side panels); `test/operator/operator-responsive-browser.test.ts` (add `seedOwnQuestion(f, choiceForm, …)` to the fixture so the in-card form is covered in Chromium and WebKit; add a card-overflow check to `layoutProblems`' existing clipping rules only if a card control clips).
**Test:** Responsive matrix journeys in both engines pass at every listed viewport for `overview` with the in-card form present (no clipping, no horizontal scroll, zero command POSTs). Evidence: capture the Overview at 1366×900 and 390×844 (desktop and phone shots from the work-browser tests, plus one with the in-card form selected and one with the recorded confirmation) via `captureBrowserEvidence`.
**Implementation:** DESIGN.md edits in place, no dated sections: remove "Overview attention cards and stat strip" from "Not yet adopted"; rewrite the "Overview, task list and Board" bullets for the new Overview (cards, in-card single-choice answer, strip placement under the title, ordering partition, dashed row, work panel without Updated, Projects panel without sync time, "Completed work" instead of Recent results, no phone Overview frame so phone is composed from the shell and desktop frame); change the Inbox section's entry-point line ("the Overview and task-row attention links (unchanged)") to say Overview cards answer single-choice questions through the shared `QuestionResponse`. Counterparts to state: failed answer → Retry answer; stale read → Refresh request; conflict → Review current request; unknown → Check whether it saved; recorded → confirmation stays on the card (an answer is not reversible, as in the Inbox); approval and intervention only link. Entry points that apply: Overview desktop and phone, project and `/app/tasks` routes (List/Board attention bar, unchanged), Inbox, task `?request=`, retained HTML coordination page (unchanged); gaps: no notification, deep-link or context-menu surface exists. Artboard comparison: view `01-attention-overview` on the canvas (open the artifact link in `design/DESIGN.md` with the Artifact tool or Browser pane; board source is `project/01-attention-overview.dc.html`) beside the 1366×900 shot, and `09-phone-inbox-queue`, `ds-domain-components` and `800a-tablet-overview-list` beside the 390×844 shot; record in the PR the remaining deliberate differences already listed in DESIGN.md.
**Validate:** From the worktree root, after `npm run build`, run `node --test dist/test/operator/operator-responsive-browser.test.js dist/test/operator/operator-work-browser.test.js`; expect all pass. Then `npm run format:check`; expect clean.
**Complete when:** DESIGN.md and the ui08 row describe the shipped Overview, the matrix includes the in-card form in both engines, and desktop and phone evidence with the artboard comparison is recorded for the PR.

### Acceptance coverage

| Acceptance criterion | Slice | Verification |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Overview puts the next decisions first, above a compact work table | 2, 4 | T2 card/order tests; T4 panel test |
| Title and stat strip: Needs you, Uncertain, Active tasks, Running turns | 2 | T2 stat strip test (a) |
| Needs you cards: uncertainty first, then questions and approvals oldest first | 1, 2 | T1 `orderAttention`; T2 order test (b) |
| Each card shows request, reason, inline evidence and its response | 2 | T2 card tests (b), (c) and the per-card assertions |
| Single-choice question answered in its card; an approval always opens exact material | 2, 3 | T3 tests (1), (3); T2 approval test (b) |
| Dashed row names further requests and opens the Inbox | 1, 2 | T1 `furtherRequests`; T2 dashed-row assertion |
| Work table (List/Board switch, filters; Task, State, Next, Lead) beside Projects and Recent results, separate from requests | 4 | T4 tests (a)–(d); Updated and recency omissions recorded in T5 |
| Keep every SPEC.md behaviour and existing tests; update selectors that change | 2, 3, 4 | Named existing tests updated in place; Inbox and question suites pass |
| DESIGN.md Implementation status updated in the same change | 5 | T5 doc edits, `format:check` |
| Desktop 1366×900 and phone 390×844 screenshots compared with the artboards | 5 | T5 evidence and comparison notes; phone artboard gap per Planning decisions |
| Answering in a card uses the same command, validation and outcome handling as the Inbox | 3 | T3 tests (2), (3), (5), (6) |

### Final validation

- From the worktree root, after `npm ci`, run `npm run check` at the integrated delivery candidate before marking the PR ready; expect type checking, lint, formatting, build and the full suite to pass. CI then runs its profiles (Chromium operator shards, WebKit on nightly/manual) and the required `check` context must be green.
- Per-slice commands above are the focused checks; do not rerun the full suite after each slice or repair. Re-run a slice's focused command only when files it covers change.

### Review focus

- Independent review of the integrated candidate should check that the card answer path is the Inbox's (no second command builder, no change to `QuestionResponse` behaviour), that an approval never offers a decision in place, and that no number, time or identifier is shown that a read model does not carry.

content.title: W4: Task detail header, tabs and inspector

nodes.body:
<!-- to-plan:implementation-plan:v2 -->

**Revision:** 1
**Supersedes:** none
**Replan report:** none

## Implementation plan

**Issue:** https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/issues/1041
**Planned against:** `main` at `1c3007176b8480c58842a1862d5cc64a082770c3`
**Publication mode:** Autonomous
**Local state:** Clean
**Epoch closure:** null

### Approach

Re-lay the existing `/app/tasks/:id` page (`TaskWorkspace`) on the `03-task-detail` composition: a header (Back, title and recorded outcome from the shell page header, then a status strip and a tab list), five tab panels, and on Overview a stacked main column beside a task inspector. Everything is `web/` presentation over the task read the page already holds; no `src/` change, no new read, command or endpoint.

The mechanism is deliberate: **all five panels stay mounted and inactive ones are `hidden`**. Files, Changes, Review, History and the reply draft keep their state, focus, unconfirmed-command checks and reading anchors exactly as today (they already live in `TaskWorkspaceState` and the page's `data-record-id` anchors), and a hidden panel has no layout box so the existing anchor capture skips it. The active tab is page state, not a route: tabs add no history entry; deep links choose the initial tab.

Order: T1 pure model and tests → T2 header strip, tabs and tab-aware navigation → T3 Overview composition, assignments table and inspector → T4 docs, evidence and responsive coverage.

### Guardrails

- SPEC.md owns behaviour; the canvas owns presentation (epic #1035 Boundaries). No change to `src/`, contracts, commands, endpoints, Stop/Resume or hold semantics, approval authority (an approval still opens `/coordination/task/:id#<interactionId>`; the page never approves or denies), or the retained `/task/:id`, `/runtime/task/:id`, `/coordination/task/:id` pages. #1030 owns when Stop… is offered: keep `TaskHeaderActions` and `taskHeaderReport().stop` untouched. Haze stays untouched.
- SPEC "preserve visible actionable requests, reading position, disclosure choices and unfinished replies as the task updates" holds across tabs: an open request is reachable from every tab (T2 strip), switching tabs keeps each tab's scroll, the unsent reply, history expansions and Files/Changes/Review state, and a poll or Refresh task on any tab restores that tab's anchor.
- Out of scope: Board (#1042), Inbox (#1040), Overview (#1039), composer (#1043), neutral badges (#1044), readiness picker (#1032), phone drill-in screens, a sticky phone bottom bar, any new identifier, time, count or artifact list that no read model carries (Planning decisions).
- Keep every existing test. Update selectors that change (listed per slice) rather than deleting; add browser tests for each new behaviour. Non-browser cases stay independently runnable (Node 26 service CI has no browser).
- Plan-mismatch vs ordinary repair. A factual plan mismatch (one diagnosis, at most two repair cycles) is only a wrong seam or repository assumption in this plan, namely: (a) mounted-but-`hidden` panels cannot keep the reading anchor, focus restoration and unconfirmed-control focus working with only tab bookkeeping around `capture()` and the layout effect; (b) the task read lacks a fact the strip or inspector is specified to show (Planning decisions lists the omissions already settled); (c) `first.current`/`layoutPath` deep-link handling cannot select the initial tab without a first-paint flash that existing tests observe. Ordinary in-scope work stays with the ticket owner and consumes no budget: selector, copy and fixture updates, CSS and responsive tuning (including the band and tab-fit details in Allowed deviations), test setup, lint/format/typecheck, documentation, CI flake and baseline-equivalent path or command corrections. Record such corrections briefly in the delivery record; stop for a material design/contract change, changed authority, or unknown overlap.
- Reuse the existing delivery record and valid checks/reviews. Use an integration amendment only for a changed published integration decision requiring durable consumption.

### Planning decisions

- **Artboards.** `03-task-detail` governs every task; `12-imported-task-source-execution` governs the imported inspector (read-only snapshot, issue state, sync, dependencies managed in GitHub, commenting permission, "GitHub owns the issue. Ensemble coordinates the work."); `47-phone-task-overview`, `53-phone-failed-refresh-uncertain` and `55-phone-parallel-delegation` govern phone composition; `800c-tablet-task-evidence` shows the tab header at 1024. The phone artboards `14`/`15` draw an older GitHub-source/Ensemble tab pair with a task "Pause" that DESIGN.md already rules out; they are not built. `06-workspace-changes-review` draws a compact header on non-Overview tabs; this build keeps the full header on every tab.
- **Header ownership.** The shell `PageHeader` already owns the single `h1`, Back and `TaskHeaderActions` (`app.tsx` `taskHeaderProps`), and `app.tsx` is being edited by #1040 for the Inbox route. So `app.tsx`, `components.tsx` and `styles.css` are not edited: the report's `subtitle` becomes the recorded desired outcome (`data.task.outcome`, plain text, clamped to three lines in CSS, full text stays in the brief; omitted when empty), and `TaskWorkspace` renders the identity/status strip, tools row and tab list as the first children of its `article`. Deviation: the task ID and source chip sit in the strip row under the title instead of above it.
- **Task ID.** No read carries a short ID (AT-142). The ID slot reads `repository#number` for an imported task (the chip repeats it as "Imported · repository#N ↗" linking `source.url`) and "Local task" otherwise, as Overview/List/Board do. No raw UUID.
- **Read-model omissions, recorded rather than invented.** No task "Updated" time (omit); no tab counts (History is loaded per assignment, Review count lives in local-review state; DESIGN.md already says Review has no count); no GitHub Project status (`memberships[].projectFields` hold node ids only); no "Unblocks" list; no "Last turn" time or workspace root; no per-task artifact list (artifacts stay in the latest result's `RetainedResultEvidence`; the inspector lists results and the bound delivery PR). T4 records each in DESIGN.md.
- **Strip facts come from `TaskRead` only.** State word and icon follow `taskStatusLine`'s existing precedence (Stop hold or stopping → Stopping; uncertain; running/starting; Done/Cancelled; paused by `admission.reasons`/execution/closure hold → Paused; not ready → Draft; ineligible, waiting or task hold → Waiting; else Ready) and reuse the `.task-state[data-column]` styling and `stateIcons` from Overview/List. Readiness text is the existing `taskStatusLine` state part (`taskReadiness`). Next actor: uncertain → "Next: you · inspect execution", open approval → "review material & decide", open question → "answer question", unresolved results → "resolve result destination", a rejected completion at the current task version → "review rejected completion", else "No operator decision" (terminal: "Next: none · no decision"/"history retained"). The list's `lead-review` and server-side non-Stop task-hold uncertainty are not in the task read and are not reproduced.
- **A request is never hidden by a tab.** The strip's "Next: you · …" text is a button that selects Overview and focuses the decision card (`#decisions`). That is the persistent route to a request from Files, Changes, Review and History, including one that arrives by poll while another tab is open (no focus is stolen).
- **Tab state.** `TaskWorkspaceState.tab` (default `overview`) and `tabScroll`. One `selectTab(tab)` stashes the current `scrollY`, clears `anchor`/`bottom`/`historyAnchor` (as the existing `showSection` branch does), sets the tab, and after commit restores that tab's stored scroll. Not mirrored to the URL (the existing test asserts in-page moves add no history entry); `history.state.taskWorkspaceReading` gains `tab` so Back/Forward restores it. Tab buttons use the WAI-ARIA tab pattern (`role=tablist` "Task sections", `role=tab`, roving `tabIndex`, Arrow/Home/End, `aria-controls` the `role=tabpanel`).
- **Section → tab map** (section ids unchanged, so existing `?section=` links, `showSection` and `document.getElementById` keep working): `decisions`, `brief`, `review` (Latest result), `assignments`, `reply` → Overview; `files` → Files; `changes` → Changes; `local-review` → Review; `context`, `history` → History. Initial tab from the URL, in order: `section`; the fragment (`#history`, `#files`…; `path` can carry it, so read the fragment from `path` as well as `location.hash`); `path` (+`repository`) → Files; `target`/`base` → Changes; `review` → Review; `assignment` → History (an expanded assignment must be visible); `result`/`source` → Overview. A `record`/`request` target selects the tab of the panel that contains it. `EntryLinks` (frame 57's contextual entries: Files, Changes, Review, "Assignment context & identifiers", "Assignment history", "Message lead") stay, as in-place, history-neutral links that now also select the tab; `ask()` selects Overview before focusing `#workspace-reply`; `RetainedResultEvidence.openCurrent` selects Files.
- **Persistent tools.** The old `.task-source-line` actions stay reachable on every tab (many tests click "Refresh task" from History or Review): "Open GitHub to edit source", "Refresh source observation" (imported only), "Advanced task controls", "Requests and coordination" and "Refresh task" remain in one tools row under the strip, with their names and behaviour unchanged. The inspector shows source facts, not duplicate controls.
- **Inspector is Overview-only** (as `03-task-detail`; the Files/Changes/Review/History artboards are full width). Beside the main column from 1121px of shell width; below the main column otherwise.

### Implementation context

- **Existing:** `web/src/task-workspace.tsx` — `TaskWorkspace` (one function, ~1900 lines): the task read via `useOperatorResource`; `capture()`/`poll()`/`refresh()`; a `useLayoutEffect` that restores reading position, applies `?section=`/`?record=`/`?request=` on first render and on path change, and shows the "New updates" button; `ask()`; `refreshSource`; the render order today is source line and tools → `section.workspace-attention.decision-card` (`WaitReasons`, hold flags, `QuestionResponse` for `?request=`, `.decision` blocks) → `.task-columns` (`section#brief`, `section#review` with `EntryLinks`, `AssignmentRows`, result evidence) → `TaskFiles` (`section#files`) → `Changes` (`section#changes`) → `LocalReviewPanel` (`section#local-review`) → `section#context` → `section#history` → `section#reply`. Also `sectionIds`, `Disclosure`, `Literal`, `CriteriaRows`, `ReviewEvidence`.
- **Existing:** `web/src/task-header.tsx` — `taskHeaderReport` (title, `subtitle = taskStatusLine`, Back, `stop`), `TaskHeaderActions` (Execution, Stop… dialog; unchanged). `web/src/task-detail.tsx` — `showSection`, private `inPage`, `EntryLinks`, `AssignmentRows`. `web/src/task-detail.css` — header grid for `.page-header[data-desktop-back]`, `.task-source-line`, `.decision-card`, `.task-columns`, `.entry-links`, `.assignment-row`, `.reply-card`. `web/src/task-workspace-state.ts` — `TaskWorkspaceState` (`scrollY`, `historyAnchor`, `focusRecord`, `selectionInitialized`, `expanded`, `files`, `changes`, `review`), purged on sign-out.
- **Existing:** `web/src/task-overview.ts` — `taskStatusLine`, `stopConsequences`, `assignmentRow`, `sourceLine`, `originLabel`, `briefParts`, `criterionRows`. `web/src/inbox-presentation.ts:holdNotices(data, action)` and `web/src/question-response.tsx:QuestionHolds` (read-only dependencies; #1040 edits `inbox-presentation.ts`, so import only). `web/src/execution-runtime.ts:executionSummary`. `web/src/tasks.ts` — `TaskColumn`. `web/src/task-views.tsx` — private `stateIcons`; `web/src/work.css` — `.task-state[data-column]`, `.task-next[data-operator]`.
- **Existing (app wiring, not edited):** `web/src/app.tsx` renders `PageHeader` with `taskHeaderProps` from the `TaskHeaderReport` the page reports through `onHeader`, and mounts `TaskWorkspace` with `client`, `session`, `drafts`, `taskId`, `path`, `onRefresh`, `workspace`, `onHeader`, `questionStates`, `state`. The shell `path` can include a `#fragment` (set by `navigate`).
- **New:** `web/src/task-tabs.ts` — `taskTabs`, `tabForSection`, `tabForLocation`, `tabIds`. `web/src/task-inspector.tsx` — `TaskInspector`. `test/operator/operator-task-strip.test.ts`, `test/operator/operator-task-tabs.test.ts`, `test/fixtures/task-tabs.ts` (`openTaskTab(page, name)`).
- **Follow:** `web/src/overview-attention.tsx` for card/hold anatomy and `QuestionHolds` use; `test/operator/operator-work-browser.test.ts:start` and `shot` for fixture, sign-in, viewport and evidence helpers; `test/fixtures/operator-work.ts:seedCatalog` (returns `importedId` for `fixture/source#42`, outcome "Source-owned imported outcome"); `test/sources/github-dependencies.test.ts` for seeding an open native GitHub blocker; `test/fixtures/task-review.ts:seedReviewTask` as `operator-task-detail-browser.test.ts:seed` uses it.
- Run commands from the implementation worktree root with Node from `.node-version` (24.21.0) after `npm ci`; rebuild (`npm run build`) after every source edit before running a `dist/` test. `main` has since advanced to `15e16a30` (#1043, merged after this plan's base): it changes `design/DESIGN.md`, `docs/design/ui08-foundation.md` (the `/app/tasks/new` row only), `web/src/wait-reasons.tsx` (an opt-in `variant`; the default output this page uses is unchanged), the composer rules in `web/src/styles.css`, composer files and `operator-task-overview.test.ts`. None of this plan's seams moved; re-read the `DESIGN.md` fragments named in T4 before editing them. Baseline proven at `1c300717`: trusted CI run 38785565934 passed every job (quality, node24 operator/workspaces/execution/integrations shards, node26 service, `check`), and locally on Node 24.21.0 `npm run build` then `node --test dist/test/operator/operator-task-overview.test.js` (8 pass) and `node --test dist/test/operator/operator-task-stop-browser.test.js dist/test/operator/operator-task-detail-browser.test.js` (10 pass, about 9 s) passed.

### Implementation slices

**Task graph and parallelism:** T1 → T2 → T3 → T4, acyclic. No concurrent set: T2 and T3 both edit `web/src/task-workspace.tsx`, `web/src/task-detail.css` and `test/operator/operator-task-detail-browser.test.ts`, T3 mounts into T2's panels, and T4 documents the result. Shared files with in-flight work are listed in Review focus; none is a source file of #1032 or #1040 except `DESIGN.md` and the ui08 docs file.

#### 1. Tab and strip model

**Task ID:** `T1`
**Depends on:** `none`
**Prerequisites:** none.
**Files and symbols:** new `web/src/task-tabs.ts`; `web/src/task-overview.ts` (factor `taskReadiness(data)` out of `taskStatusLine`, which keeps its exact output; add `taskColumnOf(data)`, `taskNextActor(data)`, `taskIdentity(data)`, `sourceFacts(source)`, `executionFacts(data)`; `sourceLine` reuses `sourceFacts`); new `test/operator/operator-task-tabs.test.ts`; new `test/operator/operator-task-strip.test.ts`. `operator-task-overview.test.ts` is not edited; its existing `taskStatusLine`, `sourceLine`, `stopConsequences` and `assignmentRow` cases are the regression guard.
**Test:** node:test, no browser. `operator-task-tabs`: `tabForSection` for every section id in the map (and an unknown id → `overview`); `tabForLocation` for `?section=history`, `?section=local-review`, `?assignment=a#history`, `?path=docs/a.md&repository=r`, `?target=branch`, `?review=k`, `?result=r&source=s`, `/app/tasks/x#files` (fragment), `?section=files&assignment=a` (section wins), and no params → `null`. `operator-task-strip` (builds `TaskRead["data"]` literals as `operator-task-overview.test.ts:data()` does): `taskColumnOf` table — Stop hold on a running execution → Stopping, `uncertain` and `holds.uncertainty` → Uncertain, running/starting → Running, done/cancelled, closure `held` → Paused, `admission.reasons` has `project-paused` → Paused, not ready → Draft, ineligible or `holds.task` → Waiting, else Ready, each with its expected column. `taskNextActor`: uncertain beats approval beats question; open approval/question/unresolved result/rejected completion at the current version each name the operator action with `operator: true`; none open → `operator: false`; done and cancelled use their "Next: none" lines. `taskIdentity`: imported → `repository#number` and the source URL, repository missing → "repository unavailable#?", local → "Local task" and no URL. `sourceFacts`: latest successful sync across memberships, none → null. `executionFacts`: running-assignment count, lead runtime line, delivery "Reviewable PR · no PR yet" vs a bound PR vs not recorded.
**Implementation:** Pure functions typed from `TaskRead["data"]`; reuse `executionSummary` and the existing readiness/wait helpers. No React, no I/O. `taskStatusLine(data)` becomes `${taskReadiness(data)} / Accountable project lead: …` so `test/delivery/operator-delivery-integration-browser.test.ts` (which imports it) still compiles until T2 updates that test.
**Validate:** From the worktree root, after `npm run build`, run `node --test dist/test/operator/operator-task-tabs.test.js dist/test/operator/operator-task-strip.test.js dist/test/operator/operator-task-overview.test.js`; expect all pass (overview still 8 pass). Also `npm run typecheck`.
**Complete when:** the model and its unit tests pass and the existing overview helper tests are unchanged in behaviour.

#### 2. Header strip, tab list and tab-aware navigation

**Task ID:** `T2`
**Depends on:** `T1`
**Prerequisites:** T1 merged into the working branch.
**Files and symbols:** `web/src/task-workspace.tsx` (tab state, `selectTab`, panel wrappers, initial-tab selection, `ask`, `refresh`/`capture` bookkeeping, the layout effect's `first.current` and `layoutPath` branches, strip and tools row); `web/src/task-workspace-state.ts` (`tab`, `tabScroll`); `web/src/task-header.tsx` (`taskHeaderReport` subtitle becomes the outcome; new `TaskStrip` and `TaskTabs`); `web/src/task-detail.tsx` (`inPage`, `EntryLinks` and `AssignmentRows` take a `reveal(sectionId)` prop that selects the tab, then calls `showSection` after commit; `showSection` unchanged); `web/src/task-detail.css` (header band, strip, tools row, tabs, panels, phone); `web/src/task-views.tsx` (add `export` to `stateIcons`, nothing else); new `test/fixtures/task-tabs.ts`.
**Test:** In `test/operator/operator-task-detail-browser.test.ts` and the files below.
 Update in place: (a) test 1 "Task detail shows the designed header…" — `.page-header-title p` now reads the outcome ("Ship an accessible command menu" fixture's body-derived outcome or the seeded one); `nav[aria-label="Task sections"]` count 0 becomes the tablist (five `role=tab` named Overview, Files, Changes, Review, History; Overview `aria-selected=true`; no counts); the "Accountable project lead: Task lead$" check moves to the strip (`[data-task-strip]` contains "Accountable lead · Task lead" and the readiness text); exactly two header actions and Back stay; the decision card still sits above the brief and the side-by-side brief/result geometry assertions are unchanged (T2 does not re-lay Overview; T3 stacks them); the Files/Changes/Review entry-link loop keeps its `closest("section").id` assertion and now also asserts the matching tab is selected and `history.length` is unchanged; the final "Message lead" link focuses `section#reply` on Overview. (b) "An empty local task says so honestly" and "lists waits in order" read the strip instead of `.page-header-title p` (`/Accountable lead · Unconfigured/`). (c) `test/operator/operator-task-browser.test.ts` `statusLine` (closure-held and project-paused tasks) reads `[data-task-strip]`'s readiness text `/^Held · closed on GitHub/` and `/^Draft · project paused/`; the final `getByText("closed on GitHub")` zero-count assertion stays. (d) `test/delivery/operator-delivery-integration-browser.test.ts` lines near 44 and 243: compare the strip's readiness text with `taskReadiness(data)` and `/^Done/`. (e) Any assertion in the task-page browser files that reaches Files, Changes, Review, History or Captured-context content without a `?section=` deep link or a tab click (expected in `operator-task-workspace-browser`, `operator-task-background-refresh-browser`, `operator-harness-assignment-browser`, `operator-neutral-copy-browser`, `operator-search-browser`, `operator-review-browser`, `operator-retention-access-browser`, `operator-comments-browser`, `operator-question-browser`, `operator-question-cards-browser`, `operator-files-browser`, `operator-changes-browser`, `operator-local-review-browser`, `operator-inspection-navigation-browser`, `operator-retained-inspection-browser`) gets `openTaskTab(page, "History")` or a `?section=` deep link. Hidden panels fail Playwright visibility waits, so these surface as timeouts, not wrong values; do not delete or weaken the assertion.
 New tests in `operator-task-detail-browser.test.ts` (Chromium; one WebKit engine case for the tab keyboard pattern via `testForEngine`): (1) Tab list: Arrow Right/Left/Home/End move and select; each `role=tabpanel` is `hidden` unless selected; `aria-controls` ids resolve; exactly one panel visible; no command POST and `history.length` unchanged on every switch. (2) Deep links choose the tab with no flash: `?section=files`, `?section=local-review`, `?assignment=<id>#history`, `?path=…`, `?target=branch`, `?result=<id>` select Files, Review, History, Files, Changes, Overview respectively on first paint (assert `aria-selected` immediately after `page.goto` resolves the heading) and a `?record=<message id>` target selects the History panel that contains it. (3) State survives tab switches and Refresh task: type "Unsent reply" in `#workspace-reply`, expand an assignment (`#history details[open]` count 1), scroll Overview to the result anchor, switch to Files and back: reply text, expansion and the anchor top within 1px are unchanged; while on Files click "Refresh task" dispatched without scrolling, then return: same assertions. Repeat with a timer poll (`page.clock` or the existing background-refresh helper) while History is the active tab. (4) Per-tab scroll: scroll Files and History to different offsets, switch among Overview, Files and History: each restores its own `scrollY` within 1px. (5) Strip: state mark word and icon (`.task-state[data-column]`) for Waiting, Done and Stopping tasks from `seedReviewTask`/`f.seedPersistedState`, readiness text, "Next: you · review material & decide" (amber `data-operator`) with an open `seedOwnApproval`; the Next button on the Files tab selects Overview and focuses `#decisions`; a new approval that arrives while Files is active updates the strip without moving focus or the active tab. (6) Imported task (`seedCatalog().importedId`): ID slot `fixture/source#42`, chip "Imported · fixture/source#42" linking `source.url`; a local task shows "Local task" and no chip; neither shows a UUID. (7) Back/Forward restores the tab and scroll: Files → open Overview route → Back returns to Files at its scroll. (8) Persistent tools: "Refresh task", "Advanced task controls" and "Requests and coordination" are visible on every tab. (9) Stop… behaviour unchanged: `operator-task-stop-browser.test.ts` passes unmodified.
**Implementation:** (1) `TaskWorkspaceState` gains `tab: TaskTab = "overview"` and `tabScroll`. (2) In `TaskWorkspace` the `selectionInitialized` block sets `state.tab = tabForLocation(path) ?? "overview"` once; the layout effect's `layoutPath` branch calls `selectTab(tabForSection(id))` before `showSection(target)`, and the `first.current` branch selects the tab of the panel that contains a `record`/`request` target (`target.closest("[role=tabpanel]")`) before scrolling. `selectTab` is the only writer of `state.tab`. (3) Wrap the existing sections in five `div[role=tabpanel][hidden]` wrappers (`task-panel-overview|files|changes|review|history`); do not unmount or reorder section contents. `section#context` moves into the History panel before `section#history`. Overview holds the decision card, the "New updates" button, `.task-columns` content and `section#reply` (T3 recomposes it). (4) `capture()` stores `tab` in the `history.state.taskWorkspaceReading` payload; the `layoutPath` restore reads it back. `capture()`'s anchor query is unchanged because a hidden panel has no rect. (5) `TaskStrip` (task-header.tsx): identity (`taskIdentity`), chip, `ColumnMark`-style state mark using `stateIcons` and `.task-state[data-column]`, readiness (`taskReadiness`), Next actor (button when `operator`), lead name, then the tools row (`.task-source-line` content moved here unchanged); `TaskTabs`: the tab list. Both render as the first children of `article.task-workspace`, under the shell header. (6) `taskHeaderReport().subtitle` becomes `data.task.outcome || undefined`. (7) CSS in `task-detail.css` only: drop the desktop divider under the shell header on this route, put the hairline under the tabs, strip on the `--surface` tone if it can be done with CSS (otherwise page ground), amber `data-operator`, tabs 13px with a 2px indigo underline on the selected tab and 44px height at ≤1120px, panels `[hidden]{display:none}` stays the browser default (do not override it), outcome clamp.
**Validate:** From the worktree root, after `npm run build`, run `node --test dist/test/operator/operator-task-detail-browser.test.js dist/test/operator/operator-task-stop-browser.test.js dist/test/operator/operator-task-browser.test.js dist/test/workspaces/operator-task-workspace-browser.test.js dist/test/operator/operator-task-background-refresh-browser.test.js`; expect all pass. Then, because panels moved, `node --test dist/test/workspaces/operator-files-browser.test.js dist/test/workspaces/operator-changes-browser.test.js dist/test/workspaces/operator-local-review-browser.test.js dist/test/workspaces/operator-review-browser.test.js dist/test/workspaces/operator-inspection-navigation-browser.test.js dist/test/coordination/operator-comments-browser.test.js dist/test/delivery/operator-delivery-integration-browser.test.js`; expect all pass. Also `npm run typecheck && npm run lint`.
**Complete when:** the strip, tools row and five tabs render for local and imported tasks, deep links select the right tab on first paint, state and reading position survive tab switches, polls and Refresh task, and the files above pass.

#### 3. Overview composition and inspector

**Task ID:** `T3`
**Depends on:** `T2`
**Prerequisites:** T2's panels, `selectTab` and strip are in place.
**Files and symbols:** `web/src/task-workspace.tsx` (Overview panel: decision-first order, stacked `section#brief`, `section#review`, new `section#assignments`, `section#reply`; move the imported source/dependency blocks out of the brief); new `web/src/task-inspector.tsx` (`TaskInspector`); `web/src/task-detail.tsx` (`AssignmentRows` becomes a table); `web/src/task-detail.css` (Overview two-column grid, cards, table, inspector, phone reflow); `test/operator/operator-task-detail-browser.test.ts`.
**Test:** In `operator-task-detail-browser.test.ts` (extend `seed` with a second open approval via `seedOwnApproval` and a dependency-blocked variant): (1) Decision first: with an open `seedOwnApproval` the decision card's first block is the approval ("Your decision · approval pending", exact action, target, `revision N`, material hash line, link "Review material & decide" to `/coordination/task/<id>#<interactionId>`, no Approve/Deny control) followed, inside the same card, once by the blocking hold lines from `holdNotices` ("Approval does not clear it") when the task is held, then the `WaitReasons` list unchanged; the card sits above the brief at 1366 and 390. The existing "waits in order", "approval wait opens review" and "question names its requester" tests pass unchanged. (2) Overview order and layout (also update test 1's brief-beside-result assertions to the stacked order and keep the `.task-columns` class on the main column wrapper so its no-inner-scroll assertion still matches): Shared brief, Latest result, Assignments, Reply are stacked in one main column; at 1366 the `aside[aria-label="Task context"]` is to the right of the main column and not wider than 320px; at 1024 it is still beside; at 390 it is below the Reply card; the document is the only scroller and no horizontal scroll. (3) Assignments table: a real `table` with `th scope=col` Assignment, Requested by → result to, Known state; `.assignment-row` count equals the assignments (4 in `seed`); the title button still opens that assignment's history (History tab selected, `#history details[open]` 1) and `ExecutionNotices` text stays in the state cell; at 390 rows reflow to stacked blocks with 44px buttons. (4) Inspector content for a local task: Holds with a count and a row per hold and pending request (symbol plus word, "Approval pending · Next: you" for an open approval, `holdNotices` titles and details for waits); Dependencies lists local dependencies as links (`/app/tasks/<id>` with state) or "None"; Execution facts: state, running turns count, lead runtime line, delivery line; Results & artifacts lists each result newest first as an in-place link that sets the result revision select, selects Overview and focuses `section#review`, plus the bound PR when `delivery.binding` exists, and "No results yet." when empty. No "Updated", "Unblocks", "Last turn", workspace path or Project status text appears. (5) Imported task (`seedCatalog().importedId`, plus an open native blocker seeded as in `test/sources/github-dependencies.test.ts`): the Shared brief label reads "Requirements · GitHub" and the inspector's first group is "GitHub source · read-only" with `fixture/source#42`, "Issue open", "synced" with the latest successful time or "no successful sync", the note "GitHub owns the issue. Ensemble coordinates the work.", native blockers under "Dependencies · managed in GitHub" with a symbol and "Open blocker" or "Closed", "GitHub commenting permitted|unavailable" from `commentPolicy`, then a separate "Ensemble execution" group (holds, execution facts, results); a local task shows neither the GitHub group nor the note. No control inside the GitHub group posts or edits anything. (6) Files/Changes/Review/History tabs show no inspector.
**Implementation:** (1) Overview panel order: `section#decisions` (the existing `section.workspace-attention.decision-card` gains `id="decisions"` and an attention border only when an operator request is open; neutral otherwise), then `section#brief`, `section#review`, `section#assignments`, `section#reply`. Inside the decision card render open requests first, then, once and only when a request is open, `QuestionHolds` over `holdNotices(data)` (the same notices Inbox shows), then `WaitReasons` and the existing `{k} hold` lines unchanged; keep `QuestionResponse` for `?request=` and the completion/unresolved links. (2) Move `AssignmentRows` out of `section#review` into `section#assignments` and render it as a table: first cell the existing title button plus the short id in mono, second the requester → destination flow, third state, runtime and wait with `ExecutionNotices`; keep `.assignment-row` on each `tr`. (3) `TaskInspector` receives `data`, `taskId`, `selectedResult` and callbacks to select a result and reveal `review`; groups in order: (imported only) "GitHub source · read-only" then "Ensemble execution" label; Holds; Dependencies (native blockers for imported tasks, local dependencies for all); Execution facts; Results & artifacts. It moves the existing source-facts text (identity, per-selection sync lines) and the "Native/Local task dependencies" blocks out of the brief. (4) CSS: Overview grid `minmax(0,1fr) minmax(280px,320px)` at 1121px and wider and at 1024px; one column below; cards use `--surface`, `--line` and radius 8px; table reflows at ≤759px. Tone tokens only (`--attn*`, `--risk*`, `--idle*`, `--ok*`); symbol plus word on every state.
**Validate:** From the worktree root, after `npm run build`, run `node --test dist/test/operator/operator-task-detail-browser.test.js dist/test/operator/operator-task-stop-browser.test.js dist/test/workspaces/operator-task-workspace-browser.test.js dist/test/workspaces/operator-review-browser.test.js dist/test/coordination/operator-question-browser.test.js dist/test/coordination/operator-question-cards-browser.test.js dist/test/coordination/operator-comments-browser.test.js`; expect all pass in Chromium and WebKit where those files use both. Also `npm run typecheck && npm run lint`.
**Complete when:** Overview shows decision, brief, result, assignments table and Message lead stacked beside the inspector, the imported task separates GitHub source from Ensemble execution, and the files above pass.

#### 4. Documentation, evidence and responsive coverage

**Task ID:** `T4`
**Depends on:** `T3`
**Prerequisites:** T3 complete.
**Files and symbols:** `design/DESIGN.md` (Implementation status); `docs/design/ui08-foundation.md` (the `/app/tasks/:id` row); new `docs/evidence/ui-workbench-task-detail.md` and new PNGs under `docs/evidence/ui-workbench/` (new names only: `1366-task-detail.png`, `1366-task-detail-imported.png`, `1366-task-detail-history.png`, `390-task-detail.png`, `390-task-detail-imported.png`); `test/operator/operator-task-detail-browser.test.ts` (capture names); `test/operator/operator-responsive-browser.test.ts` only if the matrix flags a real layout problem (it already visits `/app/tasks/<id>?request=…` at 390, 760–1366 and 683 in both engines).
**Test:** Responsive matrix in both engines passes unchanged for the `question` route (task page with Overview, tab list and inspector), including no horizontal scroll and no clipping; the tab list fits at 390 without internal scroll, and at 360 may scroll inside itself only if the matrix does not flag it. Evidence: capture the task page at 1366×900 (Overview with a decision and a blocked imported task, and History) and 390×844 (local and imported) through `captureBrowserEvidence`, then copy the chosen shots from the journey's evidence directory into `docs/evidence/ui-workbench/`.
**Implementation:** DESIGN.md edited in place, no dated sections: remove "the task detail header, tabs and inspector" from "Not yet adopted" (edit only that fragment; re-read after #1040 and #1043 merge, which edit the same bullet); in "Task detail, composer and Stop" rewrite the task-detail bullets for the shipped page — the header (shell Back, title, outcome, Execution and Stop…), the strip and its sources, tabs and deep-link mapping, decision card first with the blocking hold line, Overview order, the inspector (Overview only, imported GitHub group), and each deliberate difference from Planning decisions (ID slot and chip under the title, no short ID, no Updated, no tab counts, no Project status, no Unblocks, no Last turn or workspace path, results rather than an artifact list, full header on every tab, no phone drill-in, bottom bar or GitHub-source/Ensemble tab pair, `lead-review` absent from the Next actor); replace the now-stale statements "The build has no holds side panel yet…", "Imported tasks keep source/execution separation… not separate panes or tabs", "The header shows Back, the title, a status line…" and "The section-button row is gone…" with current ones. State the counterparts: Stop… → confirm → Execution → Resume (retained, unchanged); a request is reachable from every tab through the strip; tab switches send nothing and keep drafts; Refresh task re-reads state only. Entry points that apply: Overview, List, Board, Inbox "Open task", Search results, recovery and assignment links, `?request=` and `?section=` deep links and the composer receipt all open `/app/tasks/:id` with the same header; the retained HTML pages are unchanged and linked from the tools row; gaps: no context menu, extension or notification surface exists. `docs/design/ui08-foundation.md` row: describe the strip, tabs, Overview column and inspector in place of "two-column detail… inspection sections follow". `docs/evidence/ui-workbench-task-detail.md` (dated, `docs/evidence/` is the only dated location): base SHA, branch, viewport, each shot with its artboard (`03-task-detail`, `12-imported-task-source-execution`, `47-phone-task-overview`, `53-phone-failed-refresh-uncertain`, `55-phone-parallel-delegation`, `800c-tablet-task-evidence`) and the deliberate differences. Compare by opening the artboards on the canvas (artifact link in `design/DESIGN.md`; board source `project/03-task-detail.dc.html` via the Artifact tool's read action) beside the shots.
**Validate:** From the worktree root, after `npm run build`, run `node --test dist/test/operator/operator-responsive-browser.test.js dist/test/operator/operator-task-detail-browser.test.js`; expect all pass. Then `npm run format:check`; expect clean.
**Complete when:** DESIGN.md and the ui08 row describe the shipped page, the evidence note and screenshots exist with the artboard comparison, and the responsive matrix passes.

### Acceptance coverage

| Acceptance criterion | Slice | Verification |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Header: task ID, source chip for imported tasks, title, desired outcome, actions (Execution, Stop… only where #1030 offers it) | 2 | T2 test (a), (6), (9); `operator-task-stop-browser` unchanged |
| Status strip: state badge, readiness and holds, next actor, lead (Updated omitted, Planning decisions) | 1, 2 | T1 `taskColumnOf`/`taskNextActor` cases; T2 test (5) |
| Tabs Overview, Files, Changes, Review, History | 1, 2 | T1 `tabForLocation`; T2 tests (1), (2), (4), (7) |
| Overview: decision card first including the blocking hold line | 3 | T3 test (1) |
| Overview: shared brief, latest result, assignments table, Message lead | 3 | T3 tests (2), (3) |
| Inspector: source sync, holds, dependencies, execution facts, results and artifacts | 1, 3 | T1 `sourceFacts`/`executionFacts`; T3 test (4) |
| Imported tasks separate read-only GitHub content from Ensemble execution | 2, 3 | T2 test (6); T3 test (5) |
| Keep every SPEC.md behaviour and existing tests; update selectors that change; add browser tests | 2, 3 | Named updates in T2 (a)–(e); full affected-file lists in T2 and T3 Validate |
| History updates preserve position, disclosures and replies | 2, 3 | T2 tests (3), (4), (7); existing `operator-task-workspace-browser` and `operator-task-background-refresh-browser` |
| A request stays reachable from every tab | 2 | T2 test (5) |
| `design/DESIGN.md` Implementation status updated in the same change | 4 | T4 doc edits, `format:check` |
| Screenshots at 1366 × 900 and 390 × 844 compared against `03-task-detail` and the phone task artboards | 4 | T4 evidence note and comparison |

### Final validation

- From the worktree root, after `npm ci`, run `npm run check` at the integrated delivery candidate before marking the PR ready; expect type checking, lint, formatting, build and the full suite to pass. CI then runs its profiles (Chromium operator and workspaces shards, WebKit on nightly/manual) and the required `check` context must be green.
- Per-slice commands above are the focused checks; do not rerun the full suite after each slice or repair. Re-run a slice's focused command only when files it covers change.
- The workspace, coordination and delivery browser files in T2 Validate cover task-page selectors the unit tests cannot; run them once at T2 and again only if later slices touch the panel wrappers.

### Review focus

- Independent review of the integrated candidate should check: panels stay mounted (no panel unmounts on tab change) and every anchor, focus and unconfirmed-control path survives a tab switch; `selectTab` is the only writer of the active tab; no request or decision can be hidden by a tab without the strip route; no number, time, identifier or list is shown that a read model does not carry; the Stop… and Execution actions are unchanged from #1030.
- Shared files with in-flight work: `design/DESIGN.md` and `docs/design/ui08-foundation.md` (#1040 edits the "Not yet adopted" bullet and the Inbox rows; PR #1048 for #1032 edits an unrelated `DESIGN.md` hunk; #1043 already merged its own edits there). Edit only the task-detail fragments named in T4 and rebase on whichever merges first. `web/src/wait-reasons.tsx` is consumed through `WaitReasons` with its default output. `web/src/task-views.tsx` takes a one-word `export`; #1042 (W5) edits that file later. `web/src/app.tsx`, `web/src/components.tsx`, `web/src/styles.css`, `web/src/inbox-presentation.ts` and `test/operator/operator-task-overview.test.ts` are deliberately not edited. If the `.task-workspace` base rules in `styles.css` (about lines 985–1060 and 1712–1780) cannot be overridden from `task-detail.css`, the only permitted `styles.css` edit is in those hunks, away from the composer and inbox blocks.

### Allowed deviations

- The shell page header is not changed, so the ID and chip may sit in the strip row. The tonal `--surface` band behind header, strip and tabs may be dropped for a page-ground header with a hairline under the tabs if a CSS-only band needs negative margins into `.page`'s padding.
- Tab-list fit at the narrowest widths (internal horizontal scroll at 360px or below) is a CSS decision, provided the responsive matrix reports no clipping or page scroll.
- A test may use a `?section=` deep link instead of `openTaskTab` when the test is about the section rather than tab navigation.
