nodes.body:
> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Agent Brief

**Category:** enhancement

**Summary:** Keep bounded result evidence inspectable after task files change or the workspace is removed.

**Current behaviour:**
Results retain exact result/assignment/work revision metadata. Image artifacts refer to files in the current ready workspace with hash checks; the bytes are not copied into durable result storage, so later mutation or cleanup can make them unavailable.

**Desired behaviour:**
Preserve bounded copies of result-linked file contents and diffs with exact provenance. Retained result evidence remains distinct from current workspace contents and survives workspace removal, restart and replacement of a latest-turn capture. Store bounded result-linked evidence and reviewed context rather than a complete historical tree. Capture gaps do not reject the result; they record a reason and never cause later bytes to be substituted. Respect existing result-record lifecycle and document storage limits without promising indefinite unlimited storage or adding a new deletion-management UI.

Also retain bounded context for draft and submitted line-review anchors, even when no recorded result exists. Bind exact task/repository/file content, range, diff side and comparison/result/turn context; preserve it independently of latest-turn replacement and workspace cleanup. Later changes yield outdated or unknown/unavailable states, never substituted bytes. This is bounded review-context retention, not a full historical workspace.

**Key interfaces:**
- Result capture and ResultReviewRecord: retain resultId, taskId, assignmentId, workId/workRevision and evidence identity.
- Existing artifact metadata, integrity checks and supplied change metadata: preserve provenance and distinguish supplied claims from observed captures.
- Safe file inspection/capture boundary: shared exclusions and bounded reads.
- Workspace cleanup and retained result reads: evidence lifetime is independent of workspace lifetime and latest-turn capture.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- [ ] Successfully captured text/image/PDF and diff evidence returns the original bytes/content after the source is edited or deleted, the service restarts and the workspace is removed.
- [ ] Every retained item carries exact result/task/assignment/work provenance and capture identity/time; current files cannot masquerade as historical evidence.
- [ ] Latest-turn replacement does not remove a diff/file retained with a result. Retained-result capture can consume the comparison slice's output without requiring whole-workspace copies.
- [ ] Excluded, oversized, changing, missing and failed captures record explicit gaps while the result remains recorded; no retry silently backfills an old result from newer contents.
- [ ] Historical records predating capture remain honest references/unavailable states; no fabricated migration to exact retained evidence.
- [ ] Apply the same task-access, sensitive-path, unsafe-path and preview limits to retained evidence as live inspection; metadata/errors cannot leak excluded contents.
- [ ] Real SQLite/filesystem tests cover persistence, cleanup, replay/idempotency and interrupted capture so there is no falsely available partial record or cross-result substitution. Document bounded storage and cleanup behaviour.

- [ ] Draft and submitted review anchors preserve bounded original text/diff context through file mutation/rename/deletion, latest-turn replacement, restart and workspace cleanup; a result record is not required for a live-file review.
- [ ] Validate task/repository/content/range/side identity and apply existing access/exclusion/size limits; reject cross-task or invalid anchors. Retention failures remain explicit and never backfill newer bytes.
- [ ] Prove changed content produces outdated status when established, while unknown/missing comparison remains distinguishable. Document draft/review retention and cleanup without silently dropping context still referenced by a review.

**Out of scope:**
Full workspace snapshots, indefinite every-turn history, result deletion UI, download/export, backfilling old evidence with current bytes and requalifying unchanged #742 history.

**Authority and validation:**
Chris approved #776's product scope and four delivery slices on 6 October 2026. This brief specifies work; it does not dispatch it, change Project readiness, authorise deployment/cutover or reopen #734. Preserve #742's completed task/evidence behaviour and existing runtime trust/ownership limits. Design and review the Pen interaction/state handoff before UI implementation. Numeric limits, storage and route choices are engineering decisions to document within these bounds; return material scope/guarantee changes for review. Use the pinned Node/package manager, npm ci and npm run check for implementation. The implementation owner performs required automated and bounded live validation; reuse unaffected evidence.


**Approved local code review amendment — 6 October 2026:** Chris authorised the added line-feedback and batched local-review scope. This updates the brief, not dispatch authority. Existing native dependencies and design-review gates remain unchanged.

<!-- to-plan:implementation-plan:v2 -->

**Revision:** 1
**Supersedes:** none
**Replan report:** none

## Implementation plan

**Issue:** https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/issues/781
**Planned against:** `main` at `60da4d05552713d65f999918f7a6b61719bb81b5`
**Publication mode:** Autonomous
**Local state:** Clean
**Epoch closure:** null

### Approach

Retain only file, diff and line-review context selected by a recorded result or review anchor. Capture permitted original bytes through the #779 safe-reader boundary and, for diffs, the exact comparison/side export planned by #780. Store content, hash, origin and an explicit gap manifest in the production SQLite database under immutable result or review identities. Make result acceptance independent of capture success. Serve retained evidence through task-scoped authenticated reads that continue to enforce current access and private-path policy after the workspace is gone. Draft and submitted review anchors use a separate, bounded lifecycle so they need no result and survive latest-turn replacement. No UI, runtime admission change or additional actual-runtime journey belongs to #781.

### Guardrails

- The accepted source is #781's issue and Agent Brief, the #776 inspection scope in `docs/SPEC.md`, and WI03/WI07/WI10/WI11 in `docs/acceptance.md`. #779 is delivered at this base. #780's export, comparison IDs, side hashes/ranges and latest/pending capture are **planned**, not present here. Screen its actual final reviewed merge and tests before starting T1; adjust equivalent names and renew affected checks, or stop for a material contract mismatch. Do not read or integrate the other owner's live implementation checkout. The native dependency remains closed #779; this local implementation prerequisite does not alter GitHub relationships.
- Preserve #742's result, source, supplied `reviewMetadata.changes`, artifact identity, search, feedback and recipient behavior. A supplied diff/file claim remains labelled supplied; it cannot establish observed bytes or an exact comparison. Historical records before this migration remain references or unavailable, without reading current files to backfill them.
- Use #779's task/repository binding, private/control-path, safe no-follow regular-file, hardlink, race and byte checks for capture; do not introduce a weaker reader, a new root, semantic secret scanning, or an independent sandbox. Current task/project/session permission and exclusions govern every retained read; raw paths and error details do not leak excluded material.
- No full workspace or every-turn history, deletion-management UI, file download/export, Pen/UI work, #734/native integration, Haze deployment or cutover. Retention follows result and review records, not workspace or latest-turn lifetime. Automatic quota pressure creates explicit new gaps and never evicts still-referenced original context.
- Continue routine implementation and fixture corrections within unchanged requirements, coverage, architecture and authority; record and renew affected evidence. A factual published-plan mismatch permits one focused diagnosis and two edit/validation cycles. Ordinary repairs do not consume that allowance. Investigate unknown overlap; return material privacy, compatibility, migration or accepted-guarantee changes to the root task. No per-stage human approval is needed inside unchanged scope.
- Implementation owner uses Node `24.21.0`, npm `12.2.0`, `npm ci`, focused checks and `npm run check`; this planner did not run tests or live probes. Reuse unaffected #742/#779/runtime evidence. #780's one actual runtime journey is its own gate and is neither spent nor renewed by this plan.

### Planning decisions

- **Capture and commit ordering.** `StandaloneService`'s `ensemble_report_result` callback is asynchronous around `dispatchCoordinationTool`, while `CoordinationStore.recordResult` commits the result, recipient event and `TaskReviewStore.recordResult` synchronously in one transaction. Prepare a bounded, immutable candidate from the exact bound task/work/turn before that call; pass it as optional evidence to the result transaction. The transaction either stores the accepted result plus its complete manifest/bytes/gaps or stores neither. A permitted capture failure becomes a gap, not a rejected result. Exact callback/receipt replay reads its committed manifest and never performs another workspace capture. A rejected or stale result discards the candidate. Never hold the SQLite write transaction over filesystem or Git awaits. If a process dies while preparing, no result has been accepted; if it dies after commit, only a complete manifest is visible.
- **Result selection.** Candidate paths come from result-linked artifact file references and supplied change-file references, within explicit caps; the observed diff comes only from a compatible exact #780 comparison/export bound to the same task/repository/work/turn observation. If it is missing, unsettled, too large or cannot establish both original sides, record a diff gap. A supplied literal diff stays available only as its existing supplied claim. Results without eligible links retain a truthful empty selection. Capture time and the source observation/side hash are recorded; do not imply bytes represent terminal state or that a reporting callback stops later writes.
- **Storage and cleanup.** Use SQLite BLOBs in `standalone.sqlite`, covered by the existing offline backup/restore and owner lock; `src/standalone/operations.ts` already hashes SQLite BLOBs. Initial engineering caps: #779's 1 MiB text and 8 MiB image/PDF per file, 1 MiB serialized observed diff, at most 32 selected files and 32 MiB retained payload per result, 128 MiB result payload per task and 512 MiB retained payload per installation. Review context is a selected bounded original line span with line-offset/side/hash metadata, at most 256 KiB per anchor, 128 anchors and 16 MiB per task, subject to the same 512 MiB installation pool. Enforce quotas transactionally from counted stored byte lengths, not process-local counters. On limit, persist `too-large`/`quota` gaps for new items; no truncation presented as exact, no eviction of existing referenced bytes. SQLite file/WAL overhead can exceed logical payload caps; document it. Workspace archive removes no retained rows. If a future owner lifecycle deletes a result/review, delete only its unreferenced payloads transactionally with foreign keys; no new deletion action is introduced. A draft anchor stays while its draft exists; submission moves/links that exact context to the submitted review before draft cleanup, and submitted context stays with its review. Explicit draft discard may release unreferenced draft context; neither refresh nor quota maintenance silently does so.
- **Anchor identity and status.** Server-generated immutable context IDs bind task, repository or repository-free scope, normalized path, selected original content hash, exact line/range and diff side, plus comparison ID and result/turn IDs when applicable. Validate side-specific line existence against the original captured bytes and reject mismatched task/repository, malformed/empty/reversed/out-of-bounds ranges, forged side hashes and changed binding; never accept path/line alone as proof. Store a bounded original excerpt and line map independently of a result. Rechecking a currently accessible exact path with a different hash or a known rename/deletion marks the anchor `outdated`; matching hash is `current`; an absent safe comparison is `unknown` or `unavailable` as appropriate. Preserve original bytes in all states. No automatic retargeting after rename or latest-turn replacement.
- **No independent parallel slice yet.** A new store file by itself would depend on invented #780 export semantics, and the safe-reader, result callback, task-review store and HTTP contract share the same ownership/data boundary. None has a disjoint executable path, resource and acceptance check at `60da4d0`. Start the ordered graph after #780's reviewed merge/seam screening; independent final audit may read the integrated candidate.

### Implementation context

- **Existing:** `src/standalone/workspace-inspection.ts` (`previewWorkspaceFile`, binding/exclusion/byte checks) owns #779's current safe inspection; `src/standalone/operator-api.ts` (`workspaceInspectionCurrent`, `readWorkspacePreview`, `readArtifact`, `readReview`) and `src/standalone/operator-web.ts` route authenticated task reads and recheck visibility after awaits. `src/operator/contracts.ts` validates response envelopes.
- **Existing:** `src/standalone/service.ts` handles the bound runtime callback and `dispatchCoordinationTool`; `src/standalone/coordination-tools.ts` invokes `CoordinationStore.recordResult`. `src/core/coordination.ts` commits the result, recipient and review metadata atomically, with an exact callback receipt/replay path. `src/core/task-review.ts` owns `ResultReviewRecord`, artifact IDs, source references and supplied change metadata. `src/standalone/task-review.ts` previews existing PNG/JPEG references from the current ready workspace and rejects hash mismatch; it is not durable byte storage.
- **Existing:** `src/standalone/workspaces.ts` (`archiveAndCleanup`) deletes managed workspace files after preservation checks; result records live in `standalone.sqlite` under `src/core/store.ts`/`src/standalone/data-directory.ts`. `src/standalone/operations.ts` backup/verify/restore hashes SQLite BLOBs and must be exercised with the new tables.
- **Planned integration:** #780's `workspace-comparison.ts`, `comparison-store.ts`, comparison ID/side/range export and service/operator wiring exist only in its published plan at https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/issues/780#issuecomment-6050732630. Screen the delivered types and lifetime before implementing result diff or review anchors; do not import unmerged names at this base.
- **New:** `src/standalone/retained-evidence.ts` will adapt the safe byte reader and exact #780 export to bounded capture candidates; `src/core/retained-evidence.ts` will own schemas, SQLite manifest/BLOB/quota/ref lifecycle and exact task/result/review lookup. Name changes are routine only if the same boundaries remain. `test/retained-evidence-store.test.ts`, `test/retained-result-service.test.ts`, `test/operator-retained-evidence.test.ts`, `test/review-anchor-retention.test.ts` are focused real SQLite/filesystem/service/HTTP seams; follow `test/task-review-service.test.ts`, `test/operator-task-review.test.ts`, `test/operator-workspace-inspection.test.ts` and `test/workspaces.test.ts` fixtures.

### Implementation slices

**Task graph and parallelism:** `T1 -> T2 -> T3 -> T4 -> T5` is acyclic. T1–T4 share retention schema, guarded capture and task-scoped API contracts and run sequentially in one implementation checkout after the #780 gate. T5 independently audits the integrated final diff; it does not write implementation code. No separate PR is required by the graph.

#### 1. Exact bounded capture and transactional result lifetime

**Task ID:** `T1`
**Depends on:** `none`
**Prerequisites:** Root verifies #780's final reviewed merge on the implementation base, screens actual exact comparison/export IDs, side/range hash and capture lifetime, and records compatible integration evidence. No live runtime invocation.
**Files and symbols:** `src/standalone/retained-evidence.ts` capture candidate; `src/core/retained-evidence.ts` durable store; `src/core/store.ts` SQLite value typing only if needed for BLOB binding; `src/core/coordination.ts:recordResult`, `src/standalone/service.ts` callback, `src/standalone/coordination-tools.ts` dispatch; `src/core/task-review.ts` result association; affected #780 comparison export and #779 reader only to expose the same guarded primitives. `test/retained-evidence-store.test.ts`, `test/retained-result-service.test.ts`.
**Test:** Real SQLite and temporary repository/repository-free workspaces: report a result linked to UTF-8 text, PNG, PDF and two-sided diff; mutate/delete source, replace latest-turn capture, close/reopen database and archive/remove workspace. Assert exact original bytes, hashes, source observation and result/task/assignment/work/workRevision/capture IDs/times. Exercise supplied `changes.diff` with contradictory observed diff and verify source labels. Inject missing, excluded, unsafe, symlink/hardlink, oversized, changing and failed reads, diff export loss, per-result/task/global quota, crash points before candidate, before commit and after commit; assert result acceptance with complete gaps, no partial `available` row, no newer-byte replay/backfill and no cross-result substitution. Verify rejected callback commits neither candidate nor result; exact replay returns original receipt/manifest and ignores changed files.
**Implementation:** Capture only eligible linked candidates under #779 path/byte and #780 exact comparison guards before calling the synchronous result transaction. Revalidate bound work/task/repository/source identity after awaits and inside commit; persist typed manifest and bytes or exact gap reason with per-item capture ID/time/hash. Enforce quota and all foreign-key/identity checks in the same transaction as result acceptance. Read exact IDs from storage, never a current pathname. Preserve existing metadata/search/artifact records and service terminal/hold decisions. Document the persisted limit/lifetime in `docs/SPEC.md` alongside #779 and WI07.
**Validate:** From repository root after `npm ci` with pinned Node/npm, run `npm run build:service && node --test dist/test/retained-evidence-store.test.js dist/test/retained-result-service.test.js dist/test/task-review-service.test.js`; expect all exact/replay/interruption fixtures and unchanged result behavior to pass. Hold T2 if transactional or privacy boundary cases fail.
**Complete when:** Accepted results have one immutable, bounded, restart-safe manifest of available bytes and explicit gaps; result capture failure does not reject the result.

#### 2. Draft/submitted review anchor context independent of results

**Task ID:** `T2`
**Depends on:** `T1`
**Prerequisites:** T1's transactional, safety and replay checks pass; actual #780 side/range context is available.
**Files and symbols:** `src/core/retained-evidence.ts` review-context/draft-reference tables and transitions; `src/standalone/retained-evidence.ts` safe original text/diff excerpt capture; `src/standalone/service.ts` task-bound staging/sealing methods for later #782 review delivery; `src/operator/contracts.ts` anchor input/output schemas; `test/review-anchor-retention.test.ts`, affected `test/retained-evidence-store.test.ts`.
**Test:** With no result record, create draft anchors from current text and both #780 diff sides (single, range, deleted and renamed), retain their original excerpt/context after edit/rename/delete, latest-turn replacement, restart and workspace removal, then seal the same IDs as submitted review context and discard the draft. Assert immutable bytes and review association survive. Reject foreign task/repository/comparison/result/turn IDs, wrong side/hash, invalid or excluded ranges, changing file/binding and stale client claims; record explicit failed retention without loading newer bytes. Test repeated operation IDs with same/different material, interrupted staging/sealing, quota failure and draft discard; no orphan available payload, duplicate submission context or lost submitted reference. A result ID is optional only for genuine live-file context.
**Implementation:** Add an exact server-side anchor capture API with bounded original excerpt plus line offsets, source identity and optional comparison/result/turn context. Stage and seal context by immutable IDs and payload hash in SQLite transactions; allow explicitly discarded draft context to be reclaimed only when unreferenced. Keep submitted review-context rows available for #782's later batch delivery and never infer a review delivery/receipt in this slice. Implement the `current`/`outdated`/`unknown`/`unavailable` status discriminator without changing stored original context. Document review context and cleanup in `docs/SPEC.md`.
**Validate:** From repository root after T1 setup, run `npm run build:service && node --test dist/test/review-anchor-retention.test.js dist/test/retained-evidence-store.test.js`; expect no-result draft, submitted lifecycle, side/range rejection and restart/cleanup cases to pass. Hold T3 on any identity or referenced-context loss.
**Complete when:** The server can durably stage and seal exact bounded review context without a result, preserving referenced original bytes through all named changes.

#### 3. Authenticated retained reads and current policy

**Task ID:** `T3`
**Depends on:** `T2`
**Prerequisites:** T1–T2 store/capture checks pass.
**Files and symbols:** `src/standalone/operator-api.ts` task-scoped retained result/review reads, `src/standalone/operator-web.ts` exact-ID GET routing and known API, `src/operator/contracts.ts` availability/provenance/gap response schemas, `src/standalone/task-review.ts` artifact resolution only where the retained path supersedes the old workspace reference; `test/operator-retained-evidence.test.ts`, affected `test/operator-task-review.test.ts` and `test/operator-workspace-inspection.test.ts`.
**Test:** Authenticated HTTP against real SQLite with the workspace present/removed: exact result and anchor IDs return original typed bytes/context, observed/supplied labels, provenance and explicit gap/status. Wrong task/repository/result/anchor ID, logout, expiry, task/project access change, new private exclusion, control-path addition or visibility change during an awaited read return no bytes or sensitive metadata; exclusion applies even if bytes were captured before policy changed. Verify pre-capture historical result shows reference/unavailable, excluded-path requests have uniform empty/error shape before availability, and retained HTML/text remains inert JSON with existing image/PDF preview limits. Assert GETs do not mutate work, holds, results or latest-turn slots.
**Implementation:** Resolve task/project/session and current exclusions before and after awaited work; query immutable storage by exact IDs and revalidate policy immediately before response. Permit retained reads after workspace cleanup through the original stored task/repository identity and current access policy, with no new filesystem root or fallback to current files. Preserve old artifact behavior for legacy records while clearly marking unavailable when the workspace no longer provides matching bytes; route newly captured artifacts to their durable bytes. Add task-scoped read schemas and bounded server routes only; #782 owns presentation and review send UI.
**Validate:** From repository root after T2 setup, run `npm run build:service && node --test dist/test/operator-retained-evidence.test.js dist/test/operator-task-review.test.js dist/test/operator-workspace-inspection.test.js`; expect authenticated policy/race tests and existing artifact/inspection tests to pass. Hold T4 on any sensitive-byte or cross-task disclosure.
**Complete when:** Task-scoped retained reads remain exact and policy-safe across restart/workspace removal, including truthful legacy and missing states.

#### 4. Integrated persistence, cleanup and documentation evidence

**Task ID:** `T4`
**Depends on:** `T3`
**Prerequisites:** Focused T1–T3 cases pass.
**Files and symbols:** `test/retained-evidence-integration.test.ts` for the combined production service/SQLite/HTTP and offline backup/restore journey; affected `test/workspaces.test.ts` and `test/operator-web-http.test.ts`; `docs/SPEC.md`, `docs/acceptance.md` WI03/WI07/WI10/WI11 evidence note, and `docs/operations/standalone-macos.md` backup/storage limit note; `src/standalone/operations.ts` only if backup/restore verification reveals a real BLOB/schema incompatibility.
**Test:** One deterministic production-service journey records linked result files/diff, drafts a no-result two-side review, seals its submitted context, mutates/renames/deletes files, replaces latest capture, archives workspace, restarts service and reads all exact IDs through authenticated HTTP. Inject interrupted capture and interrupted review seal at SQLite commit boundaries and replay same operation after restart. Run offline backup/verify/restore to a disposable data root containing captured BLOBs and check hashes/foreign keys/readback; remove all fixture roots. Check logical quota exhaustion records gaps without deleting referenced bytes or blocking result. Assert no #742 result/history, service hold or #780 latest/pending behavior regresses.
**Implementation:** Finish docs with per-item/result/task/installation logical limits, WAL/disk overhead, archive independence, explicit gaps, draft discard and submitted lifetime. Record exact passing fixture IDs and any accepted limits under WI07/WI11; do not mark UI scenarios complete. Repair only interactions shown by this combined check.
**Validate:** From repository root after `npm ci`, run `npm run build:service && node --test dist/test/retained-evidence-integration.test.js`; expect matching restored hashes, retained HTTP readback and cleaned disposable roots. Then run `npm run check` and `git diff --check` as separate commands; expect pinned typecheck, lint, formatting, build and full tests green with no diff whitespace errors. No new actual-runtime run is required by #781; if the changed #780 hook fails its own gate, report the concrete integration gap without inventing a second journey.
**Complete when:** Production paths, backup/restore and cleanup pass with named deterministic evidence, final checks pass, and the docs distinguish implemented server retention from pending #782 UI.

#### 5. Independent integrated review and final acceptance

**Task ID:** `T5`
**Depends on:** `T4`
**Prerequisites:** T4 integrated checks and full `npm run check` pass on the implementation candidate.
**Files and symbols:** Read-only final diff across T1–T4 and final changed-path inventory; no owned source edits. Original implementation owner repairs findings and renews only affected checks/review.
**Test:** Review against every #781 Agent Brief criterion, the #779 private/task boundary, delivered #780 export/lifetime, #742 result/replay semantics, schema/backup compatibility and quota/ref cleanup. Seek concrete counterexamples for newer-byte backfill, side/range forgery, partial availability, access change after workspace removal, submitted-context loss and old-record fabrication.
**Validate:** From repository root, inspect final `git diff --check`, `npm run check` evidence and focused fixture output at the same candidate HEAD; expect a `ship` verdict with no unresolved material finding. After any repair that affects checked behavior, rerun its focused checks and final applicable gate, then review affected changes. The root task accepts the integrated delivery.
**Complete when:** Final candidate and evidence meet the accepted contract with any remaining limitations named for #782 handoff.

### Acceptance coverage

| Acceptance criterion | Slice | Verification |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Original text/image/PDF and observed diff after edit/delete, restart, workspace removal and latest-turn replacement | T1, T4 | Real SQLite/file/comparison lifecycle and authenticated integrated read |
| Exact result/task/assignment/work revision, observation/capture identity/time and no current-file masquerade | T1, T3 | Result manifest foreign-key/receipt fixture and exact-ID HTTP read |
| Consume bounded #780 comparison output without a tree copy | T1, T4 | Delivered export seam screen, two-sided diff fixture and replacement read |
| Excluded/oversized/changing/missing/failed capture gaps while result records; no backfill | T1, T4 | Fault/quota/replay/crash matrix |
| Legacy records honest; supplied claims stay separate | T1, T3 | Pre-migration result and contradictory supplied/observed fixture |
| Current access, sensitive/unsafe paths, preview limits and no metadata leak | T1, T3 | #779 race/path cases plus authenticated visibility/exclusion change |
| Production SQLite/filesystem persistence, cleanup, replay/idempotency, interrupted capture and bounded storage docs | T1, T4 | Transaction crash cases, offline backup/restore, quota/cleanup checks |
| No-result draft and submitted review context survives changes, replacement, restart and cleanup | T2, T4 | Anchor lifecycle fixture including draft discard after submission |
| Exact task/repository/content/range/side/comparison/result/turn validity and explicit failure | T2, T3 | Invalid/cross-task/side-hash and exclusion fixtures |
| Established change outdated, absent comparison unknown/unavailable, no newer substitution | T2–T4 | Status matrix and immutable excerpt readback |

### Final validation

- All commands run from the repository root in the **implementation** checkout with Node `24.21.0` and npm `12.2.0`; `npm ci` precedes the named focused tests and `npm run check`. Record command, candidate SHA, pass/fail counts, fixture cleanup and actual #780 integration commit. This planning checkout remains source-untouched.
- Require reviewed #780 merged-seam screening before T1 and renew any affected #780 checks after integration. Reuse unchanged #742/#779 evidence. #781 qualifies server retention through real SQLite/filesystem/replay/interrupted cases; there is no new live-runtime or UI gate here. #782 later owns UI entry points, draft/send presentation, desktop/phone/keyboard checks and integration with the server context IDs; do not claim them complete from #781.
- After final review, root checks the diff and validation evidence, publishes/accepts the authorized delivery and reports any exact #782 handoff gap. Workspace cleanup and reverse draft discard are covered; result deletion UI is intentionally absent, and retained bytes follow existing result records under the documented caps.

### Review focus

- Race between pre-commit filesystem/comparison observation and exact result binding; receipt replay must not recapture. Partial BLOB/manifest writes and quota accounting must never appear available after interrupted transactions.
- Retained bytes may outlive their workspace but never their current task access/private-path policy. Ensure exact-ID HTTP reads do not reveal excluded paths/content through metadata or error differences.
- Review anchor side/range/context identity and reference transitions; submitted context must not depend on a latest-turn slot, a surviving draft or a result record.

content.title: Workspace inspection: Integrate and qualify desktop and phone journeys

nodes.body:
> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Agent Brief

**Category:** enhancement

**Summary:** Deliver the production Files and Changes experience connected to exact task/result evidence.

**Current behaviour:**
Task detail already offers exact-result selection, supplied change metadata, image evidence and contextual feedback. There is no general file browser or Branch/Last turn/Uncommitted comparison dropdown.

**Desired behaviour:**
Design and review the desktop/phone interaction and state handoff in Pen, then integrate safe file previews, comparison selection and retained result evidence in the existing task UI. Code review and generated outputs have equal weight. Keep the displayed read stable until explicit refresh; show observation time, baseline and known changes without pausing agents. Current workspace, latest-turn observations and retained result evidence must remain distinguishable. Preserve existing reading, reply, feedback, navigation, auth and recovery behaviour.

Add a task-scoped local code-review draft: select single lines or ranges in text previews or either diff side (including deleted lines), collect comments across files, edit/remove comments and add an optional summary. Show the complete draft and named project-lead destination before Send review. Persist and deliver the batch as one logical review using existing local message permissions, exact anchors and idempotent submission/reconciliation. Preserve drafts under existing session/privacy rules and show original/outdated/unavailable context. This slice owns both draft/submission service behaviour and the UI; #780 supplies diff anchors and #781 retained context.

**Key interfaces:**
- TaskRead, task workspace sections, Changes and Artifact views: integrate shared inspection reads without duplicating result/delivery policy.
- Result/assignment/work identity and exact historical selection: preserve anchors when opening or returning from inspection.
- Shared desktop/phone navigation and operator session policy: preserve auth expiry and contextual navigation.
- Safe inspection, comparison and retained-result contracts from the sibling slices.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- [ ] Reviewed Pen handoff covers desktop/phone Files and Changes, comparison dropdown, repository/base selection, result evidence and empty/loading/failure/oversized/unavailable/unsettled states before UI implementation.
- [ ] Production UI supports text/code/Markdown, raster and PDF previews and unsupported metadata, with no download/export affordance; ignored reveal cannot bypass exclusions.
- [ ] Dropdown offers Branch, Last turn and Uncommitted with staged/unstaged filters; exact repository/baseline/turn/result identity and observation time are readable.
- [ ] Repository-free work supports files and turn capture while Git targets are unavailable; multiple repositories retain separate baselines.
- [ ] Reading remains stable while agents work. Explicit refresh preserves selection/reading position where valid and labels changed/missing contents; it neither pauses work nor clears holds.
- [ ] Opening from task/result/evidence and direct links preserves exact historical/current context and return navigation, disclosures and unfinished replies. Verify applicable Overview, Inbox, List/Board and retained advanced routes; document absent context-menu/extension/notification entry points rather than adding them.
- [ ] Keyboard and desktop/phone browser journeys cover long files/diffs, preview failures, workspace removal, auth expiry and restored historical evidence. Existing contextual feedback retains exact result anchors.
- [ ] Run production service/browser tests with real SQLite/filesystem/Git fixtures and the bounded actual-runtime turn-capture journey after deterministic checks. Record source/runtime, captures, limits and task-owned cleanup; keep unknown outcomes and holds explicit.
- [ ] Complete integrated usability review and evidence for the approved scenarios; do not count static Pen review as implementation or live-runtime evidence.

- [ ] Reviewed Pen handoff and desktop/phone/keyboard journeys cover line/range selection, deleted-line comments, multi-file draft, edit/remove, optional summary, review-before-send and sent receipt.
- [ ] Authenticated service validates every anchor and delivers one logical review with exact comments/summary to the task's accountable lead; partial delivery cannot masquerade as a complete review.
- [ ] Confirmed failure preserves editable draft; unknown outcome retains original payload/key for reconciliation. Duplicate retries create no duplicate review and changed payload under an existing key is rejected.
- [ ] Navigation/refresh preserves draft content and anchors within session/privacy rules; changed/renamed/deleted files show outdated or unavailable original context without silent retargeting.
- [ ] Prove zero GitHub publication and no review-induced approval, readiness/completion change, merge authority or hold release. Keep existing contextual feedback intact.
- [ ] Submitted reviews remain inspectable local feedback; editing/removing drafts does not retract submitted feedback. Formal verdicts, submitted-review retraction and threaded resolution are outside scope.

**Out of scope:**
Workspace file editing, terminals, downloads, native desktop/ChatGPT integration, arbitrary revision browsing, production cutover, reopening #742 acceptance and unrelated navigation features.

**Authority and validation:**
Chris approved #776's product scope and four delivery slices on 6 October 2026. This brief specifies work; it does not dispatch it, change Project readiness, authorise deployment/cutover or reopen #734. Preserve #742's completed task/evidence behaviour and existing runtime trust/ownership limits. Design and review the Pen interaction/state handoff before UI implementation. Numeric limits, storage and route choices are engineering decisions to document within these bounds; return material scope/guarantee changes for review. Use the pinned Node/package manager, npm ci and npm run check for implementation. The implementation owner performs required automated and bounded live validation; reuse unaffected evidence.


**Approved local code review amendment — 6 October 2026:** Chris authorised the added line-feedback and batched local-review scope. This updates the brief, not dispatch authority. Existing native dependencies and design-review gates remain unchanged.

<!-- to-plan:implementation-plan:v2 -->

**Revision:** 1
**Supersedes:** none
**Replan report:** none

## Implementation plan

**Issue:** https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/issues/782
**Planned against:** `main` at `35097915ff32706df490bda595a4512779d658d3`
**Publication mode:** Autonomous
**Local state:** Clean
**Epoch closure:** null

### Approach

Consume the accepted #793 Pen handoff as the interaction contract and the merged #779–#781 service seams as the data contract. Add an authenticated, durable task-scoped local review operation that binds exact retained anchors to one accountable-lead inbox event and receipt. Then build Files, Changes, retained evidence and review surfaces inside the production React task workspace, preserving exact navigation and the existing single-message feedback. Qualify server boundaries with real SQLite/filesystem/Git fixtures, browser interactions on desktop/phone/keyboard, and a separately granted bounded actual Codex runtime journey. Record WI01–WI13 results and limits in the existing evidence documentation.

### Guardrails

- The [#782 Agent Brief](https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/issues/782#issuecomment-6014085645), [SPEC workspace contract](https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/blob/35097915ff32706df490bda595a4512779d658d3/docs/SPEC.md#task-workspace-inspection--approved-post-mvp-scope-6-october-2026), [WI01–WI13](https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/blob/35097915ff32706df490bda595a4512779d658d3/docs/acceptance.md#post-mvp-task-workspace-inspection), and [reviewed #793 handoff](https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/blob/70ee69d5078f15da4508d30e902c072a6d7020be/design/DESIGN.md#workspace-inspection-and-local-review--7-october-2026) govern scope. Canvas node IDs are references, not proof of implemented behavior. Preserve the parameterised composer anchor from the actual current file, comparison side or retained evidence; never use a specimen's prefilled values for another origin. Apply the final visual follow-up: one-line explorer filename elision with full path disclosure; 24px phone source rows and 44px controls.
- Files and generated outputs have equal reading and review status. Keep current, latest actual turn and retained result evidence distinct. Existing service exclusions and task/repository binding govern all reads, staging and retained displays; ignored reveal never reveals excluded material. Do not add downloads, export, editing, terminal, arbitrary revisions, older-turn browsing, formal verdicts, submitted-review retraction or threaded resolution.
- One review is local feedback to the named accountable project lead through existing message permissions. It cannot call GitHub or change approval, readiness, completion, merge authority or holds. Keep the existing contextual single-message reply separate and working. An anchor is the original task/root/repository/path, exact content hash and line range, plus comparison side/ID or result/turn identity where applicable; a later path/line match never silently retargets it.
- Preserve #742 exact task/result/evidence behavior and accepted finite S01 runtime trust/ownership and recovery limits. #734 native visibility/ChatGPT work, Haze prototype, deployment/cutover and unrelated #800 UI refinements remain outside this slice. Do not reopen unchanged acceptance or #742 qualification.
- For actual-runtime work, implementation must first pass deterministic checks, then present the exact disposable fixture, command/hash, finite turn/attempt budget, runtime/login/policy, assertions, stop/shutdown and cleanup/hold plan to the root for its scoped grant. #780's one used live journey is reusable evidence only for the observed actual-turn portion of WI06; it is not a #782 grant or whole WI06/UI qualification. No second attempt or extra turn outside the reviewed grant. Preserve unknown outcomes and held fixtures; never delete an uncertain owner as cleanup.
- Continue routine implementation, fixture, documentation and CI repairs within unchanged requirements, coverage, architecture and authority; record them in the delivery record and renew affected evidence without per-stage human permission. A wrong factual plan seam or repository assumption permits one focused diagnosis and at most two edit/validation cycles; ordinary repairs do not consume that budget. Investigate unknown overlap. Return material scope, privacy/permission policy, qualification-grant, irreversible migration or architecture changes to the root. Reuse valid checks and reviews; an integration amendment is only for a changed published integration decision requiring durable consumption.

### Planning decisions

- Use the existing `GET /api/operator/tasks/:id/files`, `/preview`, `/comparisons`, `/results/:resultId/evidence`, and `/review-anchors/:anchorId` responses. They already validate external data and carry observation, comparison, retained-byte and gap states. Present stored comparison IDs through their exact-ID read route until explicit refresh; no frontend reconstruction of Git history or reads directly from the filesystem. Repository-free Files/Last turn remain available when Git targets are not.
- Persist editable review drafts in SQLite under task plus an opaque server-side authenticated session identity/epoch, with bounded size/lifetime and cleanup. `OperatorAuth` keeps sessions in memory and exposes an internal ID; derive an opaque owner key without persisting or exposing the raw cookie or CSRF token. Navigation, Refresh and browser reload within that live authorised session restore the draft. Expiry/sign-out/access change and service restart invalidate the old editable owner; purge client state and disclose unsent-draft loss on reauthentication rather than revealing it to a new session. Recorded frozen/sent operations survive this purge for current-policy authenticated reconciliation. Do not copy private excerpts into browser local storage.
- Public boundary: authenticated `GET /api/operator/tasks/:id/review-draft` returns only the current session's editable draft/version and anchor statuses; `GET /api/operator/tasks/:id/local-reviews/:operationId` returns a current-policy-filtered `not-recorded-or-unsettled`, `rejected-no-delivery` or `recorded` status, with immutable batch/receipt context when recorded. Strict `POST /api/operator/commands` variants `review.anchor.stage`, `review.draft.save`, `review.draft.discard`, and `review.send` carry UUID idempotency keys. Save/discard carry expected draft version; Send carries frozen draft version, ordered exact anchor IDs, comment text, optional summary, named lead assignment ID/version and payload identity. Route names may be adjusted mechanically with one coherent contract, but the read/state transitions and exact identities are required. Document finite numeric comment count, each comment/summary and whole serialized payload bounds compatible with the existing local-message delivery size; reject an oversized batch before anchor seal or event creation as a confirmed no-delivery failure that retains all editable text. Never truncate or send a partial review. A confirmed terminal no-delivery rejection leaves the draft editable; an absent receipt after transport loss is still unknown because the request may commit later. Keep its original key/payload frozen and only retry that exact material or reconcile until recorded or definitively rejected; edits then require a new key. Same key with different material is a conflict.
- The #781 anchor stage/seal/discard operations are storage primitives and explicitly report delivery `not-attempted`; `CoordinationStore.postOperatorMessage` atomically writes an inbox event and idempotent receipt for ordinary feedback. It also calls `recordRecoveryContinuation`, which can complete an operator-reconciled held delivery batch. Local review must deliberately omit that side effect while sharing the existing recipient/version checks, event and receipt semantics; ordinary message recovery behavior stays unchanged. The review send transaction owns immutable ordered comments/summary, exact anchor refs/seal, one local inbox event and one idempotent receipt. No nested `BEGIN` or asynchronous FS/policy read inside that write transaction: capture/recheck policy before it, then rederive exact session/task/lead/draft version/anchor identities at commit. Replay the original operation before mutable draft/recipient checks, subject to current read access. A sealed context without its event must never appear sent. Removing an editable draft cannot delete submitted context.
- A native browser PDF embed risks exposing its own download control. Use pinned `pdfjs-dist` to render the service's bounded PDF bytes into app-owned canvas pages, without browser PDF toolbar or export affordance; render Markdown as inert content with a Source line view and raster with bounded fit/zoom/pan. `pdfjs-dist` is not in the current package lock, so T3 begins with a focused compatibility proof: install/pin a compatible release, build the Vite/TypeScript bundle and render a small synthetic PDF in production Chromium with no remote fetch, worker failure or download control. If that proof fails, stop dependent PDF UI and return the concrete compatibility finding for root architecture review before choosing a different renderer. No new service trust boundary is implied.
- Use one integrated delivery candidate and one independent review covering service, browser and runtime behavior. Earlier boundary checks in T1/T2 gate dependent UI/send work; a failed persistence/privacy or atomic-send check returns to its owning slice before proceeding. A focused repair review follows changes, then final exact-head checks and findings disposition.

### Implementation context

- **Existing service reads:** `src/standalone/workspace-inspection.ts` owns safe bounded listing/preview and exclusions; `workspace-comparison.ts` and `comparison-store.ts` own Branch/Uncommitted/actual Last turn and exact IDs; `retained-evidence.ts` and `src/core/retained-evidence.ts` own result bytes, immutable anchor capture and stage/seal/discard. `src/standalone/operator-api.ts:readWorkspaceDirectory/readWorkspacePreview/readWorkspaceComparison/readRetainedResultEvidence/readRetainedEvidenceItem/readRetainedReviewAnchor` and `operator-web.ts:read` expose authenticated routes; `src/operator/contracts.ts` validates their envelopes.
- **Existing delivery:** `src/core/coordination.ts:postOperatorMessage` checks recipient assignment/version, local feedback reference and replay, then records a single event/receipt transaction; its `recordRecoveryContinuation` side effect can settle an operator-reconciled held batch and must not occur for a review. `src/standalone/operator-api.ts:command` and `src/operator/contracts.ts:operatorCommandSchema/commandReceiptSchema` expose operator commands. `src/standalone/service.ts:stageReviewAnchorDraft/sealReviewAnchorDraft/discardReviewAnchorDraft` supply independently persisted anchor context but no delivery. It does not depend on the native runtime, and putting it in the live journey would depend on the model not reporting a result early. The live journey therefore covers only native turn behaviour (WI06/WI07) plus the production UI reading it.

**Guarded entry:** `test/wi782/live-inspection-journey.mjs`, SHA-256 `74f2f29e8e567fb6a6e77f57c93cadc496027437e083513ed92edf286ca56e83`, at PR #810 head `3b39dae0`. It refuses unless invoked exactly as:
`ENSEMBLE_WI782_CODEX_SHA256=<launcher sha256> node test/wi782/live-inspection-journey.mjs --live --three-turns`

**Journey** (one disposable repository-free task, one service lifetime, one Codex process, at most 3 `Runtime.startTurn` calls, single attempt):
1. T1: the lead's initial turn writes `marker-1.txt` and reports R1.
2. T2: an operator-created assignment on the same task overwrites `marker-1.txt`, writes `marker-2.txt` and reports. C2 replaces C1, and R1 keeps its original bytes.
3. T3: a third assignment writes `marker-3.txt`, runs `sleep 900` and is stopped once started. It is expected to leave an interrupted capture and a Stop hold.

**Then:** authenticated HTTP reads and a Chromium pass at 1366 and 390 widths with screenshots, verified same-boot exit of the exact Codex process, and a read-only SQLite reopen.

**Controls:**
- Preflight as in #780 (launcher hash, chatgpt account, approval `never`, sandbox `workspace-write`, project paused).
- Starts are matched to planned work; a 4th or unplanned start (e.g. an automatic repair) is refused before the runtime and ends the journey.
- `resumeTask` is never called.
- The fixture is always retained with its hold, never deleted.

**Deadlines:** 1,200 s total, plus per-phase budgets.

**Outcomes:** model deviations become unproved rows. No retry or second attempt is allowed.

**Status:** built and tested offline only (`inspection-journey-harness.test.ts`). Not run, and not authorised until Chris grants this exact entry and command.

Delivered in #810 (merged as 3067db0c) and #830 (merged as 6fc9749f). Evidence: deterministic suites, plus one granted live journey that passed (see the T8 amendment comment and `docs/evidence/wi01-wi13-workspace-review.md`). Feedback to a completed lead continues in #828.
