> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Agent Brief

**Category:** enhancement  
**Summary:** Refine existing operator layouts and interactions, with a revised and reviewed Pen handoff before UI implementation.

### Current behaviour and verification

The operator already has a Dark / Neutral / Default shadcn foundation, Inter and JetBrains Mono, shared controls, an attention overview, List/Board, Inbox, task detail, Search and a local task composer. This request is not already implemented.

Triage inspected the shared task rows/cards, navigation shell and mobile drawer, composer input/validation and command lifecycle, structured-question presentation, shared control styles/tokens, the retained-HTML inventory, the product glossary, accepted React/runtime ADRs and UX acceptance. Optional composer inputs remain expanded; narrow task rows retain competing fixed minimum columns; shared controls suppress outlines in favour of shadows; answer inputs remain fixed-size; question scrolling and submit padding retain the reviewed defects.

HEAD remains `a2f0af26b76b3e8b70b8f9d72ec01d17ac30cdfa`, matching the earlier populated production-bundle review. Reuse its confirmed tablet-collapse, scroll-chaining and long-answer observations and passing build. The inset override and focus fallback remain source-confirmed risks; physical notched-device, virtual-keyboard and forced-colours results are not established. No full repository check is claimed from triage.

No prior rejection records were found; the repository has no out-of-scope knowledge-base directory. The scope was grilled and confirmed with Chris on 7 October 2026. No unresolved product decision requires another scope interview.

### Desired behaviour

- Keep task lists compact and title-led while giving task detail, questions and evidence comfortable reading space. Distinguish work state, next actor and operator attention; retain quieter project/lead/source/provenance metadata and truthful unknown/stale/failed/cancelled/undelivered states.
- Retain the existing dark neutral visual foundation and fonts; refine shared typography, spacing, surfaces, radii and restrained interaction feedback.
- Collapse navigation into the existing drawer before it crowds the content. Rows, filters, Inbox queue/detail and forms adapt to available width. Preserve intentional Board/evidence scrolling while eliminating unintended clipping, overlap and letter-per-line columns.
- Keep visible keyboard focus, including in forced colours, and preserve drawer trapping, Escape and focus return. Independent scrollers avoid unintended page chaining; short-viewport and bottom actions remain reachable with effective safe-area padding. Preserve existing phone touch-target sizing and reduced-motion behaviour.
- Let answer/outcome/context textareas grow within useful bounds, then scroll internally. Safari/WebKit and Chromium retain usable fallbacks; resizing preserves input, selection and caret.
- Keep project, title and outcome prominent in the composer. Disclose optional context, reference links, assignee and dependencies with useful summaries. Collapse/reopen retains values. Every validation path, including unavailable assignee/dependency options, expands the affected section and exposes its error/focus target.
- Preserve drafts, privacy/session boundaries, live-update reading/navigation state, exact approval material, independent holds, retained controls and recovery routes. Confirmed failure keeps editable input; unknown outcomes reconcile the original operation without duplicate submission.

### Key interfaces

- `TaskRow` / `TaskCard` and task-summary presentation: preserve domain attribution and board mapping while refining hierarchy and width adaptation.
- `MobileNavigation`, shared shell and owned Button/Input/Textarea/NativeSelect/Sheet controls: consistent responsive, focus, scrolling and action reachability.
- `TaskComposer`, `ComposerInput` and `ComposerState`: disclosure is presentation state; retain input validation, project-change clearing rules, frozen submission, draft recovery and command receipts. Create and start / Save draft keep their existing semantics.
- `QuestionResponse` and question/approval state: retain exact question schema, recommendation/selection constraints, drafts, response identity and failed/unknown/recorded outcomes.
- Canonical editable Pen document and portable design handoff: shared library components, exact frame references, interaction annotations and explicit evidence limits. Coordinate overlapping edits with #793 without consuming its separate Files/Changes/local-review scope.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Update the existing Pen design and handoff with representative desktop, tablet and phone compositions for Overview, List/Board, Inbox/questions, task detail/evidence, Search and composer. Account for Settings/recovery, login and retained HTML through the shared-component inventory.
- [ ] Include navigation and composer disclosure states, populated optional summaries, validation, long content and short-viewport actions. Render affected frames, check resolved layout bounds and record exact node references. Save/reopen/readback confirms persistence. Verify the existing comparison-image loading gap or explicitly retain it as unresolved.
- [ ] Link Chris's review of the concrete Pen layouts/interaction handoff before beginning UI implementation. This known review checkpoint does not reopen the agreed product scope. Static review does not count as integrated acceptance.
- [ ] Production UI demonstrates the desired hierarchy and usable layout at 390×844, short 390×480, 759/760/800px, representative 1024/1366px and immediately around the chosen navigation breakpoint. Long titles, metadata and questions do not create unintended overlap or inaccessible actions; zoom remains usable.
- [ ] Safari/WebKit and Chromium journeys cover keyboard/focus, drawer open/close/restoration, bounded textarea growth, nested scroll boundaries and effective bottom padding. Focus is visible in a forced-colours check. Record actual browser/engine versions, inset/keyboard methods and physical-device limitations.
- [ ] Composer disclosure preserves exact optional values and summaries through collapse/reopen and permitted draft/navigation recovery. Errors automatically expose their fields. Project changes, confirmed failures, unknown-outcome reconciliation and recorded receipts retain existing semantics; behavioural regression tests cover these changed paths.
- [ ] Shared behaviour is consistent across applicable Overview, Inbox, project/cross-project List/Board, task/request links, Search, composer, Settings/recovery, login and retained advanced routes, including direct/return navigation. Document absent context-menu/extension/notification paths and intentional fallback limits rather than inventing new entry points.
- [ ] The implementation owner runs pinned dependency installation and the repository's full check, plus proportional production-browser/interaction validation. Record attributable source identity, results, gaps and cleanup in the issue/evidence handoff. Reuse unaffected runtime evidence; no new model calls are required by this presentation work.

Use a finite representative matrix, not every fixture at every viewport. Required checks that remain unproved stay open gaps. Update affected presentation contracts/evidence when implementation changes them; the issue owns delivery sequencing.

### Out of scope and authority

No new product capabilities, palette/component-framework replacement, API/policy/runtime/provider changes, altered board mapping or admission/recovery guarantees. Files/Changes/local reviews remain in #776/#793; paused native Codex/ChatGPT integrations remain in #734. Do not add a release/cutover dependency to #649 or reopen completed #736/#765.

Triage readiness records a complete specification. It does not dispatch work, approve an implementation plan, change Project readiness, deploy/cut over, or grant paid runtime/external test-write authority. The first deliverable is the revised Pen handoff; implementation follows its concrete review.

<!-- to-plan:implementation-plan:v2 -->

**Revision:** 1
**Supersedes:** none
**Replan report:** none

## Implementation plan

**Issue:** https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/issues/800
**Planned against:** `main` at `70ee69d5078f15da4508d30e902c072a6d7020be`
**Publication mode:** Autonomous
**Local state:** Clean
**Epoch closure:** null

### Approach

Refine the current operator presentation in the accepted Dark / Neutral / Default shadcn system. First revise the one canonical Pen document and its portable handoff against the merged #793 Files/Changes/local-review design. Render, inspect, save, reopen and read back representative layouts, then link Chris's concrete design/interaction review in #800. **Stop before application UI edits until Chris has approved both those revised layouts and this implementation plan.** The existing #800 product brief is complete; the checkpoint reviews the actual design and execution contract, not product scope. After both approvals, make focused UI increments through the existing React bundle, preserve the current command and question state machines, then qualify the production bundle with finite Chromium/WebKit journeys and the repository check. Preserve completed #736/#765 evidence and the existing #649 release/cutover dependencies without reopening those issues.

### Guardrails

- Source of truth: #800 body and its Agent Brief comment `6046979428`, `docs/SPEC.md`, `docs/acceptance.md` UX01–UX05/UI01–UI03, ADR-1007, and the current `design/DESIGN.md`. #793/PR #801 is merged into this baseline. Its Files/Changes/local-review entry and exact original-content/return-anchor contracts stay intact; #776/#782 own new inspection capabilities.
- Preserve board mapping, task/source attribution, exact approval material, independent dependency/Stop/ownership holds, stale/unknown/cancelled/undelivered states, service permissions, authentication/session/CSRF boundaries, and command identity/receipt semantics. Keep `ComposerState`'s frozen recovery and `QuestionResponseStates`' exact request identity; disclosures and sizing are presentation state, never command inputs. Existing session expiry/sign-out purges private client state. Do not claim a saved draft from on-device unfinished input.
- No new product capability, palette/framework swap, backend/provider change, paid live Codex call, external test write, deployment, Haze replacement, release/cutover change, or paused #734 native work. Static Pen frames cannot qualify keyboard, responsive, runtime, safe-area or persistence behavior. A physical iPhone/Safari result is a separate observation from automated WebKit.
- The **human review stop** is a hard dependency: T2 requires a linked, explicit Chris review of the concrete revised Pen layouts and an explicit approval of the implementation plan before T3–T8 begin. `/to-plan --auto` removes only the ordinary plan-publication pause. If the design review requests a material contract change, update the issue/spec and replan; routine visual corrections stay in T1. The implementation owner, not Chris, runs validation.
- Continue ordinary implementation, fixture and equivalent command repairs within unchanged requirements, coverage, architecture and authority; record corrections and renew affected evidence. A factual plan seam mismatch permits one focused diagnosis and at most two repair cycles. Ordinary code/test/fixture/CI repairs do not consume that allowance. Investigate unknown overlap and stop for a material scope, architecture, privacy/permission or qualification change, or exhausted grant. Reuse valid checks/reviews and the existing delivery record; an integration amendment is only for a changed published integration decision needing durable consumption.

### Planning decisions

- Keep the existing shared `TaskContents` data mapping and `taskColumn`/`taskReasons` domain derivation. Reorder and restyle the rendered facts rather than creating a second task-state interpretation. The reproduced 760px task-row collapse comes from fixed grid minima while the 224px sidebar remains; choose the exact navigation threshold and row/container strategy from measured content at 759/760/800px and zoom. The historical 760px Pen note is a starting point, not a fixed target.
- Keep the current `ComposerInput`/`ComposerState` schema and submitted `task.create` payload. Use local disclosure state with summaries derived from current input and current permitted options. All validation branches, including unavailable assignee/dependency options before `ComposerState.submit`, open the affected section and focus its visible field/error. Project changes still clear assignee/dependencies. Unknown outcomes keep the frozen original command and only expose reconciliation; confirmed failure keeps editable values.
- Use a small opt-in shared textarea growth behavior for answer, outcome and context inputs. Measure the controlled textarea's content height and clamp to explicit min/max presentation bounds; beyond the cap it scrolls internally. This works when CSS content sizing is absent in WebKit/Chromium, and resize must not change value, selection or caret. Scope the opt-in to the named inputs so other Settings/retained controls do not gain incidental behavior.
- Make scroll ownership explicit: question body, Inbox queue/detail, dependency list and drawer scroll independently, while headers and actions remain reachable in short viewports. Check computed cascade for the later `.question-submit` `padding-block` override, and inspect `web/index.html` viewport metadata plus CSS safe-area behavior. Use measurable emulated inset/viewport evidence; disclose any virtual-keyboard or physical-notch gap.
- A finite matrix covers all eight Agent Brief acceptance rows without a Cartesian product: desktop 1366×900 and 1024×768, phone 390×844 and the reproduced 390×480 question case, 759/760/800px, and immediately below/at/above the chosen navigation threshold. Run representative production-bundle journeys in Chromium and automated WebKit; use forced-colours emulation where supported and label the engine/version and method. Record zoom/long-content, reduced motion, safe-area and keyboard-resize methods and limits. Do not infer a physical Safari result from WebKit automation.
- Baseline proof is limited: the current source typechecked, linted, formatted and built locally after an offline `npm ci --ignore-scripts`; 16 focused non-browser composer/question-state tests passed. A local full `npm run check` reached browser tests but failed because Playwright 1.64.0 Chromium headless shell was absent at `~/Library/Caches/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1248/chrome-headless-shell-mac-arm64/chrome-headless-shell`. This is not a passing full baseline or the required final `npm ci`; recent CI at an earlier head and #801's design-only merge do not prove the #799 Playwright update. Install pinned browser engines and rerun the full check during implementation before claiming completion. If installation remains unavailable, retain that check as an open gap, not a pass.

### Implementation context

- **Existing:** `design/design.pen` and `design/DESIGN.md` — one editable shadcn canvas and its node/interaction handoff. Existing references include Overview `N9G11A`, List `nD0nh`, boards `E7qC9`/`MUFPD`, Inbox `cGjau`, phone question `pmu7r`, task `RyH7J`, phone composer `i3glx`, and #793's in-place task/result extensions `gAT6T`/`IuukL`/`M41aTm`. The newer Files/Changes/review nodes and parameterised current-file versus diff anchors are documented in the #793 handoff. The comparison-image loading gap has mixed historical evidence; verify the intended references in this revision or retain the gap explicitly.
- **Existing:** `web/src/app.tsx` routes Overview, Inbox, task lists/detail, Search, composer, Settings and recovery through one shell; `MobileNavigation` in `web/src/components.tsx` wraps Radix `Sheet` from `web/src/ui/sheet.tsx`. `web/src/styles.css` holds the 759px shell switch, fixed task-row columns, Inbox 760px switch, question scroller and conflicting safe-area padding; `web/src/tokens.css` holds the accepted foundation.
- **Existing:** `web/src/task-views.tsx` owns shared `TaskContents`/`TaskRow`/`TaskCard`, Overview, List/Board and filters. `web/src/tasks.ts` owns task column/reasons. `web/src/task-workspace.tsx` owns detail/evidence and reading/return anchors; `web/src/search.tsx` owns Search context. `web/src/inbox.tsx` owns queue/selection, and `web/src/question-response.tsx` with `question-response-state.ts` owns exact form, draft, validation, focused error and original-answer reconciliation.
- **Existing:** `web/src/task-composer.tsx` owns fields/options and the early assignee/dependency validation; `web/src/composer-state.ts` owns storage readback, validation, frozen command and receipt handling. `web/src/ui/{button,input,native-select,textarea,sheet}.tsx` own shared controls. `web/src/settings.tsx`, `web/src/recovery.tsx`, the login path in `web/src/app.tsx`, and retained HTML via `src/standalone/operator-html.ts`/`web/src/styles.css` are alternate presentation entry points.
- **Follow:** `test/fixtures/operator-web.ts` and the existing `operator-{task,question,search,foundation,settings}-browser.test.ts` suites for disposable SQLite, fake runtime, production bundle, authenticated browser and cleanup patterns. `test/operator-task-composer.test.ts` and `test/question-response-state.test.ts` guard frozen operations and draft semantics. `scripts/run-tests.mjs` owns the full test runner; it does not accept arbitrary file filters, so focused compiled tests use `node --test dist/test/<file>.test.js` after build.

### Implementation slices

**Task graph and parallelism:** `T1 → T2 → T3 → T4 → T5 → T6 → T7 → T8 → T9` is acyclic. T2 is the human review gate. T3–T8 are serial because `web/src/styles.css`, shared controls and shell wiring are mutable integration seams; a single UI owner carries them or uses explicit file handoff after each merged increment. T1's canonical Pen ownership is exclusive until review; no implementation task edits Pen. T9 integrates and reviews the final candidate. No slice assumes unmerged #782 changes; refresh overlap before an affected file is edited and reconcile compatible changes with targeted evidence renewal.

#### 1. Revise and persist the canonical Pen handoff

**Task ID:** `T1`
**Depends on:** `none`
**Prerequisites:** #793/PR #801 merged at the planned baseline; verify the sole current Pen file/session and owner before editing.
**Files and symbols:** `design/design.pen` (existing frames/components, shared library `X`) and `design/DESIGN.md` (current node map, layout and interaction handoff). Preserve #793's `gAT6T`/`IuukL`/`M41aTm` Files/Changes/review entries and `Nid6O`/`pi945`/`R2IFU` anchors.
**Implementation:** Through native Pencil MCP only, revise existing reusable components and representative desktop/tablet/phone frames for Overview, List/Board, Inbox/question, task/evidence, Search and composer. Include collapsed/expanded navigation and optional composer sections, supplied-value summaries, error expansion, long titles/answers/questions, short-height actions, and clear unknown/stale/failed/cancelled/undelivered labels. Annotate the unprovable focus, keyboard, scrolling, safe-area, textarea, auth and return behavior. Account for Settings/recovery/login/retained HTML in the shared-component/entry-point inventory and mark intentional canvas gaps. Refresh `DESIGN.md` with exact new/existing node IDs, component/layout rules and limits; supersede its historical fixed 224px/760px and fixed textarea guidance without erasing dated evidence. Keep #793's source inspection/anchored review semantics intact.
**Validate:** In the verified canonical Pen document, use native Pencil `execute` readback (`Get` with `resolveInstances` and bounds/problem visitor) on each affected frame; use `TakeScreenshot` on representative desktop/tablet/phone and error/long-content frames. Expect no unintended visible clipping, sibling/root overlap, placeholders or inaccessible drawn actions; record exact node IDs and rendered observations. Save through Pen's native UI, leave/reopen the same file, then MCP-read the intended nodes and file identity. Check comparison-image nodes after reopen; mark any unresolved image-load gap. From repository root run `git diff --check`; expect no whitespace errors. No source code or browser acceptance is claimed by this slice.
**Complete when:** The editable Pen and `DESIGN.md` show the agreed compositions, settled bounds/renders and verified persistence, with a linkable concrete review packet in #800.

#### 2. Obtain the two required approvals before UI edits

**Task ID:** `T2`
**Depends on:** `T1`
**Prerequisites:** T1's persisted Pen file, exact-node handoff, renders and limitations are available to Chris.
**Files and symbols:** #800's review record and the published plan permalink; no application file changes.
**Implementation:** Present the concrete revised layouts/interaction handoff and this plan for separate explicit Chris review/approval. Record links and dispositions in #800. If either is not approved, hold T3–T8 while any requested corrections are resolved under the same issue authority; a material product/permission change returns to the issue/spec and planning gate.
**Validate:** Read back the #800 record and plan identity; require explicit approval of the concrete revised Pen and explicit approval of this implementation plan, each linked and dated, before dispatching UI work. A general earlier product-scope agreement or `--auto` publication is insufficient.
**Complete when:** Both approvals are verifiable and the UI gate opens; otherwise the task stays held with the design/plan review question visible.

#### 3. Shared shell, controls, focus and motion

**Task ID:** `T3`
**Depends on:** `T2`
**Prerequisites:** Both review approvals; pinned browser engines available for focused UI tests.
**Files and symbols:** `web/src/app.tsx` shell/login and `MobileNavigation`; `web/src/components.tsx`; `web/src/ui/{button,input,native-select,sheet}.tsx`; `web/src/styles.css` shell/focus/drawer rules and, if the tested inset path requires it, `web/index.html`; `test/operator-foundation-browser.test.ts` and new `test/operator-ux800-shell-browser.test.ts`.
**Test:** Use the authenticated production bundle at widths 759, 760, 800 and the chosen threshold minus/at/plus one, with long nav labels, a direct task link, Tab/Shift+Tab, Escape and return focus. Assert sidebar/drawer choice leaves sufficient content width, drawer traps focus/restores the trigger and closes on Escape, 44px phone targets remain, no body horizontal overflow, slotted Button/Input/NativeSelect/Sheet controls have visible focus in ordinary and Chromium forced-colours modes, and reduced-motion removes optional transitions without suppressing state feedback. Check disabled/loading/error/pressed states and direct/return navigation; retain session-expiry purge.
**Implementation:** Choose and document the measured shell threshold; make layout min-width and drawer scroll/action behavior responsive to content. Add an actual outline fallback for shared slotted focus styles, preserving the existing ring and Radix semantics. Use restrained pressed feedback and `prefers-reduced-motion` without hiding status or introducing animation-dependent actions. Keep retained HTML and login aligned through the shared stylesheet, without hydrating them.
**Validate:** From repository root after `npm run build`, run `node --test dist/test/operator-foundation-browser.test.js dist/test/operator-ux800-shell-browser.test.js`; expect the assertions above in the production bundle. Use pinned Node/npm setup in Final validation.
**Complete when:** Shared navigation and controls work at the tested width/focus boundaries, including login and retained foundation paths, without policy changes.

#### 4. Task hierarchy and width-aware Overview/List/Board

**Task ID:** `T4`
**Depends on:** `T3`
**Prerequisites:** T3 shell/focus evidence passes.
**Files and symbols:** `web/src/task-views.tsx` `TaskContents`/`TaskRow`/`TaskCard`/`TaskViews`/`TaskBoard`; `web/src/styles.css` row/card/filter/board layout; `test/operator-task-browser.test.ts` and `test/operator-task-list.test.ts`.
**Test:** Seed the existing populated catalog (`test/operator-task-browser.test.ts`, `seedCatalog`) with a long title/source, agent-owned failed-check repair, unknown repair owner, question, independent approval/dependency hold, capacity wait, completed result, cancellation, undelivered closure and uncertain execution. At 390×844, 759/760/800, chosen threshold ±1, 1024 and 1366, assert title/work state/attention reason/next actor remain readable and source/project/lead accessible; no letter-per-line column, clipped control or horizontal page overflow. Toggle project/cross-project List/Board and filters, then open/return to a task; assert same task IDs, board grouping, filters/column/position and zero action commands.
**Implementation:** Recompose task facts so title, current work state, attention and next actor scan first; quiet but retain provenance. Replace fixed competing row columns with a measured responsive composition or container-aware rule, and let filters collapse before labels/controls compress. Preserve `taskColumn`, `taskReasons`, readiness versus work state and Board's intentional horizontal column navigation. Keep existing source and project links/labels.
**Validate:** From repository root after build, run `node --test dist/test/operator-task-browser.test.js dist/test/operator-task-list.test.js`; expect the populated responsive and no-mutation checks to pass.
**Complete when:** Overview and both List/Board contexts share the same compact, truthful hierarchy and all tested widths remain usable.

#### 5. Inbox/questions, scrolling, inset and growing answer input

**Task ID:** `T5`
**Depends on:** `T4`
**Prerequisites:** T4 list/entry-point evidence passes; no task/queue ownership changes.
**Files and symbols:** `web/src/inbox.tsx` `Inbox`; `web/src/question-response.tsx` `QuestionResponse`; `web/src/ui/textarea.tsx` opt-in growth; `web/src/styles.css` `.action-inbox`, `.inbox-rows`, `.question-content`, `.question-submit`, `.dependency-list` where shared, and `web/index.html` if safe-area metadata is required; `test/operator-question-browser.test.ts`, `test/operator-inbox.test.ts`.
**Test:** Use grouped free-text/single/multiple-choice questions with descriptions, recommendation and custom text, a long roughly 1,200px answer, exact approval with independent hold, and stale/failed/unknown/recorded response fixtures. At 390×844 and 390×480 plus 800 and desktop widths, scroll question/queue/detail to each boundary and assert headers/actions reachable, overscroll does not move the outer page unintentionally, focus/selection/draft persist through Inbox ↔ task and back, and the submit inset's computed padding remains positive under an explicit emulated inset. Type/edit a long answer in Chromium and WebKit; assert content grows to cap, then internal scroll; value, caret and selection survive resize. Force validation error and assert focus lands on the affected question. Reconcile an unknown answer with the original key; assert no second response command.
**Implementation:** Bound independent scroll regions using available height with correct `min-height:0`, containment and reserved action space; remove the later cascade override that cancels safe-area padding. Add opt-in measured/clamped Textarea growth and use it for question answers, preserving native form labels and `QuestionResponseStates` receipt behavior. Avoid auto-answering recommendations, changing question schema or clearing separate holds.
**Validate:** From repository root after build, run `node --test dist/test/operator-question-browser.test.js dist/test/operator-inbox.test.js dist/test/question-response-state.test.js`; expect nested-scroll, input, exact-form and reconciliation assertions. Capture computed style and scroll offsets as evidence, not only screenshots.
**Complete when:** Long exact questions and approvals remain readable/actionable at the short viewport and all response states remain truthful.

#### 6. Composer disclosure with preserved commands and drafts

**Task ID:** `T6`
**Depends on:** `T5`
**Prerequisites:** T5 shared textarea behavior and scroll/inset evidence pass.
**Files and symbols:** `web/src/task-composer.tsx` `TaskComposer` and local disclosure state; `web/src/styles.css` composer sections/actions/dependency scroll; `web/src/ui/textarea.tsx` opt-in outcome/context use; `web/src/composer-state.ts` only if an actual unchanged-contract defect requires it; `test/operator-task-browser.test.ts`, `test/operator-task-composer.test.ts`.
**Test:** Seed permitted projects/profiles/dependencies and supply context, two links, assignee and dependency; collapse/reopen all optional sections and assert exact input, summaries and selected values survive, including authenticated navigation and on-device recovery. Trigger invalid URL/combined brief, invalid/unavailable assignee and dependency, then assert the relevant section opens, visible field/error receives focus, no creation POST occurs. Switch projects and assert assignee/dependency clearing and summaries update. Exercise Save draft versus Create and start, confirmed failure, frozen unknown response across reload and exact-key reconciliation; assert the same command/receipt semantics, no duplicate task and no claim of execution from Ready. Test long outcome/context growth/caret in both engines and 390×480 action reachability.
**Implementation:** Keep project/title/outcome prominent. Add accessible labelled disclosures for optional context, references, assignee and dependencies, with summaries derived from current values; preserve mounted values while collapsed. Wire every validation branch, including the pre-submit options rejection, to open the correct disclosure before focusing its error/field. Retain `ComposerState.edit`/`submit` and session-storage recovery ownership; style pinned actions with effective safe-area reserve and independent dependency scrolling.
**Validate:** From repository root after build, run `node --test dist/test/operator-task-browser.test.js dist/test/operator-task-composer.test.js`; expect exact-value, zero-premature-POST, original-operation and receipt assertions.
**Complete when:** Progressive disclosure improves scanning while identical user input produces identical authorized commands and recovery outcomes.

#### 7. Reading surfaces and all alternate entry points

**Task ID:** `T7`

## Agent Brief — reconciled 3 October 2026

**Summary:** Qualify final operational recovery and prepare a reviewed executable cutover proposal.

Native prerequisites remain #697 and #704. The current issue body defines the finite technical completion checklist: final-schema/external-effect backup/restore, reconciliation before admission, evidence-based uncertain-execution recovery, generated LaunchAgent recovery-identity validation, and a reviewed executable proposal for one bounded cutover.

Complete #698 once this technical evidence and proposal review pass. Actual cutover execution is separately tracked by #761 and is not required to close this technical ticket. #761 retains explicit execution approval, physical sleep/wake evidence from #732 before operational use, old-work disposition, no competing writer/scheduler, preservation/rollback and verified operational acceptance. #649 still requires that outcome.

Reuse valid #704 evidence and test affected boundaries only; run pinned npm ci and npm run check for implementation changes. No evidence-free unlock, universal containment claim, production deployment, reboot or Haze mutation is authorised.

Operational recovery follow-up found while qualifying #694 against the merged #704 setup: `src/standalone/termination.ts` invokes `sysctl` by name to read the macOS boot-session identity. The generated LaunchAgent PATH is `/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin`, so it cannot resolve `/usr/sbin/sysctl`. A read-only probe with that PATH returned no captured process identity; adding `/usr/sbin` produced a complete identity. #694's bounded live journey used the full host PATH and passed; no deployment/cutover claim is made. Include a narrow fix (absolute macOS command path or corrected fixed LaunchAgent PATH) and recovery-identity readback under the generated LaunchAgent environment in this ticket's uncertain-execution operational qualification. The existing paused/unready #704 launchd evidence remains valid within its recorded limits.

<!-- to-plan:implementation-plan:v2 -->

**Revision:** 1
**Supersedes:** none
**Replan report:** none

## Implementation plan

**Issue:** https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/issues/698
**Planned against:** `main` at `b972978895957400cf808d3a8e6ab18224d79af2` (clean detached planning checkout)
**Publication mode:** Autonomous
**Local state:** Clean
**Epoch closure:** null

### Approach

Qualify final-candidate backup/restore and the existing evidence-based recovery route using disposable standalone SQLite/filesystem data and an exactly owned synthetic macOS child. Fix the demonstrated generated-environment boot-identity command defect. Reuse unaffected #704 lifecycle and #697 provider/UI/runtime evidence. Deliver a reviewed executable proposal for one bounded project cutover; actual execution remains #761, with #732 physical sleep/wake evidence and separate explicit approval required before operational use.

The live #698 body, [reconciled Agent Brief](https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/issues/698#issuecomment-5896972077) and [LaunchAgent finding](https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/issues/698#issuecomment-5916110506) govern this finite scope. Native prerequisites #697/#704 are complete. `docs/SPEC.md`, `docs/acceptance.md:R06`, ADR-1004/1005/1006 and `docs/operations/standalone-macos.md` define retained contracts. Technical completion requires the reviewed proposal, not the eventual cutover window.

### Guardrails

- No production deployment, loading a persistent LaunchAgent, Haze prototype database access/import/mutation/resumption, provider write, real Codex/model turn, paid routing, host reboot/power action, credential disclosure or shared login/environment changes. X01–X08 stay paused. Synthetic fixture processes/files and read-only host identification are the bounded operational evidence.
- Keep existing exact generation/process/workspace/effect evidence, independent Stop/writer/capacity holds and admission gates. Same-boot PID absence verifies only the recorded process; independently account for the fixture's known writers/descendants and effects. A timer, acknowledgement, historical terminal, generic shutdown text or null identity cannot release ownership. No universal containment or live-reattachment proof is added.
- A different restore root does not relocate workspaces. Preserve their identity rejection and old paths untouched. Snapshot content does not include auth, worktrees, provider records or remote effects; preserved external-effect rows do not mean the effects are settled. Reconcile those independently before admission.
- Qualify the existing owned-cleanup route first. If it cannot establish the required boundary, retain holds and report the concrete failure plus the separately authorized safe host-restart grant needed; do not reboot, broaden recovery proof or repeat unchanged inconclusive cleanup. Continue independent backup/proposal work.
- Continue routine implementation and fixture corrections within unchanged requirements, coverage, architecture and authority; record the correction and renew affected evidence. A factual plan mismatch allows one diagnosis and two repair cycles; ordinary repairs do not consume that budget. Investigate unknown overlap; stop for material design/contract changes or exhausted grants.
- Reuse the existing delivery record and valid checks/reviews. Use an integration amendment only for a changed published integration decision requiring durable consumption; preserve repair budgets and grants. Root owns architectural acceptance, publication and all remote mutations. One coherent PR is sufficient.

### Planning decisions

- `readHostBootIdentity` still executes `sysctl` by name while `renderLaunchAgent` supplies `/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin`. Choose `/usr/sbin/sysctl` on macOS, leaving the fixed LaunchAgent environment unchanged; this repairs the known lookup without adding ambient environment or changing recovery semantics.
- Core `PRAGMA user_version` and operations' maximum supported version both remain 6. Final domain/routing/delivery/recovery/history tables have changed independently, so qualify the actual schema fingerprint and whole-database contents, not an unnecessary version bump or table-specific export. Existing generic logical digest includes all ordinary tables.
- Startup already awaits runtime/execution reconciliation, delivery refresh, own-closure reconciliation, GitHub refresh and durable inbox reconciliation before creating the scheduler (`StandaloneService.start`). Demonstrate this ordering under delayed/unavailable providers and an uncertain old generation; repair only a reproduced violation.

Reuse #697's final assembled candidate evidence and original S07a/UI07 source/runtime identities. This work adds real owned-process identity/cleanup under the generated environment and final-state snapshot/recovery, not a repeat launchd/model/provider journey.
- Keep the cutover proposal in `docs/operations/standalone-cutover-proposal.md`, linked to #761, as an executable operations artifact rather than a parallel delivery backlog. New `docs/evidence/s08b-final-recovery.md` records results/provenance. Update existing operations procedure/current shared R06 inventory, preserving all historical evidence.

### Implementation slices

**Task graph and parallelism:** `T1 -> T2 -> T3`, acyclic. Keep one owner for the recovery fixture, operations qualification and proposal/evidence integration; sequential work avoids shared lifecycle/provenance edits. Independent integrated review follows the candidate; repairs stay with that owner. No additional agents or separate PRs are prescribed.

**Shared setup/commands:** Run from the controller-created clean implementation checkout based on this SHA. Set `PATH=/tmp/ensemble-drain-tools:/private/tmp/node-v24.21.0-darwin-arm64/bin:$PATH`; verify `node --version` = `v24.21.0` and `npm --version` = `12.2.0`, including nested scripts. Real boundary runner uses the absolute Node executable with its own synthetic rendered environment, not inherited host credentials. #### 1. Generated-environment identity and owned-survivor recovery

**Task ID:** `T1`
**Depends on:** `none`
**Prerequisites:** Shared setup and unchanged recovery contracts.
**Files and symbols:** `src/standalone/termination.ts:readHostBootIdentity`; new `test/termination.test.ts`, `test/s08b/owned-recovery.mjs`; update `docs/operations/standalone-macos.md` current npm pin to 12.2.0 and accurate recovery procedure. No launchd environment expansion or production service deployment.
**Test:** Derive PATH/environment from an actual rendered disposable plist, then run the compiled identity functions in an absolute-Node child under that exact synthetic environment. Before the repair, the known PATH lacks sysctl and identity is unavailable; after the repair, capture a complete boot/birth/PID identity for the runner-owned harmless child. Verification while it is alive conflicts. After graceful termination through its retained child handle and observed exit, independent verification reports `mac-pid-absent-same-boot`. Wrong generation/process, missing original identity and unavailable/conflicting evidence reject release. Keep macOS-specific tests explicit; Linux skips do not pass this required macOS boundary.
**Implementation:** Replace only macOS sysctl invocation with its absolute supported path. In the runner, bind a fake execution's exact process identity to the owned synthetic child, persist the uncertain generation and Stop, restart real service storage, and inspect through existing read-only recovery/API surfaces. Demonstrate no blind resubmit/admission while the child is alive or inspector is inconclusive. Account for the deliberately bounded child topology, verify its relevant file sentinel and synthetic effects independently, terminate its exact owned child gracefully, verify no known surviving fixture writer, then submit the existing exact recovery receipt. Wrong/evidence-free receipt fails with holds intact. Exact receipt releases only the matched writer/capacity generation; Stop still requires explicit Resume and all remaining controls. Repeat receipt/read-only observation/restart without duplicate admission. This qualifies the owned-process recovery route, not actual Codex containment.
**Bounded runner:** At most one harmless child, one disposable service fixture and one restore/reopen cycle for this route; no child descendants, network provider traffic or model calls. Total timeout 60 seconds, per identity/receipt step 5 seconds, cleanup 10 seconds. On timeout retain the primary failure and ownership evidence; graceful exact-handle shutdown precedes any task-specific forced termination. Remove only the recorded created fixture after process/service ownership is settled.
**Validate:** After build run `node --test dist/test/termination.test.js dist/test/recovery.test.js dist/test/recovery-continuation.test.js dist/test/no-turn-recovery.test.js dist/test/operations.test.js`; then on macOS run `/private/tmp/node-v24.21.0-darwin-arm64/bin/node test/s08b/owned-recovery.mjs --qualify`. Expect generated-environment boot identity, live-conflict/dead-exact verification, rejected wrong/no-proof release, independent effects/workspace readback, exact release with other holds retained, and settled cleanup. The runner emits sanitized source/runtime/harness/count/result identities; keep raw process/private paths in the private delivery record.
**Complete when:** The known PATH finding is repaired and both deterministic controls and the real owned-process/filesystem boundary pass without broadening recovery or needing a reboot.

#### 2. Final candidate snapshot/restore and admission ordering

**Task ID:** `T2`
**Depends on:** `T1`
**Prerequisites:** T1 identity/recovery boundary pass; final #697 candidate and reused #704 snapshot contract.
**Files and symbols:** New `test/operations-final-candidate.test.ts`; use production operations APIs/CLI and existing service/recovery/provider seams. Extend `test/operations.test.ts` only for a shared necessary fixture correction; production operations/service changes only for demonstrated defects.
**Test:** Build disposable current-schema data through ordinary service/domain/tool commands, with source/task/assignment identities, nested result destinations, routing provenance, conversation/history/artifact metadata, questions/answers and exact approvals, pause/Stop/dependency controls, capacity/writer ownership, queued inbox supersession receipts and representative confirmed/denied/uncertain external actions plus PR/settlement/completion history. Use fake runtime and fail-closed HTTP responses; no real provider writes or paid routing. Before stopping, an independent read-only SQLite connection records protected row identities/digests and actual schema fingerprint. Stop/drain the owned service before offline backup; verify the committed snapshot and restore to a distinct canonical nonexistent private directory using production CLI.
**Implementation:** Compare all protected rows and logical digest before restored startup, run integrity/foreign-key checks, and compare retained public projections after startup's documented derived reconciliation (provider observations may become unknown/refreshed; immutable history/receipts must not be rewritten). Restore excludes owner/WAL/auth/worktree/provider contents as before. Verify managed old-root bindings are rejected before path access and preserved files are byte-identical; do not relocate them. Delay execution/provider/source reconciliation and assert zero new admissions until it ends. Unknown effect/source state holds affected work without replay; exact confirmed readback may settle only its identity and cannot clear independent Stop/workspace/child/approval holds. Once ordinary controls and the qualified exact recovery route permit a separate eligible fixture task, observe one admission; repeat restart/reconciliation without duplication. Keep representative cases finite; do not rerun both complete real delivery journeys.
**Validate:** Run `npm run build` then `node --test dist/test/operations-final-candidate.test.js dist/test/operations.test.js dist/test/s07b-delivery-integration.test.js dist/test/recovery.test.js`; expect exact final schema/history/receipt preservation, unchanged source filesystem, refused active-source/preexisting/incomplete/tampered operations, startup reconciliation before admission, unresolved effects held and one eventual eligible admission without replay. Existing #704 refusal/fault tests retain the generic boundaries; new checks prove the affected final tables and startup path.
**Complete when:** Final-candidate backup/verify/restore, state readback, recovery/admission ordering and exact cleanup pass, with exclusions and accepted runtime limits recorded.

#### 3. Reviewed bounded cutover proposal and technical handback

**Task ID:** `T3`
**Depends on:** `T2`
**Prerequisites:** Passing technical qualification, current #697/#704 evidence applicability and the proposed Haze/Chris’s MacBook Pro identity above, with root-reviewed current discovery provenance. Discoverable current facts are not new execution authority; unresolved old-controller details are explicit #761 preflight refusal gates.
**Files and symbols:** New `docs/operations/standalone-cutover-proposal.md`, `docs/evidence/s08b-final-recovery.md`; update `docs/operations/standalone-macos.md` and existing `docs/evidence/release-candidate-inventory.json` R06 attribution/remaining gates. No permanent documentation-shape test.
**Implementation:** Use the exact proposed Haze repository/Project and current Mac identities above, recording root discovery timestamp/provenance and the unavailable prototype metadata. The proposal specifies one eligible named Haze task at execution preflight; no current task is silently selected or authorized by the proposal. Root/user #761 approval must bind that task, its outcome/version and effect/turn/time limits before enablement. Inspect only relevant non-secret configuration and public/read-only scheduler/work ownership facts; never open the installed prototype database merely to fill this proposal. The proposal must be a named plan with explicit executable parameters and readback checks, not a generic template or a claim that live work is already stopped.

Include these ordered execution stages for #761 review:

1. Verify exact candidate/source/tooling and #698 evidence, completed physical #732 proof, user-approved project/host/resources/window, permitted provider operations/merge mode, login/auth boundaries and cleanup/rollback authority. Revalidate all discovered facts at execution time. Missing authority or unresolved target identity blocks only execution, not a passing technical qualification.
2. Inventory old tasks, assignments, active/queued execution, effects, workspaces and exact scheduler/process identities through the qualified read-only surfaces. Record explicit retain/finish/cancel/hold disposition per old work item before enabling new work. Unsupported/inaccessible old state blocks enablement; do not migrate/import/resume it automatically. Preserve Haze installation/files/data and shared login/config.
3. Under separately approved #761 authority, hold/stop only the named old admissions, request exact owned cancellation as applicable, and independently prove no competing scheduler/known writer can act on the selected workload/workspaces. Keep uncertainty held. A paused UI or acknowledgement alone is not proof. Record the verified identities and boundary before enabling a fresh standalone project.
4. Create and verify private backups/preservation of the selected standalone installation and separately authorized old assets using their own supported procedure; the standalone operations CLI must never point at Haze prototype data. Record canonical paths, content hashes, exclusions, stable Node/CLI/auth/log paths, private operator origin, reviewed plist/label and recovery readbacks. Prepare fresh standalone data, project permissions/source selections/explicit repository grants and one bounded workload without enabling yet.
5. After exact approval and final no-competition readback, execute only the named reviewed installation/enablement commands, observe one bounded service/runtime/provider/UI outcome, and verify committed identities/control state before broader operation. Define successful outcome and maximum effects/turn/time bounds in the reviewed proposal. Require immediate hold on unexpected execution, unknown effect, duplicate, identity mismatch or evidence failure.
6. Rollback first holds/stops new admission and reconciles exact execution/effects; restoring SQLite cannot undo GitHub or release uncertainty. Restore only a verified snapshot into a new path with startup reconciliation. Re-enable old scheduling only if separately approved and independently proven noncompeting. Preserve snapshots/history/workspaces and verify exact owned cleanup; no automatic deletion, hidden force release or simultaneous old/new writers.

Provide concrete discovery commands using the documented existing `bb status`, project/machine/plugin read-only listing interfaces and exact verified local configuration; record the failed current lookup. If the old controller remains unreachable, refuse enablement and obtain independently verified controller/work/process identities through the operator's approved route. Do not autostart it or infer no writers from connection refusal. Bind discovered canonical old-data/backup paths and exact controller controls into the execution packet before #761 approval; the reviewed proposal itself names Haze/this Mac and contains the conditional refusal steps. Use concrete supported standalone `operations backup/verify/restore/render-launch-agent` arguments from the procedure, with deployment paths expressly selected in that packet rather than pretending temporary test paths are durable production paths. Where an old scheduler lacks a qualified control seam, mark that concrete #761 execution gate and obtain its explicit disposition instead of inventing commands or modifying it in #698. Obtain root independent review of the complete technical evidence and named proposal; repairs stay with the owner. Record proposal digest/review disposition and any execution-only gates. Technical #698 completion does not require waiting for the user to approve a window or executing these stages.
**Validate:** From the implementation checkout run `git diff --check` and this focused one-off inventory check; review the proposal's command arguments against the verified operations CLI/renderer and actual read-only target facts. Manually walk its gates, failed-step holds, preservation and rollback with the integrated reviewer. No production dry run or placeholder command can count as execution.

```sh
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
root = Path.cwd()
inventory = json.loads((root / 'docs/evidence/release-candidate-inventory.json').read_text())
rows = inventory['releaseCandidate']['scenarios']
assert len(rows) == 40 and len({r['id'] for r in rows}) == 40
assert {r['id'] for r in rows} == {f'A{i:02d}' for i in range(1,31)} | {f'R{i:02d}' for i in range(1,11)}
for r in rows:
    assert r['disposition'].strip() and r['references'], r['id']
    for ref in r['references']:
        p = Path(ref)
        assert not p.is_absolute() and '..' not in p.parts and (root / p).is_file(), ref
import subprocess
baseline = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'b972978895957400cf808d3a8e6ab18224d79af2:docs/evidence/release-candidate-inventory.json']))
assert next(r for r in rows if r['id'] == 'R03') == next(r for r in baseline['releaseCandidate']['scenarios'] if r['id'] == 'R03')
assert inventory['releaseCandidate']['sharedUI07Identity'] == baseline['releaseCandidate']['sharedUI07Identity']
assert inventory['releaseCandidate']['s07aReuse'] == baseline['releaseCandidate']['s07aReuse']

PY
```

**Complete when:** Named executable proposal and technical evidence receive independent review, R06 technical qualification is attributed without promoting physical/cutover results, exact cleanup passes and applicable final-head delivery checks pass.

### Acceptance coverage

| #698 finite item | Slice | Verification |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1: Reuse #704; final schema/effects/state readback and reconciliation before admission | T2 | Current-schema snapshot/restore tests, protected-row/digest readback and delayed startup zero-admission assertion |
| 2: Qualified recovery, evidence-free release rejection and generated-environment boot identity finding | T1, T2 | Identity regression, real owned-child qualifier, exact/wrong receipt tests and independent holds |
| 3: Reviewed executable one-project proposal, #732 prerequisite and separate #761 execution | T3 | Named target/host provenance, reviewed command/readback/rollback stages and recorded proposal digest/verdict |
| 4: Source/runtime/results/limits/cleanup, deterministic faults, bounded live boundary and pinned checks/reviews | T1–T3 | Sanitized technical report, exact fixture cleanup, final validation and integrated review |

### Final validation

- Run pinned `npm ci`, `npm run test:fixture-preflight`, `npm run check` and `git diff --check` from the implementation checkout. Record actual successful counts, final source/tree/runtime/harness identities, failures/repairs and process/filesystem cleanup. Repeat only affected evidence after repairs.
- Baseline planning checks: clean exact SHA, `git diff --check`, pinned Node 24.21.0/npm 12.2.0 and existing paths/symbols. No redundant planning full suite or operational runner executed.
- Require independent integrated standards/correctness, reuse/clarity/efficiency and overengineering review under existing delivery requirements, including the executable proposal. ### Review focus

nodes.body:
> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Agent Brief

**Category:** enhancement
**Summary:** Reconcile the existing operator UI with the reviewed shadcn foundation while preserving supported behaviour and service-owned policy.

Chris approved this scoped plan during triage. This brief defines the implementation scope; it does not dispatch implementation. Keep the issue unassigned and preserve its current Project status. Native dependencies govern sequencing; final integrated visual/usability acceptance remains on #736.

**Current behaviour:**
At the inspected main revision `adb13194e6730dd3d077a14c1b446875cada7fae`, the frontend retains a light bespoke palette, Space Grotesk / Instrument Sans / IBM Plex Mono fonts and bespoke shared controls. The reviewed design instead uses shadcn Dark / Neutral / Default with Inter interface text and JetBrains Mono identifiers. React already uses Radix for mobile-navigation dialogs, but the shared foundation has not been reconciled. Redundancy checks covered shared tokens/components, screen styles, frontend dependencies and operator route entry points; no completed migration or prior-rejection records were found.

**Desired behaviour and approved scope:**
1. Produce a bounded inventory mapping existing screens, shared controls, desktop/phone navigation, dialogs, login, direct routes and service-served legacy controls to reviewed counterparts. Migrate alternate entry points or explicitly record an intentional disposition and remaining gaps.
2. Adopt the actual shadcn component approach within the existing React + Vite / same-origin architecture. Settle and record the minimal dependency/component choices before implementation; reuse existing primitives where appropriate. Implement Dark / Neutral / Default semantic tokens, Inter / JetBrains Mono roles, compact hierarchy, 36px desktop controls and 44px phone actions. Waiting, success and dependency states use neutral treatments with explicit labels.
3. Apply the foundation to existing Overview, project/cross-project List and Board, task creation, setup/configuration, runtime/recovery and applicable task/Inbox controls. Preserve supported behaviour and remove redundant old palette, font dependencies and bespoke component styling.
4. Validate representative desktop/phone states and keyboard/focus behaviour, run pinned checks, update the frontend architecture/product/evidence documentation, and hand the integrated revision and changed-surface evidence to #745.

**Key interfaces:**
- Shared `Button`, `TextField`, `StatusBadge`, `ResourceStatus` and `MobileNavigation` controls: converge on the reviewed foundation while retaining semantic roles, labels, state and controlled interactions.
- Shared theme/typography tokens and responsive screen compositions: use one consistent foundation across supported entry points.
- Operator API projections and command receipts: retain server-owned permission decisions, revision/idempotency handling and pending/confirmed/failed/uncertain semantics.
- Shared-component ownership: coordinate with #742/#743; their new task/review/search/navigation and structured-question behaviours remain in those tickets.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- [ ] The surface/control inventory covers direct routes, phone navigation, dialogs, login, setup/recovery and legacy entry points; intentional dispositions and omissions are explicit.
- [ ] Existing screens use the reconciled shared foundation without parallel old/new systems. Populated, empty, waiting, loading, stale and error states have readable typography and consistent focus, disabled and selected treatments.
- [ ] Existing task creation, List/Board parity, imported-source ownership, configuration validation and execution/recovery actions retain their supported behaviour and counterparts/recovery paths. Currently supported drafts, selections, disclosures and reading position survive refreshes and failed submissions.
- [ ] Session/origin/CSRF protections, service-owned permissions, exact approval material, independent dependency/Stop/ownership holds and command-outcome semantics remain effective. Visual state never implies unconfirmed persistence, delivery, repair ownership or completion.
- [ ] Attributable browser screenshots compare representative laptop/phone states with corresponding reviewed Pen frames. Keyboard/focus and responsive checks qualify application behaviour; static canvas renders alone are insufficient.
- [ ] Pinned `npm ci` and `npm run check` pass, together with proportional browser/regression checks. Reuse unaffected runtime/provider evidence; add bounded live checks only for a changed integration boundary or demonstrated gap.
- [ ] Remove superseded styling/font dependencies where redundant; update ADR-1007 and relevant documentation to distinguish implemented and planned surfaces. Hand the integrated revision, changed-surface evidence, alternate-entry-point coverage and remaining gaps to #745.

**Out of scope:**
- New task/review/search and structured-question feature work owned by #742/#743; reopening completed #740/#741/#744 scope.
- Treating #742/#743 as whole-ticket prerequisites for migrating already-delivered screens, or using historical handoffs as the latest design. Their later reviewed extensions remain subject to publication of the amended design.
- New themes, backend/runtime capabilities, external-write permissions, editors/terminals/browsers, a separate frontend service, or wholesale copying of the retired Rust/desktop frontend.
- Deferred X01–X08, deployment, merge, installed Haze replacement or cutover. Preserve accepted runtime trust limits and recovery boundaries.

<!-- to-plan:implementation-plan:v2 -->

**Revision:** 1
**Supersedes:** none
**Replan report:** none

## Implementation plan

**Issue:** https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/issues/765
**Planned against:** `main` at `adb13194e6730dd3d077a14c1b446875cada7fae`
**Publication mode:** Autonomous
**Local state:** Clean
**Epoch closure:** null

### Approach

Replace the delivered React UI's bespoke primitives with owned shadcn/ui component source, one Dark / Neutral / Default token foundation and Inter / JetBrains Mono. Keep React + Vite and the existing same-origin service. Migrate existing screens and style their retained HTML destinations from the same production CSS; retain their commands and supported interaction state. Record every supported entry point and its disposition. This is foundation reconciliation, not delivery of the future task-detail, search or structured Inbox features.

Requirements: issue #765 and its Agent Brief https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/issues/765#issuecomment-5973184706; `design/DESIGN.md` (3 October reviewed foundation and frame map); `docs/SPEC.md` operator contract; `docs/acceptance.md` operator UI and UX scenarios; ADR-1007. #736 retains final integrated human acceptance. #742/#743 consume this foundation; #745 receives its integrated revision and evidence.

### Guardrails

- Preserve existing routes, form actions, fields, hidden CSRF/idempotency/revision identities, authentication expiry, same-origin boundaries, server-owned permissions and exact-material decisions. Keep dependency, Stop and ownership holds independent. No visual treatment may imply a recorded result, successful delivery, repair ownership or completed execution without its existing evidence.
- Preserve currently supported draft, filter, selected-column, disclosure, focus and reading-position behavior. Do not replace state ownership, `OperatorClient`, `ConfigurationDrafts`, composer state or `CommandLifecycle`. Do not claim retention that legacy full-page forms never supported; inventory those limits.
- No new React task-detail/Inbox/question/search capabilities from #742/#743, no expansion of completed #740/#741/#744 scope, no new theme switch, backend/runtime capability, external-write permission or frontend service. Do not port the retired Rust frontend. Paused X01–X08, deployed Haze, deployment, merge and cutover remain untouched.
- Keep exact private editors and advanced operational forms reachable. UI08 does not remove retained routes or move private values into public JSON. Native checkbox/select/details behavior remains appropriate where replacing it would alter supported semantics.
- Continue routine implementation and fixture corrections within unchanged requirements, coverage, architecture and authority; record corrections and renew affected evidence. A factual plan mismatch permits one focused diagnosis and two repair cycles; ordinary implementation repairs do not consume that budget. Investigate unknown overlap; stop for material design/contract changes or exhausted grants. Reuse the existing delivery record and valid evidence; use an integration amendment only for a changed published integration decision requiring durable consumption.

### Planning decisions

1. **Actual shadcn, locally owned source.** Use official Radix-based shadcn/ui source components in `web/src/ui/`: Button, Input, Textarea, NativeSelect, Badge, Alert, Card and Sheet (the latter wraps the already installed Radix Dialog). Include only those needed now; no generic Sidebar subsystem, data-table framework, form library, toast system or new Radix umbrella package. Current task rows can retain their accessible article composition; cards and status/receipt panels use the actual Card/Badge/Alert source. Future table/accordion/avatar/radio/grouped-question components belong to their consuming feature when needed. Plain navigation links and native `<details>` remain ordinary compositions with foundation styles. Preserve toolbar/pressed-button Board column behavior rather than falsely declaring ARIA tabs.
2. **Concrete dependency contract.** Add `class-variance-authority`, `clsx`, `tailwind-merge`, `@radix-ui/react-slot`, and self-hosted `@fontsource/inter` / `@fontsource/jetbrains-mono`; retain `@radix-ui/react-dialog`. Add Tailwind v4 and `@tailwindcss/vite` as build dependencies. Add `lucide-react` only for the small decorative chevron/close symbols used by copied NativeSelect/Sheet; textual labels remain accessible and authoritative. Do not install a shadcn runtime library. Copy/adapt official source deliberately rather than letting an init CLI overwrite the app. Record copied-source provenance and exact installed versions in the design/evidence record; pin versions in `package.json` and lockfile. `cn` is the small standard clsx/tailwind-merge helper. No animation package is required: omit optional motion utility classes. Native checks use the shared input/ring/selection treatment without a new checkbox dependency. Remove the three old font packages after no callers remain.
3. **One styling owner.** `tokens.css` owns semantic tokens, fonts and typography roles; owned shadcn source owns primitive variants/states; `styles.css` owns composition, responsive geometry and a bounded `.legacy-operator` adapter for server HTML native controls. Delete redundant bespoke button/input/badge/drawer skin rules instead of layering two systems. Add only the required Tailwind/Vite setup; preserve the current Vite root, `/` base, `dist/operator` output and supported asset types. Retain current module/import conventions rather than introducing a repository-wide alias migration.
4. **Resolved presentation.** Pen MCP readback supplied by the lead: background `#0a0a0a`, foreground `#fafafa`, card/popover `#171717`, primary `#e5e5e5` with `#171717` foreground, secondary/muted/accent `#262626`, muted foreground `#a3a3a3`, border/input `#ffffff1a`, ring `#737373`, destructive `#ff666999`; sidebar `#18181b`, sidebar accent `#2a2a30`, sidebar foreground `#fafafa`. Use semantic shadcn variable names and consistent foreground pairs, including normal error text in foreground with a destructive panel border. Inter 400/500/600 supplies interface text; JetBrains Mono 400 supplies identifiers/provenance. Routine waiting/success/dependency badges and panels are neutral with explicit words. Desktop controls 36px, phone interactive targets at least 44px; checkbox/radio glyphs need not be 44px if their full labelled targets are. Sidebar 224px, main padding20px, gaps12px, headings18px/600, task/request titles14px/600, control text14px/500, metadata12px. Composer outcome260px desktop/180px phone. Validate the existing760px breakpoint with actual content rather than assuming it qualifies all narrow widths.
5. **Retained HTML disposition.** The normal production listener already mounts `OperatorWebBundle`, and all retained page HTML passes through `operator.ts:document()` including runtime/coordination route results. Expose only validated CSS asset hrefs from the loaded bundle and link them in that wrapper; add `.legacy-operator` rather than inject executable client code or broaden routes. Use the same semantic CSS/fonts and control geometry, keeping server HTML forms and full-page navigation. Unsupported-path and denied-request fragments intentionally remain minimal public error responses, with no authenticated navigation/private context. The deliberately web-disabled diagnostic server retains functional platform HTML: it has no old palette/fonts, no second custom theme, and is not qualified as the production presentation. Explicitly record/test this disposition. Do not introduce separate asset infrastructure solely for that fallback.
6. **No new proof gate.** Existing build/service/browser seams establish feasibility. Preliminary baseline is qualified by green GitHub Actions `check`, run37132100241 completed2026-10-03T15:09:18Z at the exact SHA. Implementation must run pinned install/check and renew changed browser evidence; no new live runtime/provider exercise unless the work actually changes an integration boundary or reveals a gap. Official component/Vite guidance inspected during planning: [existing Vite project](https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/installation/vite), [Button](https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/radix/button), [Native Select](https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/radix/native-select).

### Implementation context

- `web/src/components.tsx`: Button/TextField/StatusBadge/ResourceStatus are bespoke elements; MobileNavigation already uses controlled Radix Dialog with trigger, title, description, close, overlay and focus restoration. Keep these domain-facing seams while delegating their primitive rendering to owned shadcn source; preserve caller-provided className/ref/ARIA/native props and controlled values.
- `web/src/app.tsx`: App/ProjectNavigation/RouteLink own shell and routing, Login owns password submission; `/app/inbox` currently links to `/coordination`, not a implemented React Inbox. Unknown app routes keep their existing outcome. Login clears password after failure by design; do not promise password retention.
- `web/src/task-views.tsx`: TaskViews/TaskRow/TaskCard/TaskBoard own Overview, cross-project/project List/Board, URL filters and phone selected column. `tasks.ts` owns mapping and `taskDetailHref` points to retained detail. `task-composer.tsx` and `composer-state.ts` own existing input/reconciliation; optional values are already shown inline, so foundation migration must not silently implement new progressive disclosure.
- `web/src/settings.tsx`: DraftField/DraftCheck/DraftOutcome plus SettingsWorkspace/ProjectSetup/ProfileConfiguration/ProjectConfiguration/RoutingConfiguration/SourceConfiguration; `settings-state.ts:ConfigurationDrafts` owns exact unknown/recorded submission state. `recovery.tsx:RuntimeSettings/AssignmentRecovery` owns capacity and curated read-only recovery, linking retained controls.
- `src/standalone/operator.ts`: document()/loginContent()/OperatorHttpServer response paths wrap server-rendered `OperatorUi` pages. `operator-runtime.ts` and `operator-coordination.ts` register the runtime/coordination routes and controls. `operator-web.ts:OperatorWebBundle.open/asset` allowlists `js/css/woff2`, rejects symlinks and missing references; preserve that validation for stylesheet exposure. `cli.ts` loads the production bundle; no new listener.
- `test/operator-control-inventory.test.ts` checks68 individual documented controls,14 destinations,38 retained forms,12 discriminants/actions and16 extension routes against `docs/design/ui06-configuration.md`; extend that seam for presentation disposition rather than invent an independent command inventory. Browser suites use `createOperatorFixture`, real SQLite, built production assets, Playwright Chromium, `browserSuite` and `captureBrowserEvidence`; retain their owned teardown and attributable evidence.

### Surface/control inventory to carry into delivery

In T1 create `docs/design/ui08-foundation.md`, completing the following bounded matrix against current rendered controls. Import the individual UI06 control-disposition table by stable reference and add presentation ownership/counterpart columns for every row; do not collapse distinct command controls into an unchecked category. Record keyboard role, state coverage, phone disposition, direct/linked access and screenshot evidence for each group below.

| Existing surface / entry paths | Existing controls and disposition | Reviewed counterpart / evidence reference |

| `/login`, unauthenticated `/app*`, bootstrap/expired session; legacy login when web disabled | Password field, pending/error/retry, sign-in; logout in React topbar and HTML navigation. Shared Input/Button/Alert; intentional password clear unchanged | Shared `eIXDM`/`DOuyS`; no login frame exists, record composition gap |

| `/app/tasks/new`, project-scoped query and receipt/recovery views | Project/title/outcome/context/references/permitted assignee/dependency checks, Create and start/Save draft, unfinished-input resume/discard, unknown reconciliation and confirmed receipt. Keep current feature structure | Composer`Z315o`/`MhM7z`/`i3glx`, waits`Z6U3T4`, validation`JX4dm`/`wXiWx`; reference optional disclosure is future behavior if absent |
| `/app/settings`, `/app/settings/projects/new`, `/app/settings/profiles/new`, `/app/profiles/:id/settings`, `/app/projects/:id/settings` | Setup/project/profile fields, native checks/selects, dirty/reload/review latest/reconcile/discard controls; routing candidates, credential preserve/set/clear, source rows/previews/refresh/repository/readiness/group errors/placement; exact retained-editor links | Shared `eIXDM`/`DOuyS`; no complete setup/config frames; preserve UI06 individual dispositions and document gap |
| `/app/settings/runtime`, `/app/assignments/:id/recovery` | Global/project cap/remove override, pending/recorded/unknown; read-only generations/independent holds/omission and exact recovery links | Shared Alert/Badge/Input/NativeSelect/Button; uncertainty`CTUzI`/`zeoGi` inform semantics, no full settings/recovery frame |
