nodes.body:
## Agent Brief — reconciled 3 October 2026

**Summary:** Qualify the assembled standalone release candidate.

#737 owns external-delivery implementation and focused provider-fault evidence. #736 owns the reviewed UI and Chris's final integrated visual/usability acceptance. Both are native prerequisites of this issue; the earlier combined S07 brief and #696-only prerequisite are superseded.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- [ ] Assemble the A01–A30/applicable R01–R10 evidence inventory, linking still-valid upstream evidence and recording missing, failed and deferred rows.
- [ ] Run the missing assembled delivery/provider journeys for handback, through-merge, feedback wakeups, restart and truthful UI outcomes on explicitly authorised test resources. Preserve all completion, approval, admission and recovery gates.
- [ ] #745 and #697 share one attributable evidence inventory. Reuse still-valid #739/#743 evidence and one bounded assembled UI/service/runtime journey across both gates. #697 adds the missing delivery/provider integration checks; it does not repeat the same UI journey merely because it is a later gate. Cover pause, Stop, restart, replay, failure and session-expiry combinations deterministically unless a changed integration boundary or demonstrated failure requires a bounded live check. Record the source/runtime identities and why reused evidence still applies. Final visual/usability acceptance remains with Chris on #736.
- [ ] Run pinned npm ci and npm run check for implementation changes, satisfy applicable review requirements and record fixture/process cleanup.

#704/#698 own operational preparation and final recovery; #761 owns actual separately authorised cutover. R03 physical sleep/wake evidence remains with #732 before operational use. X01–X08 remain deferred. This brief does not dispatch work or authorise external writes, merges or deployment.

<!-- to-plan:implementation-plan:v2 -->

**Revision:** 1
**Supersedes:** none
**Replan report:** none

## Implementation plan

**Issue:** https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/issues/697
**Planned against:** `main` at `8d8ad5c2c67cf492d82443574f1a426f1540d4c0` (clean detached planning checkout; no implementation branch created)
**Publication mode:** Autonomous
**Local state:** Clean
**Epoch closure:** null

### Approach

Qualify the assembled candidate by joining the existing delivery implementation to the production React/API presentation and durable service restart path. Reuse the qualified real S07a handback/through-merge and UI07 runtime journeys; add the missing deterministic connected provider/service/browser evidence, then consolidate A01–A30 and applicable R01–R10 in the existing shared release inventory. Repair only demonstrated integration regressions within the accepted contracts.

Authoritative scope is the live issue and its [reconciled Agent Brief](https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/issues/697#issuecomment-5896972084), with `docs/acceptance.md`, `docs/SPEC.md`, and ADR-1004/1005/1006/1007 supplying product contracts. Native prerequisites #737 and #736 are closed. #736 closed at `2026-10-04T20:20:50Z`; reconcile stale repository pending-review statements against that live completed gate, preserving historical evidence and dates rather than requesting another unchanged product review.

### Guardrails

- No new external operations, real Codex turns, paid routing calls, credential inspection, shared login/configuration changes, deployment or cutover are authorized by this plan. The S07a fixture grant expired; never reuse it. Use disposable synthetic provider state, fake runtime and isolated file-backed production SQLite. Preserve Haze and paused X01–X08.
- Keep #737's delivery implementation and #736's UI design ownership. Do not replace their implementations, introduce workflow stages, bypass policy, add a force-unlock path, or claim a stronger runtime boundary. Bound successful terminal status, ended Ensemble callbacks and absence of other holds/known unfinished execution remain the normal-success rule. Active children, unresolved effects and independent ownership/Stop/dependency holds prevent completion.
- Keep provider source identity/status separate from Ensemble execution; PR readiness, confirmed merge, operator settlement and Done are distinct. Operator writes remain restricted to the supported bound issue comment. Test agent merge requests through their actual bound callback, never by widening operator API authority.
- Reuse unaffected real-runtime/provider evidence with original source/runtime/harness identities and limitations. Do not relabel a deterministic response fixture as real GitHub or a fake runtime as Codex. A demonstrated failure or material integration repair invalidating a real transport boundary stops only that affected live claim: return the exact named resource, allowed operations/merge method, credential boundary, runtime-turn/time budget and cleanup grant required before rerunning it; continue independent deterministic work.
- Continue routine implementation and fixture corrections within unchanged requirements, coverage, architecture and authority; record the correction and renew affected evidence. A factual plan mismatch allows one diagnosis and two repair cycles; ordinary repairs do not consume that budget. Investigate unknown overlap; stop for material design/contract changes or exhausted grants.
- Reuse the existing delivery record and valid checks/reviews. Use an integration amendment only for a changed published integration decision requiring durable consumption; preserve repair budgets and grants. Keep all remote publication and Project/issue mutations with the root controller.

### Planning decisions

- The missing seam is production React/API visibility connected to both delivery modes and feedback/restart through real service/storage. `test/operator-review-browser.test.ts` currently exercises a review fixture with no bound PR; S07a's actual settlement browser used retained HTML. Existing focused delivery/store/provider tests alone do not supply this connected React journey.
- S07a evidence in `docs/evidence/s07a-github-delivery.md` records passing real handback/through-merge, failing CI with zero provider attempts, exactly one actual fixture squash merge, feedback, restart and cleanup at runtime source `3b4b14756cf09db180d8efefa2f723b647fc2d89`. UI07 records its single shared native journey at `f455679ce62f6284fece21d6f8f454b2c4488db4` and final deterministic projection at `566528decc2cb380ebf08298253bd6f99320164a`. Current operator-only authorization restrictions do not establish invalidation of either transport proof. No extra live proof is a default prerequisite.
- Use the highest practical deterministic seam: `StandaloneService`, real `GitHubHttpDeliveryProvider` fed scripted HTTP responses, authenticated `LocalOperatorHttp` with production `OperatorWebBoundary`/Vite bundle, browser actions and independent SQLite readback. A fetch dispatcher returning real `Response` objects is sufficient; it must intercept every provider request, reject unknown URLs/methods and never forward to global fetch. This tests production provider parsing/readback without credentials or external traffic. Explicit synthetic credential material may be supplied directly to the provider constructor through `providerFactory`, avoiding host environment changes.
- Keep the harness bounded to these scenarios, not a generic replay framework. Use the existing fixture lifecycle/browser diagnostics and domain/service/tool commands; direct SQLite is for independent assertions and deliberate negative fault setup, not to fabricate a successful delivery/completion.
- R03 physical sleep/wake remains deferred/unproved with #732. R06 fresh-database separation and existing #704 operations evidence can be linked; final operational recovery and separately authorized cutover remain with #698/#761. Candidate qualification must not claim operational release readiness.

### Implementation context

- **Existing:** `src/standalone/service.ts` — `StandaloneService`, `settleHandback`, `coordinationView`, and bound dynamic-tool handling wire PR registration, external actions, completion requests, delivery feedback and scheduler gates. `StandaloneServiceOptions.delivery.providerFactory` permits an injected production HTTP provider.
- **Existing:** `src/standalone/github-delivery.ts` — `GitHubHttpDeliveryProvider.inspectPr`, `preflight`, `performAction`, `inspectAction`, `inspectClosedIssue`, and `mergeGateReasons` validate provider payloads, actual exact-head rules and confirmed effects. `src/standalone/delivery.ts:DeliveryCoordinator` serializes refresh/settlement/completion and retained feedback.
- **Existing:** `src/core/delivery.ts:DeliveryStore` owns persisted binding/action/settlement state. Production database is `<data-directory>/standalone.sqlite`. A restart must reopen the same file with fresh service/runtime objects, not reseed or copy a success snapshot.
- **Existing:** `src/standalone/operator-api.ts:OperatorApi.deliveryProjection` and task read projection expose retained confirmed/stale/uncertain provider state. `web/src/task-workspace.tsx:Changes` renders exact PR/head/check/feedback/action state and says merged still requires completion. `web/src/task-views.tsx` and `web/src/app.tsx` share Overview, cross/project List/Board and Inbox destinations.
- **Follow:** `test/fixtures/operator-web.ts:createOperatorFixture`, `OperatorFixtureRuntime`, and `startWeb` for production bundle/API/auth/lifecycle composition; `test/delivery-fixture.ts:deliveryFixture` for unique bound thread/turn/tool identities and completion ordering; `test/pr-completion.test.ts` for handback/through-merge and own-closure assertions; `test/github-delivery-provider.test.ts` for scripted HTTP payloads; `test/fixtures/fixture-lifecycle.ts` and `test/fixtures/browser-diagnostics.ts` for bounded cleanup/evidence.
- **New:** `test/fixtures/s07b-delivery.ts` — a small shared `createReleaseDeliveryFixture` with scripted HTTP-provider state, write counters, controllable bound fake runtime, isolated service data/workspace/auth, production web startup and reopen-on-same-database lifecycle. No production fixture hook or additional dependency is required.
- **New:** `test/s07b-delivery-integration.test.ts` and `test/operator-delivery-integration-browser.test.ts` — connected service/provider/restart and production browser qualification. `docs/evidence/s07b-release-candidate.md` records this candidate's attributable integration results and evidence applicability.

### Implementation slices

**Task graph and parallelism:** `T1 -> T2 -> T3`; acyclic. T1/T2 share the fixture and browser test ownership; execute sequentially. T3 consumes their final evidence and updates the existing shared inventory. No independently ready implementation tasks or additional PR split are needed. One implementation owner retains repairs; independent integrated review follows final qualification under existing delivery requirements.

**Shared validation setup:** Commands below run from the implementation checkout rooted at `/Users/chris/dev/ensemble` or its controller-created clean implementation worktree. Verify Node `24.21.0` and npm `12.2.0` before installation. Current verified local tooling uses `PATH=/tmp/ensemble-drain-tools:/private/tmp/node-v24.21.0-darwin-arm64/bin:$PATH`; the npm wrapper reports `12.2.0`, including nested npm script execution. Verify `node --version` and `npm --version` after setting this PATH. The passive implementation slot already passed pinned `npm ci`; retain that evidence while its lockfile and tooling remain unchanged. Do not fall back to the ambient Node 26/npm 11. Equivalent verified pinned tooling is allowed. Run `npm ci`, `npx playwright install chromium` if the pinned browser is absent, and `npm run build` before focused compiled tests. Sandbox escalation is only for the failed local listen/browser/install command after concrete failure.

#### 1. Connected handback and durable production presentation

**Task ID:** `T1`
**Depends on:** `none`
**Prerequisites:** Closed #737/#736 and the clean baseline above; shared setup.
**Files and symbols:** New shared fixture and both integration test files; existing service/provider/API/React files are read-only unless this journey demonstrates a specific regression. Locate wiring through the context above.
**Test:** Start the real service against disposable file-backed SQLite, configure a synthetic reviewable-PR project and exact imported identity/repository grant, and admit an identified fake lead turn. The scripted provider supplies repository/PR/head/check/feedback and own-closure readback through production HTTP parsing. Register through `ensemble_register_pr`; exercise `ensemble_request_completion` and `ensemble_external_action` through the bound callback. Assert PR-ready is waiting/open, premature completion fails, handback merge makes zero provider writes, stale or denied exact material cannot settle, and a fresh authenticated operator settlement followed by eligible lead completion and successful terminal becomes Done. Completion before terminal/callback settlement is not Done. Use the existing retained operator settlement route where React has no equivalent; do not add a new React mutation surface for qualification.
**Implementation:** Compose a bounded fixture with fresh unique fake thread/turn identities, controllable terminals/callbacks and request counters; production provider receives only synthetic in-memory credentials and the exhaustive dispatcher. Mount the production web bundle and same-origin API using the existing fixture pattern. Browser signs in, opens `/app/tasks/<taskId>` and Changes, refreshes provider observation, and inspects exact PR identity/head/checks/actions plus waiting versus Done. Assert the same task execution/source truth through Overview, cross-project and project List/Board cards and any existing related Inbox destination; use shared route entry points/direct links, including phone task navigation. Do not invent attention for routine progress or dependency waiting. Reopen the same database with fresh service/runtime/web/auth objects after all owned active work is settled; assert retained settlement/history/identity and no duplicate operation/continuation. Independent SQLite readback verifies receipts before accepting browser success.
**Validate:** After shared setup run `node --test dist/test/s07b-delivery-integration.test.js dist/test/operator-delivery-integration-browser.test.js dist/test/pr-completion.test.js dist/test/delivery-operator.test.js dist/test/operator-review-browser.test.js`; expect the handback connected assertions and retained existing settlement/policy/auth tests to pass with zero handback merge effects and verified fixture cleanup.
**Complete when:** The production provider/service/API/React handback path and restart assertions pass; any observed defect is reproduced, repaired narrowly and affected evidence renewed.

#### 2. Through-merge, feedback continuation and conservative failure visibility

**Task ID:** `T2`
**Depends on:** `T1`
**Prerequisites:** T1's shared fixture/lifecycle and connected handback pass.
**Files and symbols:** Extend the same fixture and integration tests; preserve one owner. Any required repair is limited to the implicated existing delivery/service/API/React seam, with a meaningful regression.
**Test:** In a through-merge project, the current bound lead submits `pr.merge` with exact target/head/result identities. A failing exact-head required check makes zero simulated writes; after that check passes at the current head, a fresh operation makes exactly one simulated merge with exact readback. Replay/restart does not merge again. Confirmed merge still leaves task incomplete until a new eligible lead completion request, successful bound terminal and ended callback pass all existing gates. For an imported task use exact own-closure attribution/current source readiness; remote closure alone is not completion.
**Implementation:** Exercise one feedback identity changing check/review state, wake the retained task-scoped lead once, and verify unchanged polls/repeated observation/restart do not duplicate inbox work or turns. Pause before observation to inspect persisted feedback without dispatch; resume revalidates. Add deterministic changed-head settlement invalidation, provider outage and lost/unknown-effect response cases: fresh readback governs success, uncertain effects retain visible holds and no replay; unrelated task visibility remains usable. Include an active child and a worker successful result/terminal: neither can independently complete the parent. Cover task Stop and restart retaining independent holds, failed/denied exact-material approval and session expiry preserving input/no unauthorized effect using existing fixture precedents. Bound these to the issue's finite combinations rather than an exhaustive fault matrix.
Browser observes each transition through real API responses and production task Changes, source/execution header, relevant Overview/List/Board cards and existing attention Inbox links: failed current check, changed/stale head, feedback with literal identity, confirmed merge but incomplete task, provider read failure, uncertain action, persistent hold and eventual eligible Done. Refresh is read-only; stale reads never become confirmed success. Inspect both modes through shared desktop/phone destinations. Record which extension/retained HTML routes remain applicable; retained settlement controls keep the same policy and exact-material validation. No notification/native/deferred entry point is added.
**Validate:** Run `npm run build` then `node --test dist/test/s07b-delivery-integration.test.js dist/test/operator-delivery-integration-browser.test.js dist/test/pr-completion.test.js dist/test/delivery-feedback.test.js dist/test/delivery-service.test.js dist/test/github-delivery-provider.test.js dist/test/operator-comments-browser.test.js`; expect all connected and focused regressions to pass, failing gate zero effects, passing gate one simulated merge, durable feedback deduplication and no bypass/duplicate after restart. Browser diagnostics and lifecycle cleanup must settle on success and failure.
**Complete when:** Both modes and named failure/restart/control cases pass through production provider/service/storage/API/React, with exact effect/continuation counts and no unconfirmed Done claim.

#### 3. One attributable final candidate inventory and integrated qualification

**Task ID:** `T3`
**Depends on:** `T2`
**Prerequisites:** Final T1/T2 results, unchanged applicable upstream evidence and native completed gates.
**Files and symbols:** Extend `docs/evidence/release-candidate-inventory.json` without deleting/replacing original UI07 identities; add `docs/evidence/s07b-release-candidate.md`. Reconcile stale current-status prose in `docs/evidence/ui07-integrated-operator.md` and `docs/SPEC.md` only where it contradicts completed native gates; leave dated failed/historical results intact. No parallel delivery plan.
**Focused inventory check:** One-off validation requires exactly one A01–A30 and R01–R10 row, unique IDs, nonempty disposition and retrievable path/criterion/test references; do not add a permanent test that mirrors documentation shape. Reused results retain original source/runtime/provider identities and candidate-applicability rationale. New deterministic results name their final source/tree/bundle/test identities separately. Missing or failed required candidate evidence cannot count as passing. Explicitly retain physical R03 as deferred/unproved #732 and final R06 #698/#761 as outside this slice; neither may be silently promoted to pass or release-ready. Validate links/reference existence and make the final candidate identity externally attributable without a self-referential commit hash fiction.
**Implementation:** Map A01–A18/A25/A27/local A28/A30 and R01/R02/R04/R05/R07–R10 to still-valid S01–S05/UI evidence and their accepted limits; A19–A23/A29/GitHub A28/A30 to S06; A24/A26/completion fault extensions to S07a plus T1/T2; retain #704 and fresh-database R06 evidence separately from final operations. Review each original row's actual outcome, not merely a requirement label. Consolidate #745/#697 reuse in this existing shared inventory and record #736 completed at its actual closure time, with no fabricated review quote or stronger visual claim. Record source delta applicability, pinned checks, real versus deterministic scope, failures/repairs, desktop/phone/shared destination coverage, cleanup and remaining operational gates. When any required in-scope result is still missing/failed, preserve it and return one blocker report rather than declaring the candidate qualified.
**Validate:** Add the 40 candidate rows under the existing inventory's new `releaseCandidate.scenarios` key, each with `id`, `disposition` and `references` (repository-relative existing evidence/test paths); retain detailed attribution and applicability beside those fields. From the implementation checkout run this one-off command, then `git diff --check`. Expect exactly 40 unique scenario IDs, nonempty dispositions and real references. Review actual outcomes and retained identities against the issue finite items and `docs/acceptance.md` fault extensions; the command does not infer acceptance from structural validity.

```sh
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
root = Path.cwd()
inventory = json.loads((root / "docs/evidence/release-candidate-inventory.json").read_text())
rows = inventory["releaseCandidate"]["scenarios"]
expected = {f"A{i:02d}" for i in range(1, 31)} | {f"R{i:02d}" for i in range(1, 11)}
assert len(rows) == 40 and {row["id"] for row in rows} == expected
for row in rows:
    assert isinstance(row["disposition"], str) and row["disposition"].strip(), row["id"]
    assert row["references"], row["id"]
    for reference in row["references"]:
        path = Path(reference)
        assert not path.is_absolute() and ".." not in path.parts, reference
        assert (root / path).is_file(), reference
print("Validated 40 unique scenario rows, nonempty dispositions and existing references")
PY
```

**Complete when:** All in-scope candidate rows have accepted attributable evidence, authorized deferrals/outside-slice dispositions are explicit, affected source/full checks and independent integrated review pass, and no operational release/cutover claim is made.

### Acceptance coverage

| Acceptance criterion | Slice | Verification |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Finite 1: A01–A30/applicable R01–R10 complete inventory; reused evidence, failures and deferrals visible | T3 | One-off 40-row mapping check, evidence/source-delta review, S07b report |
| Finite 2: Missing assembled handback/through-merge, feedback, restart and truthful provider/UI outcomes | T1, T2 | Connected production HTTP-provider/service/SQLite/API/React tests; exact effect counts and persisted restart assertions |
| Finite 3: Reuse completed UI gate and shared #745/#697 native journey; preserve policy, admission, exact approvals and independent holds | T1–T3 | Shared destination/control assertions, existing approval/policy regressions, unchanged UI07 identities and #736 completion provenance |
| Finite 4: Pinned installation/full checks, applicable independent review and cleanup | T1–T3 | Focused tests, fixture lifecycle evidence, final commands and exact-candidate integrated review |
| R03/R06 and deferred X scope retain their release boundaries | T3 | Explicit #732 physical proof, #698/#761 final ops/cutover and X01–X08 dispositions; candidate qualification never implies operational release |

### Final validation

- From the implementation checkout with the verified pinned tooling, run `npm ci`, `npm run test:fixture-preflight`, `npm run check` and `git diff --check`. Expect installation, type checking, lint, formatting, production service/web build, preflight and complete deterministic suite success; record actual counts and cleanup. No full live rerun is scheduled without invalidation and new exact authority.
- Baseline evidence: controller-verified latest main push [CI run 37291959844](https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/actions/runs/37291959844), independently refetched job `111704200250` completed/success with pinned install, Chromium, preflight and full check steps successful. Planning checkout has clean status and `git diff --check`; Node `24.21.0`/npm `12.2.0` verified locally. No redundant planning full check was run; implementation owns final candidate checks above.
- Obtain independent integrated review under the existing standards/correctness, reuse/clarity/efficiency and overengineering delivery contracts; repair findings with the same implementation owner, renew affected tests and review, and require final-head remote gates. The root controller owns publication/merge and final acceptance.

### Review focus

- Synthetic HTTP responses must traverse the production provider, reject unhandled requests and never escape to real GitHub. New browser assertions must observe live service projections, not injected UI JSON or success seeded directly in SQLite.
- Completion, own-closure and feedback counts must bind exact task/assignment/work/conversation/head/revision identities across fresh service objects. Runtime success, merged provider state or routing output alone is insufficient.
- Evidence reuse must preserve historical identities and failed checkpoints while fixing stale current gate status; deterministic integration coverage must not be advertised as newly observed live transport or operational readiness.

S07b qualification found a concrete assembled restart defect at baseline `8d8ad5c2c67cf492d82443574f1a426f1540d4c0`: delivery feedback queued while paused retains its task material, but startup provider-readiness invalidation/revalidation advances the task revision and terminally refuses that never-admitted continuation. A bounded independent investigation reproduced zero resumed turns despite eligible current admission; the same sequence without restart continues normally. Feedback and predecessor history remain persisted.

The existing implementation owner is repairing this under the [published plan](https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/issues/697#issuecomment-5994598567). The narrow route may supersede only queued, never-admitted inbox work with unchanged material and non-derived policy snapshots after complete source reconciliation, retaining immutable old captures and binding one fresh generation to the same logical event. Held/admitted execution, material or permission changes, Stop, ownership and uncertain-effect holds keep their existing refusal/recovery rules. No R1/R2 predicate expansion or additional real provider/runtime attempt is authorized or claimed.

#697 remains exclusively claimed In progress; connected browser checks, the complete acceptance inventory, final checks and independent integrated review remain pending. Earlier qualified S07a and UI07 transport evidence remains attributed to its original inputs; final operational recovery and cutover remain with #698/#761.

content.title: S06: Discover GitHub tasks with complete native dependencies

nodes.body:
> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Agent Brief

**Category:** enhancement  
**Summary:** Discover GitHub issue tasks from configured sources and enforce complete native dependency observations before dispatch.

**Current behavior:** The standalone service has local tasks and explicit local dependencies; GitHub source discovery, canonical cross-source identity and complete provider blocker reads are not implemented. #695 is the local qualification prerequisite; #697 owns external writes.

**Desired behavior:** Configured repository, search and Project selections discover eligible issues with provenance and one external identity across overlapping sources, without making a source the owner of project policy or repository execution permission. Exclude PRs/drafts. Preserve existing placement and ownership across cross-project conflicts, partial outages, withdrawal and scope changes. Complete native blocker observations, including outside selection, gate new execution; unknown or incomplete reads hold it, while confirmed changes re-evaluate the gate without discarding active ownership or results.

**Key interfaces:** Project-scoped source configuration, canonical external references and memberships; GitHub paginated reads/native dependencies; existing local-task, admission and routing path; UI synchronization/hold views. Keep imported GitHub dependency authority distinct from operator-authored local task edges.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- [ ] Deterministic provider fixtures cover pagination, overlap/deduplication, PR/draft exclusion, partial reads, withdrawal/readiness changes and cross-project conflicts without inferred repository access.
- [ ] Initial and later incomplete blocker reads hold dispatch; complete closure/removal, reopening, mid-work addition and unreadable imported blockers produce the scoped admission behavior in #696.
- [ ] A bounded read-only test against a designated repository/Project proves discovery-to-admission and visible sync/hold state. Missing fixture or read access remains an explicit prerequisite; this issue does not authorise writes to create fixtures.
- [ ] Record provider/runtime identity and limitations; run pinned `npm ci` and `npm run check`.

**Out of scope:** External issue/PR writes and provider-effect reconciliation (#697), a full repository/transitive-graph crawl, import of Haze's live queue, a task-owner role or source-granted policy/permissions.

**Delivery boundary:** #695 is the native blocker; remain in Backlog until it passes. Follow #696's finite acceptance checklist and #649's live delivery authority.

<!-- run-github-project:planning-claim:v1 -->

Controller selected #696 from the complete refreshed Project6/native graph after verified #731 merge and #695 completion. Project item `PVTI_lAHOAAN4ns4BatgHzg9DUi8` remains Planning and is exclusively assigned to chrisbanes. Base main is `0a4240df5e91a4feb584788600822834887912c0`; committed configuration SHA256 `ee3757e300342c59fb3377a136e0d38fee789863e8daec8c6dc4634869f184c4`. There are no open implementation PRs or marked implementation plans for #696. #695's required outcome exists in this baseline.

Chris explicitly waived authoritative Project event-history requirements earlier in this run. Selection therefore uses complete current provider status plus runner checkpoints, not a claimed historical transition. The ranker's Planning timestamp is explicitly a current-state observation (2026-10-01T08:00:11Z), not an event; any new plan will be published after this observation.

Invoke to-plan --auto against the canonical #696 contract in the dedicated clean detached planning checkout. Planner profile: workhorse-owner, runtime default role with configured gpt-6-sol/high. Planner owns only read-only discovery and its exact temporary draft; root retains all GitHub/Project publication and mutation ownership. No fixture creation, Haze import, external writes, provider spending or integration-permission expansion is authorised.

<!-- to-plan:implementation-plan:v2 -->

**Revision:** 1
**Supersedes:** none
**Replan report:** none

## Implementation plan

**Issue:** https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/issues/696
**Planned against:** `main` at `0a4240df5e91a4feb584788600822834887912c0` (clean detached planning checkout of main)
**Publication mode:** Autonomous
**Local state:** Clean

### Approach

Add one read-only GitHub.com source adapter, durable project-scoped selections and provider observations, and a transactional reconciler. An issue has one provider-instance/node identity and one Ensemble task placement regardless of the selections that find it. Complete source and native-blocker observations update admission; partial reads retain prior membership and hold affected dispatch. Feed eligible imported tasks through the existing lead/assignment router and supervisor. Show source, conflict, and hold evidence through the existing authenticated operator surface. Qualify provider mapping with deterministic faults and one bounded read-only prepared fixture.

### Guardrails

- #696 owns discovery and native dependency reads; #697 owns external writes/effect reconciliation. No provider mutation, fixture creation, Haze import, prototype change, deployment, cutover, or new task-owner role.
- Source membership grants neither project placement nor repository execution permission. The operator-configured authoritative readiness rule can mark a selected issue Ready; another source's membership cannot. Keep local tasks and operator-authored local edges. Imported issues use native GitHub edges only; no operator `imported-blockers.set` override may clear an imported gate.
- Existing S04/S05 admission, routing, lead accountability, Stop/crash/writer holds and the approved successful-terminal trust boundary remain in force. A complete source read alone never bypasses another gate. Current admitted turns may finish after a new source hold; ownership and results persist.
- The designated prepared test repository/Project and a service-readable, read-only GitHub credential reference are **missing execution prerequisites** at planning time. Inventory found no designated fixture/configuration and no matching GitHub/test key names in `~/.env`; the connected read identity and production Project 6 are not a service credential or a disposable fixture. Obtain exact fixture IDs, prepared dependency cases and a least-privilege credential path before T6's live check. Do not turn that missing prerequisite into a provider write or claim the check passed.
- A **wrong-plan seam** means a disproved current file/symbol/flow assumption or incompatible source contract. Diagnose it once and allow at most two bounded repair edit-and-validation cycles within this fixed plan; stop for a material design/contract or overlapping-baseline change or exhausted budget, with evidence. Ordinary implementation, integration, fixture, test and CI defects are delivery-worker work and remain at their applicable progress gate; normal test-first cycles do not use this plan-repair budget.

### Planning decisions

- Use immutable GitHub issue node identity qualified by `github.com`, independent of repository URL or selection; persist repository and field provenance separately. GitHub REST issues include PR-shaped records, so filter `pull_request`; ProjectV2 item content distinguishes `Issue`, `PullRequest` and `DraftIssue`. [GitHub issues API](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/issues/issues), [Projects GraphQL reference](https://docs.github.com/en/graphql/reference/projects).
- Treat a selection as complete only after its final REST link / GraphQL cursor page, nested ProjectV2 item field-values pages, required Project field-definition pages and all required issue reads validate. Pass the operator's Project filter unchanged to the documented `ProjectV2.items(query:)` API; validate it with a read-only preview before activation and show the returned sample/count/validation error. Do not implement a competing local filter grammar or treat a partial preview as complete selection. GitHub Search's result cap, page failure, invalid payload, permission denial or rate limit means incomplete, never a withdrawal signal. Reconcile all configured selections periodically and after explicit operator refresh; a duplicate/missed observation converges without duplicate task or execution. [GitHub Project query API](https://docs.github.com/en/graphql/reference/projects), [Project filter syntax](https://docs.github.com/en/issues/planning-and-tracking-with-projects/customizing-views-in-your-project/filtering-projects).
- Read each selected imported issue's complete native `blocked_by` pages and the current status of each returned blocker, even outside configured sources/projects. On missing/partial/inaccessible observations persist `unknown`; do not crawl the transitive graph. GitHub's read endpoint is `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{number}/dependencies/blocked_by` with pagination. [GitHub dependency API](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/issues/issue-dependencies).
- Keep imported blocker closure observation separate from Ensemble task completion. This lets a local task depend on an imported task and release on confirmed GitHub closure while an externally closed imported task itself receives no new turns. `domain_tasks.importedBlockers` is currently only an operator-set aggregate; replace imported gating with provider-owned detailed observations while retaining local edge authority and migration compatibility.
- A complete selection withdrawal does not erase an imported task still named by an operator-authored local edge. Refresh that retained blocker by its exact stored GitHub issue reference on startup and each reconciliation, even outside every selection; verify the returned node/repository identity and persist open/closed or unknown on failed/mismatched reads. This is a finite read of referenced blockers, not a repository/transitive crawl or new task import.
- A complete conflict across projects creates an operator-visible placement decision and holds newly unowned work. A task with established assignments stays in its original project with assignment/result authority intact; a later overlapping selection alone adds no conflict gate to that owned work. Never transfer it or union permissions. An existing placement without assignments is unowned for this conflict rule and waits for the operator's placement decision.
- Classify unchanged imported title/body with label/field-only updates under the configured readiness rule as ordinary observation. Any changed title/body is an unclassified possible scope change: retain the admitted title/body fingerprint, hold new work and show a review request. Only an operator-only, versioned `source.review` command bound to the observed digest can classify it as a harmless clarification or accept a revised scope; stale decisions fail. A separate versioned `source.review` resolution for withdrawal/readiness/closure holds also requires current complete source evidence and never clears other gates. This is a conservative implementation choice, not semantic inference from text.

### Implementation context

- **Existing:** `src/core/domain.ts` — `DomainStore.migrate`, `task.create`, `task.configure`, `dependencies`, `admission`, `assignmentAdmission`, `readyTasksWithLead` and `recordRouting` own SQLite task state, local edges, revisions and routing admission. New imported state must participate in those same admission reads/transactions.
- **Existing:** `src/core/store.ts` — `Store.ensureHost` owns base `tasks`/`projects` tables; `DomainStore.migrate` owns current domain schema. `src/standalone/service.ts` — `StandaloneService.start`, `wakeScheduler`, `attemptRequest` and `handleToolCall` wire startup, routing, turn admission and delegation. `src/core/coordination.ts` — `CoordinationStore.delegate` rechecks `domain.admission` inside the durable callback transaction; `ensureRoutingFallbackEvent` is a durable event pattern.
- **Existing:** `src/standalone/operator.ts` — `LocalOperatorUi.project/task/submit`, `LocalOperatorHttp` and `COMMANDS` own authenticated configuration/task views and operator commands; `src/standalone/operator-coordination.ts` renders task/assignment coordination; `src/standalone/cli.ts` composes the production service/operator. `src/standalone/operator-routes.ts` permits authenticated nonreserved extension routes if needed.
- **New:** `src/standalone/github-source.ts` — validated `GitHubSourceReader` and `GitHubHttpSourceReader` for complete repository/search/Project selections, issue snapshots and complete native blocker snapshots; injectable fetch for tests. `src/core/github-source.ts` — selection/external-reference/observation types plus durable `GitHubSourceStore`/reconciliation, provider-owned import and conflict/hold read models. `src/standalone/github-sync.ts` — serialized `GitHubSynchronizer` that reads then commits a complete generation and wakes the existing scheduler. Names denote planned symbols, not existing ones.
- **Follow:** `test/domain.test.ts:fixture`, `test/operator-http.test.ts` and `test/core-standalone.test.ts` for real SQLite, fake runtime and authenticated HTTP patterns; `src/standalone/routing.ts:routingClientFromEnvironment` for keeping environment credential references outside public reads; `docs/evidence/s05-local-qualification.md` for evidence dispositions and limits.

### Implementation slices

**Task graph and parallelism:** `T1 → T2 → T3 → T4 → T5 → T6` is acyclic. These increments share the new source contract and then `domain.ts`/`service.ts`; execute them in order rather than concurrently. Within a slice, adapter fixtures and UI documentation may be prepared separately only after its interface is fixed; keep one integrator for shared files.

#### 1. Persist operator-owned source configuration

**Task ID:** `T1`
**Depends on:** `none`
**Prerequisites:** none.
**Files and symbols:** Edit `src/core/domain.ts` (`DomainStore.migrate`, project configuration/read methods), `src/standalone/operator.ts` (`LocalOperatorUi.project/submit`, `COMMANDS`), `src/standalone/service.ts` (`StandaloneService.provisionTask`), and `test/workspaces.test.ts`/`test/standalone.test.ts` only where the public provisioning entrypoint needs coverage; create `src/core/github-source.ts` configuration types/store and `test/github-source-config.test.ts`.
**Test:** In real SQLite, create two Ensemble projects and configure repository, search and ProjectV2 selections (including raw Project filter text) with stable IDs, one operator-linked repository binding (`repositoryId`, canonical local Git path, ref and Git identity) and a `env:NAME` credential reference. Reopen: exact selections, readiness rule, linked repository binding and version/receipt conflicts survive. The readiness fixture is `{mode:"all",conditions:[{kind:"label",name:"ready"},{kind:"project-field",projectNodeId:"P",fieldNodeId:"F",optionNodeId:"O"}]}`; `mode:"any"` is also accepted, nested rules rejected. Through public `StandaloneService.provisionTask`, an imported task discovered from a source-only repository rejects that repository ID/path/ref and an arbitrary local path; the identical imported task provisions when the operator links that exact repository binding. A repository-free local task and existing explicit local-task provisioning still work. Assert no secret value appears in reads/HTML and agent commands cannot configure sources/readiness. Red: current `provisionTask` passes caller-supplied repository tuples straight to `WorkspaceManager.provision`.
**Implementation:** Add versioned operator-only project source and linked-repository configuration with runtime validation, stable selection IDs and opaque credential references. At configuration, verify the linked local path is an existing Git repository and resolve its canonical path/Git common-directory identity plus ref; do not clone/fetch. Persist selections inactive until their native query/filter has a successful read-only preview in T2; that preview is validation, not a completeness claim. At `StandaloneService.provisionTask(taskId,repositories)`, identify imported tasks through `DomainStore`, require each requested repository ID/path/ref to equal an explicitly linked binding for that task's project, reverify local Git identity/path/ref, and only then call `WorkspaceManager.provision`; never derive a workspace repository from the issue URL or source membership. Preserve repository-free and existing explicit local-task provisioning behavior. Add operator forms/commands with existing idempotency, expected-version, session/CSRF and `DomainConflictError` behavior. Store one flat per-project authoritative readiness rule: `mode:"all"|"any"` over nonempty `label` or `project-field` conditions identified by Project/field/option IDs; matching complete fields can make an imported task Ready, while missing/unreadable fields cannot. No nested expression or generic plugin contract.
**Validate:** From repository root, run `npm run build && node --test dist/test/github-source-config.test.js`; expect the configuration, authority, secret-exclusion and reopen assertions to pass.
**Complete when:** The operator can persist/read source selections and linked execution repositories without granting authority through discovery.

#### 2. Read and validate complete GitHub selections

**Task ID:** `T2`
**Depends on:** `T1`
**Prerequisites:** T1's stored selection and credential-reference shape.
**Files and symbols:** Create `src/standalone/github-source.ts` (`GitHubSourceReader`, `GitHubHttpSourceReader`, `previewSelection`, `readIssueStatus`, typed `SelectionSnapshot`, `IssueSnapshot`, `BlockerSnapshot`) and `test/github-source-reader.test.ts`; edit `src/standalone/operator.ts`/`src/core/github-source.ts` for authenticated preview and activation and add only the concrete startup credential lookup needed in `src/standalone/service.ts` or `github-sync.ts`.
**Test:** Injectable fake HTTP pages: repository issue list, search pages and ProjectV2 item, nested field-value and field-definition cursors return one issue from all three selections, a PR, a draft, a disallowed-repository issue and duplicate pages. Preview passes the exact `status:ready` Project filter as `items(query:)`, reports sample/validation result, and activates only the matching versioned selection; unsupported/bad query remains inactive. Assert one canonical issue ID with three provenance/membership records; no PR/draft/disallowed import. `readIssueStatus` on an exact retained reference returns open/closed only for matching node/repository identity; mismatched identity, 404 and unreadable results are unknown. Inject page 2/nested field page failure, invalid field, 403/429, search-cap truncation and missing credential: each snapshot is incomplete with a bounded reason, not an empty complete set. Assert only GET/GraphQL query transport, bounded page/read limits and no credential in errors. Red: reader absent.
**Implementation:** Validate every external payload with Zod or equivalent runtime schemas; normalize `github.com` node IDs, repository ID/full name, issue fields/labels, Project item/field IDs and source provenance. Pass native issue search/Project filter syntax to GitHub; preview before enabling a versioned selection without treating the preview as complete reconciliation. Follow complete REST `Link` and GraphQL `pageInfo` cursors, including nested Project field values/definitions; reject a search result set beyond GitHub's complete accessible window rather than treating it as exhaustive. Exclude PR/draft before reconciliation. Read `blocked_by` separately and completely for each selected issue, including blocker `node_id`, current repository ID/name/issue number and status from an exact issue fetch even when outside selection; retain those fields as provenance. Expose `readIssueStatus` for exact retained references, verifying returned provider/node/repository identity and returning unknown on errors/mismatch. Keep credentials as environment-resolved request headers and sanitize errors.
**Validate:** From repository root, run `npm run build && node --test dist/test/github-source-reader.test.js`; expect all complete and injected-incomplete snapshots to pass without network.
**Complete when:** The reader returns typed complete snapshots or explicit incomplete status with provenance, never silently truncated membership/dependency data.

#### 3. Reconcile canonical tasks, memberships and placement

**Task ID:** `T3`
**Depends on:** `T2`
**Prerequisites:** T2's validated complete/incomplete selection snapshots.
**Files and symbols:** Extend `src/core/github-source.ts` (`GitHubSourceStore.reconcileSelection`, external identity/membership/placement/conflict reads) and `src/core/domain.ts` (`DomainStore` provider-only imported upsert and task reads); create `test/github-reconciliation.test.ts`.
**Test:** Real SQLite sequence: complete overlapping repository/search/Project reads create one imported task and three memberships; duplicate retry/reopen creates no second task/assignment. Remove one membership in a complete generation: two remain and history is unchanged. Partial/outage generation: no membership is removed and sync state becomes incomplete. Complete withdrawal/readiness change and provider closure retain identity/results and hold new work. Two projects discover same issue: new unowned conflict blocks; operator placement picks one project; later overlap retains the assigned original task without a conflict-only hold or permission union. Local task remains visible. Red: no canonical tables/reconciler.
**Implementation:** Add unique `(providerInstance,nodeId)` identity, source membership/generation and provider-field provenance tables, sync status and placement-decision records with database constraints. Commit each complete selection diff atomically; incomplete generations only update observability/holds. Make imported provider fields and Ready read-only to `task.configure`; provider observations change imported task version/control revision only when effective values change. Keep existing local tasks/edges untouched. Expose an operator-only, versioned placement decision for unowned work and deny transfer once assignments exist.
**Validate:** From repository root, run `npm run build && node --test dist/test/github-reconciliation.test.js`; expect identity, membership, conflict and restart assertions to pass.
**Complete when:** Complete source generations converge on one placed task without false withdrawal or cross-project permission union.

#### 4. Make native dependency completeness an admission gate

**Task ID:** `T4`
**Depends on:** `T3`
**Prerequisites:** T3's canonical imported identity and source transactions.
**Files and symbols:** Extend `src/core/github-source.ts` (provider-owned blocker observation/state), `src/core/domain.ts` (`DomainStore.admission`, local dependency evaluation, imported-blocker command restrictions); create `test/github-dependencies.test.ts`.
**Test:** Real SQLite plus fake reader: newly Ready imported issue with initial first-page error remains unknown and creates no eligible assignment; complete empty blocker list clears; complete open outside-selection blocker holds without importing it or granting repository access; closure/removal clears only this gate; reopening reapplies it. Repeat incomplete read after prior clear. Create a local Ready task with an operator-authored edge to imported blocker B; fully withdraw B from every selection, then observe B open → confirmed closed → reopened → unreadable through exact status reads. Assert the local task stays held, releases only on the confirmed closure while other gates permit, re-holds on reopen/read failure, and never treats the old closed cache as clearance; B is retained as an edge reference without a new imported task or repository grant. Repeat across service restart before first refresh. Add edge/blocker during active turn: that turn may finish, queued/new turn and delegation remain held after reopen; results/ownership remain. Red: current aggregate can be set clear without complete provider evidence.
**Implementation:** Persist complete/unknown native edge generations and exact blocker state, including outside-selection references; never author local edges for native imports. Make default initial imported dependency status unknown. Query `local_dependencies` for retained imported blocker task IDs even when their source memberships are empty; resolve their stored exact external references through T2 `readIssueStatus` and persist identity-verified open/closed/unknown observations. On startup mark provider-derived clear/closed observations unknown until refreshed so stale persisted status cannot dispatch. Change `admission` to use provider state and external-closure status in the same transaction as local and other gates; disable imported `imported-blockers.set` bypass. Advance dependent task control revisions on newly effective hold/clear so stale routing/queued decisions cannot dispatch. A confirmed refresh re-evaluates all other gates.
**Validate:** From repository root, run `npm run build && node --test dist/test/github-dependencies.test.js`; expect every named A28/A29/A30 gate and restart assertion to pass.
**Complete when:** Initial/subsequent incomplete reads and mid-work native changes hold dispatch; only complete confirmed state releases the corresponding blocker.

#### 5. Wire periodic discovery into existing lead, routing and supervision

**Task ID:** `T5`
**Depends on:** `T4`
**Prerequisites:** T4's provider-owned admission verdict and control revisions.
**Files and symbols:** Create `src/standalone/github-sync.ts` (`GitHubSynchronizer`); edit `src/standalone/service.ts` (`StandaloneService.start/stop/wakeScheduler/attemptRequest`), `src/core/github-source.ts` (source-hold/review state), `src/core/domain.ts` (`source.review` command/admission), `src/core/coordination.ts` (idempotent source-hold notice to lead/active assignees), `src/standalone/operator.ts` (`LocalOperatorUi.submit`, `COMMANDS`), `src/standalone/cli.ts` (service composition), and `test/github-service.test.ts`.
**Test:** Fake reader/runtime and real service SQLite/filesystem: a configured Ready issue with complete empty blockers enters the existing routing-enabled initial-assignment path (no preliminary lead turn); routing-disabled uses task-scoped lead; explicit permitted assignee bypass still works. Failed/partial refresh keeps old memberships and holds affected dispatch; confirmed withdrawal, lost readiness, closure or changed title/body emits one durable safe-stop notice to lead and active assignees and holds new delegation. Unchanged title/body with label/field clarification follows current configured readiness; changed text stays held until `source.review` classifies its exact observed digest. Stale or agent review requests fail, and matching operator retry replays one receipt. Simulate timer/missed event, duplicate refresh, stop/restart and delayed route result: one task/assignment, no stale launch, no cleared independent Stop/unknown-execution hold. Red: service does not run source refresh or feed imports to scheduler.
**Implementation:** Serialize source refreshes per configured selection **and** the finite set of retained imported tasks currently referenced by local edges; persist observations before waking `wakeScheduler`, bound polling and allow explicit operator refresh. At startup mark provider-derived gates unknown and complete the initial applicable reads after service recovery but before the first scheduler wake, so old clear/closed evidence cannot launch work; failed reads leave only affected tasks held. Stop/cancel timer cleanly. Reuse `DomainStore.readyTasksWithLead`, `recordRouting`, `assignmentAdmission`, `CoordinationStore.delegate` and supervisor admission checks. Add source-specific notice event with stable idempotency key and visible disposition; do not force-cancel an already admitted turn. Add `source.review` to `DomainStore`/`LocalOperatorUi.submit`/`COMMANDS`: operator actor, task ID, expected task version, current observed digest and decision (`clarification`, `accept-revised-scope`, `resume-source-hold`). Recheck current complete source/readiness evidence and leave independent gates intact. Confirmed own-delivery closure is the only automatic source-hold resolution.
**Validate:** From repository root, run `npm run build && node --test dist/test/github-service.test.js`; expect existing routing/admission path and negative hold/restart assertions to pass.
**Complete when:** Imported eligibility uses the established S04 path and all source changes respect current ownership, routing and supervision.

#### 6. Show synchronization and qualify the bounded read-only boundary

**Task ID:** `T6`
**Depends on:** `T5`
**Prerequisites:** T5 integrated service; designated prepared test repository/Project, exact read-only credential reference and dependency cases supplied for the live check. If absent, finish deterministic work, record this required live check as unproved and report the missing prerequisite once; do not create it.
**Files and symbols:** Edit `src/standalone/operator.ts` (`LocalOperatorUi.project/task`, authenticated refresh/placement forms), `src/standalone/operator-coordination.ts` (task hold/status display), `src/standalone/coordination-view.ts` if its typed view needs source status; create `test/github-operator.test.ts`, `test/s06/live-github.mjs`, `docs/evidence/s06-github-discovery.md`; update `docs/SPEC.md` and `README.md` only for behavior/status changed by this slice.
**Test:** Authenticated HTTP/Chromium test with real SQLite: project/task pages show each selection's last complete/partial sync, provenance, current memberships, unresolved cross-project placement, native open/unknown/closed blockers and admission reasons; local task still appears. Escape external title/body/field values; unauthenticated GET and bad Origin/CSRF POST cannot read/mutate source controls. Red: views lack sync/conflict/hold state. Live script reads only the designated fixture's configured repository/search/Project, verifies exact prepared overlapping issue and static open/closed/removed native dependency cases, imports into disposable local service, checks source-to-admission and UI held/eligible state with a fake runtime, and asserts zero provider writes. content.title: S05: Qualify the complete standalone local-task journey

nodes.body:
> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Agent Brief

**Category:** enhancement  
**Summary:** Qualify the assembled standalone local-task journey across the service, authenticated UI and actual Codex runtime.

**Current behavior:** S02–S04 slices own components and bounded proofs separately. Their completion alone does not establish the integrated local milestone. #694 is the native prerequisite; GitHub discovery and external delivery remain later slices.

**Desired behavior:** An operator can set up disposable project work, start Ready local tasks, route or allocate work, delegate, inspect separate task-scoped lead/assignee histories, revise and follow up, receive results, and complete work through service gates. The integrated service preserves admissions, workspaces, messages, controls and uncertainty across restart, and presents truthful access and recovery limits.

**Key interfaces:** Existing S02–S04 service/runtime/UI contracts and evidence; scenario IDs A01–A18, A25, A27, local A28/A30 and R01–R10 as scoped by #695 and the acceptance plan. Reuse valid slice evidence; record a result for each required local scenario rather than assuming a component pass proves integration.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- [ ] Run disposable repository and repository-free end-to-end journeys through actual Codex and the authenticated UI, including delegation, review/revision, result destinations and lead-requested completion.
- [ ] Cover enabled/disabled routing, explicit bypass, fallback, busy queue, retained repair assignee, capacity-one return and separate simultaneous task histories. Representative live TypeSafe calls require separately enabled credentials, project access and a declared budget; deterministic tests cover control flow meanwhile.
- [ ] Inject the documented admission, duplicate, restart, failure and hold cases; verify cooperative normal handoff, conservative crash/Stop/uncertainty holds, approval-flow integration, policy disclosure and no prototype data import. A demonstrated policy breach blocks the affected claim.
- [ ] Verify private login/session/CSRF, service restart and bounded authorised sleep/wake behavior. Host-wide sleep needs a safe agreed test window or environment; record it as a gap until available. Return one evidence report with exact versions, pass/fail/unproved results and cleanup. Run pinned `npm ci` and `npm run check` for changes.

**Out of scope:** GitHub-dependent scenarios (#696–#697), backup/restore and cutover (#704/#698), exhaustive fault combinations, strict outside-read denial, universal descendant termination or physical writer exclusion after qualified normal success.

**Delivery boundary:** #694 is the native blocker. Remain in Backlog until it passes. Separately authorised live access or spend is not granted by the `ready-for-agent` label; required checks that cannot yet be run remain explicit gaps, not passes.

Controller authorization checkpoint: Chris explicitly authorized at most **four `jev-1.13.0` TypeSafe provider calls** for this ticket's representative live routing validation, using the existing `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` and disposable task briefs. The call limit is not a monetary spending cap; provider charges were disclosed. This allowance is reserved for S05 validation, not agent-profile selection or unrelated tasks. Keep credentials out of records/logs/UI, count attempted calls (including retries) against the cap, and report actual usage/latency/errors and available cost information without inventing cost or savings. No shared configuration/login, deployment, prototype/Haze access, or host sleep/reboot is authorized by this checkpoint. Physical sleep/wake remains a separate pending test-window prerequisite; continue independent authorized work.

Superseded by [revision 2](https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/issues/695#issuecomment-5926864838). Original semantic payload is preserved below.

<details>
<summary>Superseded revision 1</summary>

<!-- to-plan:implementation-plan:v2 -->

**Revision:** 1
**Supersedes:** none
**Replan report:** none

## Implementation plan

**Issue:** https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/issues/695
**Planned against:** `main` at `31e800a68fe45dd50d1d16f442a818dbcad8cfc3`
**Publication mode:** Autonomous
**Local state:** Clean (dedicated detached planning checkout of committed main)

### Approach

Close the actual conversation-history gap, qualify the production approval bridge, then run two bounded actual-Codex/Chromium local journeys. Reuse unchanged S02–S04 proofs with explicit scenario mapping. Produce one finite local-milestone evidence report. Prepare physical-sleep validation independently, but do not run it without a safe approved window. The controller owns the separately authorized four-call TypeSafe run.

### Guardrails

- Preserve bound-successful-terminal, ended Ensemble callbacks and no-other-hold normal handoff. History is diagnostic, never admission, completion, live-reattachment or ownership-release proof. Crash/Stop/failed/ambiguous execution and unfinished callbacks retain holds.
- No Haze/prototype database/history import, shared Codex configuration/login changes, other-machine access, container installation, reboot, deployment or cutover. GitHub scenarios and backup/restore/cutover remain S06–S08.
- Capture a narrow conversation view, not a provider dump: completed assistant text from validated agent-message events, already public brief/operator-message DTOs and identity/status metadata. Preserve S04d's exclusion of runtime prompts, private instructions, workspace paths and credential references. Do not expose `request.prompt`, reasoning, raw tool arguments/results, command output, account events, arbitrary item fields or provider error bodies. No transcript goes to TypeSafe.
- Sanitize completed assistant messages as a whole before any SQLite parameter/render; incomplete delta text remains memory-only. Show active metadata, not token-by-token text. Exclude known declared credentials/private control values and conventional credential-bearing forms; disclose no unknown-secret immunity or separate secrecy/sandbox boundary. Preserve broad-read/temporary-root/ambient-access disclosures and S01 unproved model-originated escalation rejection.
- Paid routing authority is exactly [the recorded authorization](https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/issues/695#issuecomment-5916722689): at most four actual `jev-1.13.0` calls total with the existing `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` and disposable task briefs, including retries. This is a call cap, not a monetary cap. Controller launches them; worker must not spend calls during implementation/tests. No persistent billing/project configuration outside fixtures.
- Host-wide sleep is not authorized; require one agreed safe window/environment before actual `pmset sleepnow`. Missing required check/access is an explicit unproved gap, never a pass or excuse to stop independent work.
- Model execution uses existing operator Codex login. Task file edits are disposable only. Cleanup owns exact created fixtures/processes/listeners and verifies exact App Server exit before removing roots; provider threads may remain. No unrelated deletion or shared Serve mutation.
- A demonstrated selected-policy breach blocks its affected claim. Do not expand the finite checklist to fault/tool/profile Cartesian matrices, exhaustive tooling, strict outside-read denial or universal descendant containment.
- For mechanical mismatches within this fixed contract, allow one focused diagnosis and at most two repair edit-and-validation cycles; normal test-first cycles do not count. Stop for design/contract change, overlapping baseline changes or exhausted budget; report evidence and remaining decision. Routine implementation defects stay implementation fixes, not new acceptance gates.

### Planning decisions

- `CoordinationWorkHistoryEntry` contains runtime metadata, not model messages; relabeling it cannot pass R05. Add one narrowly owned SQLite history store and extend existing assignment UI, not provider-history import or a new inbox protocol.
- Existing `docs/evidence/s01-native-history-trace-2026-09-28.jsonl` proves `item/started`, `item/agentMessage/delta`, `item/completed` with thread/turn/item identity. T1 is a bounded current production projection proof, not broad App Server rediscovery. Failed proof gates dependent history/journey work.
- Completed-text-only presentation is the smallest contract realization: SPEC requires history/transport qualification, not token streaming. Whole-item sanitization avoids credential prefixes split across deltas. Already public operator brief/message DTOs provide input context, never full internal prompt/private instruction exposure.
- `executeAdmitted` binds thread before `startTurn` and turn after its response. Buffer only bounded pending events for that exact submitting thread; persist only after returned turn matches. Historical reads cannot reuse `ExecutionState.coordinationBinding`, which correctly rejects obsolete generations for command authority.
- Resolve only declared routing `env:NAME` credentials already used by the service and fixture-supplied in-memory redaction values. Include exact known private profile/project instruction strings and managed workspace/control paths in the same exclusion set for assistant echoes. Do not scan `.env`, arbitrary files, all environment values or provider login stores. Conservative additional masking covers Authorization/Bearer, password/token/API-key/secret assignments and URL user-info. Regression tests prove the bounded cases, not arbitrary transformed/unknown secret immunity; unexpected private-content exposure blocks the affected UI claim.
- Two fixed live journeys cover missing assembled boundaries: repository implementation/review/revision with nested requester delivery, and repository-free question/approval/message/restart with a second task sharing its lead. Deterministic fixtures own race/fault variants. Model self-report is not acceptance evidence.
- Controller verified baseline pinned typecheck/lint/format/build and 230/230 tests. Tests needed escalation solely for loopback listener permission. #694 is merged in this baseline, including actual Running/Stop/restart UI and private HTTPS evidence. Planning source remains unchanged.

### Implementation context

- **Existing:** `src/standalone/codex.ts` — `Runtime`, `CodexRuntime.receive`, `startTurn`, `waitForTurn` own stdio/RPC and exact terminals; notifications currently go only to private EventEmitter. `test/codex-runtime.test.ts` has executable stdio fixtures and receive parser tests.
- **Existing:** `src/standalone/service.ts` — `start` installs callbacks, `executeAdmitted` binds thread/turn, `stop` closes runtime/storage, `coordinationView` wires routes. `src/standalone/state.ts` — `ExecutionState`, `task_execution_bindings`, `execution_intents`, `task_work_revisions` own work/generation identity. `coordinationBinding` is current authority, not historical lookup.
- **Existing:** `src/standalone/coordination-view.ts` — `CoordinationView.task` assembles scoped DTO; `src/standalone/operator-coordination.ts:assignmentPage` renders escaped history. Production CLI mounts `service.coordinationView()`; extend that wiring, not a raw new endpoint.
- **Existing:** `src/standalone/routing.ts` — `TypeSafeRoutingChoiceClient`, `routingClientFromEnvironment`, `RoutingChoiceClient`, `RoutingAttemptStore`; `DomainStore.routingCredentialReference` is private credential access. Model `jev-1.13.0`, SDK retries zero; service bounds attempts. Existing tests qualify deterministic routing control flow.
- **Follow:** `test/s04b/live-runtime.mjs` for capacity-one delegation/follow-up/results/completion/restart; `test/s04d/live-operator.mjs:operatorRoutes/startOperator/signIn` for authenticated Chromium and exact process cleanup. Reuse patterns, not old coordination-only restrictions. `test/s04c/private-access.mjs` is the private HTTPS/session/origin/CSRF harness.
- **Existing:** `src/standalone/power.ts` — `ExecutionPower`, `MacPowerEventSource`, `CaffeinateAssertion`; `test/power-service.test.ts`, `test/power.test.ts` prove wake reconciliation/assertions. `test/s03b/live-runtime.mjs` qualifies real restart/Stop boundaries.
- **New:** `src/standalone/conversation-history.ts` — `ConversationHistoryStore`, `ConversationHistoryEntry`, `sanitizeConversationText`; `RuntimeConversationEvent` and optional `Runtime.onConversationEvent` in `codex.ts`. New tests `conversation-history.test.ts`, `s05-runtime-integration.test.ts`, `s05-harness.test.ts`; new harnesses `test/s05/live-journey.mjs`, `live-routing.mjs`, `live-sleep.mjs`; one report `docs/evidence/s05-local-qualification.md`. Export required event/store types only through `src/standalone/index.ts`.

### Implementation slices

**Task graph and parallelism:** Acyclic T1→T2→T3→T5; T4 depends T1/T2; T6/T7 depend T2/T3; T8 joins T4/T5/T6/T7. T1–T4 share runtime/service/view and have one implementation owner. T6/T7 harness preparation and evidence collation can proceed after their seams exist while awaiting live prerequisites. Each live mode has isolated data/capacity/ports; never share mutable fixtures. Controller alone performs paid calls and remote mutations.

#### 1. Qualify narrow production stream projection

**Task ID:** `T1`
**Depends on:** `none`
**Prerequisites:** Pinned dependencies/build; installed existing-login Codex; authorized disposable local execution.
**Files and symbols:** Extend `Runtime`, `CodexRuntime.receive` with optional `onConversationEvent`/validated `RuntimeConversationEvent` in `codex.ts`; tests in `codex-runtime.test.ts`; capture mode in new `test/s05/live-journey.mjs`; required exports in `index.ts`.
**Test:** Existing receive/executable-stdio seam sends started/delta/completed agentMessage, missing/malformed identity, reasoning/tool/account events, extra fields with credential canary, duplicate completion and >64KiB item. Assert only narrow valid lifecycle/text projection emitted, no arbitrary fields, one logical completion, and overflow exposes omission metadata without partial text. Stdio fixture emits events before turn/start response; assert identity preserved without inventing service binding. Expected red: no callback exists.
**Implementation:** Validate bounded fields; accumulate deltas per exact thread/turn/item in memory, max64KiB/item and64 unfinished items. On completed agentMessage emit its validated text when supported, otherwise completely assembled observed deltas; never infer item completion from terminal. Over-limit/unfinished items yield explicit omitted/unavailable metadata. Clear buffers on stop/failure. No raw event logging. Listener failure cannot break terminal RPC processing or fabricate history success.
**Validate:** Root after build: `node --test dist/test/codex-runtime.test.js`; expect old terminal/policy and new projection tests green. `node test/s05/live-journey.mjs --live --mode capture`: one disposable prompt asks exact `S05_CAPTURE_OK`; observe real started/delta/completed text and exact thread/turn, verify runtime exit/cleanup. Save only safe counts/identity/marker result, no raw stream. Live red test is impractical; finite assertion failure stops dependent work and returns incompatible projection contract for re-plan.
**Complete when:** Current production adapter qualifies exact safe stream observation and source/runtime identity without raw payload import.

#### 2. Persist sanitized messages at immutable execution identity

**Task ID:** `T2`
**Depends on:** `T1`
**Prerequisites:** T1 passes; notifications may precede response.
**Files and symbols:** New `conversation-history.ts` store/sanitizer and additive tables on service SQLite connection. Optional fixture in-memory exclusion supplier in `StandaloneServiceOptions`; production exclusions derived from declared credential references/private control values. Wire `start`, `executeAdmitted`, `stop`, `coordinationView` in `service.ts`; add exact historical binding read in `ExecutionState` (`state.ts`), separate from command authority. New `conversation-history.test.ts`, service cases in `s05-runtime-integration.test.ts`.
**Test:** Real SQLite/service with event-capable controlled Runtime: matching message survives reopen; duplicate final event one row; old generation survives explicit revision apply; same itemID across turns/tasks distinct; no wrong-thread/task content. Early event persists only after returned turn matches; mismatch/lost-response/restart orphan never attaches. Split fake secret across deltas; complete text with known private instruction/workspace path, Bearer/assignment/URLcredential/HTML canaries: none in DB/UI projections. Raw tooling/reasoning/extra fields absent. Overflow/incomplete text unavailable, never fake completed. Expected red: no store/binding pipeline.
**Implementation:** Add immutable work/task/assignment/version/conversation revision/thread/turn/item identity, sequence/lifecycle/sanitized text/time, unique key including work/thread/turn/item. Sanitize before SQL parameter, not after persistence. Historical exact lookup joins recorded intent and task binding, permits prior bound generations only for diagnostic reads. Pending notifications remain memory-only keyed submitting thread/observed turn within T1 bounds; flush only matching turn after `bindTurn`, discard on failure/mismatch/teardown. Missing diagnostic history cannot release or create an execution hold. Project only already public brief/message DTOs for input context; never `request.prompt`. Retain the capture-start known exclusion values in memory for the full turn and union them with current values whenever text is accepted or completed; a credential/private instruction changed mid-stream cannot escape masking. Re-evaluate current exclusions at projection, never persist secret values, and clear retained exclusions/buffers on teardown. Add a split-delta test that rotates credential and instruction between first delta and completion and proves both old/new values absent from SQLite/UI. Unregister/reset callback state on stop.
**Validate:** Root after build: `node --test dist/test/conversation-history.test.js dist/test/s05-runtime-integration.test.js dist/test/standalone.test.js dist/test/s04b-integration.test.js`; expect exact history isolation/dedup/restart/exclusion and unchanged admissions/results.
**Complete when:** Complete text durable/exactly scoped; pending events cannot contaminate execution or relax ownership.

#### 3. Render real messages on private assignment UI

**Task ID:** `T3`

## Triage Notes

**What we've established so far:**

- This is an optional enhancement beyond the accepted first-release S04/S05 scope. The current runtime adapter does not expose a per-turn reasoning-effort choice, and support at the selected Codex App Server start/follow-up/resume boundary has not yet been qualified.

**Category:** enhancement
**Summary:** Qualify supported native Codex saved-project placement, task visibility and human control handover through a finite disposable proof.

**Current behavior:** CodexRuntime starts/resumes persistent App Server threads and supervises turns. That does not establish native saved-project placement or visibility. **Desired behavior:** Produce attributable evidence for each requested native capability before implementing the production adapter. Unsupported required capabilities produce a consolidated evidence/scope-review report and retain the open gate; a negative finding is a valid investigation result but not a passed capability.

**Key interfaces:** Runtime/CodexRuntime thread and turn lifecycle; StandaloneService admission and known-execution holds; task workspace binding; the supported native host entrypoint and project/thread identifiers discovered by this proof.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- [ ] Identify the supported integration entrypoint, exact runtime/host version, disposable saved-project identity and task worktree. Host-internal pipes are not a supported standalone contract without evidence.
- [ ] Demonstrate a main native task, linked worker conversation, actual saved-project placement, opening/navigation and native change inspection after one harmless worktree change.
- [ ] Demonstrate explicit handover before human continuation and explicit return after settled execution, with one execution owner and retained workspace/identity.
- [ ] Restart the disposable coordinator and verify that tracking/reconciliation does not duplicate launch or infer return from idle status. Known active/uncertain execution retains holds.
- [ ] Record passed/failed/unproved rows, observed effects, limitations and fixture cleanup. Fail or stop at unsupported boundaries; return evidence for scope review without closing this issue as passed or releasing #725.

**Out of scope:** Production native integration, historical task import, shared login/config changes, production task writes, Haze prototype changes, new execution machines, physical process containment, exhaustive tool histories, fallback scope approval or production deployment.

**Planned against:** `main` at `8173a312a3e6a094e6280c2eaf0196ae1a070c61`
**Publication mode:** Autonomous
