content.title: UI02: Build the authenticated React operator foundation

nodes.body:
> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Agent Brief

**Category:** enhancement

**Summary:** Build the authenticated React operator foundation.

**Current behavior:**
The operator uses server-rendered HTML forms and separate Runtime/Coordination route slots. The service already owns sessions, CSRF/origin checks and validated domain commands.

**Desired behavior:**
Serve a React + Vite production build and same-origin authenticated APIs from Ensemble. Implement the reviewed shell, tokens, shared controls and login; expose read models and command adapters required by dependent screens without duplicating domain policy.

**Key interfaces:**
LocalOperatorHttp; OperatorAuth; OperatorRouteRegistry; DomainCommands; CoordinationView; runtime operator APIs.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- [ ] Production starts with one Ensemble service serving built assets and APIs; no separate frontend production server is required.
- [ ] Login/logout, session expiry, host/origin/CSRF protections and unauthenticated read/write rejection have browser and HTTP regression coverage.
- [ ] API inputs are validated at runtime; writes retain idempotency, expected revisions, exact approval material and persisted receipts. Sensitive diagnostics and credentials are not exposed through broad serialization.
- [ ] Shared navigation and controls follow the reviewed semantic tokens and fixed typography roles, including keyboard focus and phone navigation; use Radix selectively.
- [ ] Inventory every existing operator control and record its destination/owner across the child issues; no supported configuration or recovery operation is silently lost.
- [ ] Establish validated API contracts and explicit loading/stale/error outcomes for dependent screens, with reusable fixtures and build/check integration.
- [ ] Preserve existing operational access during staged migration; do not remove old control routes before replacement coverage passes.

**Out of scope:**
No service rewrite, separate production deployment, whole-product screen implementation or new authorization model.

**Shared boundaries and validation:**
Use the approved specification, acceptance criteria and design handoff linked from #736. React + Vite, same-origin service APIs and selective Radix controls are the approved architecture. Preserve server-owned policy and runtime trust limits. Run proportional automated tests and pinned npm ci / npm run check for implementation; the implementation owner performs required browser/live validation. These briefs authorise scoped planning outcomes, not immediate dispatch, deployment, merge or cutover. Keep all children unassigned in Backlog; dependency readiness is distinct from the ready-for-agent specification label. X01-X08 remain deferred.

<!-- to-plan:implementation-plan:v2 -->

**Revision:** 1
**Supersedes:** none
**Replan report:** none

## Implementation plan

**Issue:** https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/issues/740
**Planned against:** `main` at `1a643463769b2c87f1503b22f9fb14068160d846`
**Publication mode:** Autonomous
**Local state:** Clean before this scratch draft; no source or test changes

Planning uses the dedicated detached checkout `/tmp/ensemble-drain-planning-20261001`; `main` identifies its committed source baseline.

### Approach

Add a built React operator shell at `/app`, served by the existing Ensemble operator process with a narrow `/api/operator` JSON boundary. Implement login, project navigation, shared controls and truthful request states. Dependent issues implement the everyday screens using the validated DTOs and command adapters. Keep `/`, `/project`, `/task`, `/profile`, `/assignment`, Runtime/Coordination pages and every existing form action operational during migration. This foundation adds presentation and transport, not another service or coordination engine.

### Guardrails

- `LocalOperatorHttp` retains ownership of Host, exact Origin, sessions, CSRF, cookie attributes, bounded input and response headers. Every private API read/write is authenticated; browser state establishes no authority. No CORS, forwarded-header trust, bearer credential, second login model or public deployment is added.
- JSON command allowlists are presentation adapters to `DomainCommands` and `CoordinationView`. Do not duplicate admission, dependency, source ownership, exact-material approval, or recovery policy. A persisted receipt confirms that command's recorded result, never agent execution, runtime delivery or GitHub success.
- Keep all old routes and controls, and expose an explicit Existing operator controls link from the shell. No removal or silent redirects of operational views until the replacement owner's coverage passes. Unimplemented screens show a useful link to the existing view, never fictional service data or working controls.
- UI01 #739 owns native structured input and its durable adapter; UI05 #743 owns native question API/form wiring after qualification. Do not import unmerged UI01 code, model native support as plain text, or edit service/runtime/state/coordination lifecycle. X01–X08 remain deferred; no deployment, cutover, Haze prototype changes, paid inference or new live model turn.
- Protect credentials, references, private instructions and control/workspace paths in API projections. Never spread or serialize store/service rows, runtime prompts, execution payloads, recovery records or exceptions. Retained approval material is either displayed exactly and safely, or explicitly unavailable; redacted material cannot become approvable material.
- For a wrong factual seam in this approved contract, allow one focused diagnosis and at most two repair edit-and-validation cycles. Ordinary implementation, integration, test-first, fixture, formatting, documentation and CI repairs remain with the implementation owner and do not consume this budget. Stop for a design/contract change, overlapping baseline change or exhausted factual-seam budget; report evidence and required upstream change.

### Planning decisions

- `/app` is the staged React entry point. Production `operator` wires the web boundary; the existing constructor without that option retains its form-only behavior and tests. The React shell also serves `/login` GET when web-enabled; existing `/login` POST and `/logout` POST form behavior stays available. New login controls use the JSON auth endpoints. This avoids taking over `/` before UI03 covers the full everyday flow.
- Add an optional `OperatorWebBoundary` to `LocalOperatorHttp`, handled after the existing Host/target checks and before legacy route/path-length/form parsing. Keep `OperatorRouteRegistry`'s trusted HTML slots unchanged. Its current result union and form-only context cannot represent JSON/assets, and its current GET length guard precedes general extension lookup.
- Plain React state and a small pathname router are sufficient for this shell. Use Radix Dialog only for the phone project-navigation drawer (focus trap, Escape and focus restoration); native buttons/inputs/links implement the other controls. No router, query/cache framework or generated API platform is needed.
- Pin the verified registry versions: runtime `react@19.3.0`, `react-dom@19.3.0`, `@radix-ui/react-dialog@1.1.23`, and `@fontsource/space-grotesk@5.3.0`, `@fontsource/instrument-sans@5.3.0`, `@fontsource/ibm-plex-mono@5.3.0`; development `vite@8.3.2`, `@types/react@19.3.0`, `@types/react-dom@19.3.0`. Vite's declared Node range supports 24.21.0. Its native TSX transform suffices; no Fast Refresh plugin is needed for the production foundation. Self-host font files; no external font/network request. [Vite features](https://vite.dev/guide/features.html), [production build](https://vite.dev/guide/build.html), [Radix Dialog](https://www.radix-ui.com/primitives/docs/components/dialog).
- Browser TypeScript uses a separate strict DOM/Bundler/noEmit config, `jsx: react-jsx` and `isolatedModules`; service/test NodeNext compilation remains unchanged. A pure Zod DTO module is the only shared runtime import, with no Node/service imports in the browser graph.
- Start with only presently supported, durable write adapters: local task creation/configuration, local dependency add/remove, explicit instruction apply, durable message, plain-text question, approval and result-recipient reconciliation. Settings/configuration, GitHub preview/refresh/source review/placement and Stop/Resume remain supported through their existing routes until UI04/UI06 add the necessary APIs. Stop/Resume observations and unkeyed refresh are not fabricated persisted receipts. No API for imported-blocker override, arbitrary domain command or external GitHub write.

### Implementation context

- **Existing:** `src/standalone/operator.ts` — `LocalOperatorHttp.start/authorizeRead/authorizeWrite`, `readForm`, cookie helpers and `RESPONSE_HEADERS` enforce HTTP security; `LocalOperatorUi` owns existing HTML views/form adapters. `OperatorHttpOptions` currently has only `routes`.
- **Existing:** `src/standalone/cli.ts` — `operator` creates one `StandaloneService`, `OperatorAuth`, `OperatorRouteRegistry`, both registered slots and one `LocalOperatorHttp`; this is the production wiring point.
- **Existing:** `src/core/domain.ts` — `DomainCommands.execute` shares in-flight calls and delegates runtime-validated commands; `DomainStore.executeParsed` checks receipts before versions, commits `command_receipts` transactionally and invokes its change listener. JSON adapters must preserve that order and fixed create IDs/keys.
- **Existing:** `src/standalone/coordination-view.ts` — `readTask/readAssignmentHistory` provide task-scoped curated data including `unresolvedResults` revisions; `postOperatorMessage/answerQuestion/decideApproval/reconcileResultRecipient` validate scope/revisions, persist via `CoordinationStore`, then await `onCommand`. Existing receipts contain event/task/recipient/type/time. Do not modify this file for UI02.
- **Existing:** `src/standalone/operator-runtime.ts` — `RuntimeOperatorApi`, `statusForAssignment` and `taskPage` distinguish selected/queued/submitting/running/stopping/held/complete; its dependency/instruction commands are durable, Stop/Resume are observations. `src/standalone/operator-coordination.ts` owns existing questions/approval/history/result controls; material is bounded to 8 KiB and legacy missing material is deny-only.
- **Existing:** `src/standalone/conversation-history.ts:sanitizeConversationText` and `StandaloneService.coordinationView().readAssignmentHistory` supply sanitized, bounded captured assistant history with omissions. `DomainStore` exposes current/captured instruction/profile revisions and credential-reference configuration; `GitHubSourceStore` exposes issue/source snapshots. API code constructs explicit DTOs from these public reads.
- **New:** `src/operator/contracts.ts` — pure Zod schemas and inferred DTO/command/result types used by the server, browser client and fixtures. `src/standalone/operator-api.ts:OperatorApi` builds curated reads and delegates allowed writes. `src/standalone/operator-web.ts:OperatorWebBundle/OperatorWebBoundary` loads the build's known files and exposes only immutable shell/assets and the typed API adapter.
- **New:** `web/index.html`, `web/vite.config.ts`, `web/tsconfig.json`, `web/src/main.tsx`, `web/src/app.tsx`, `web/src/api.ts`, `web/src/resource.ts`, `web/src/components.tsx`, `web/src/tokens.css`, `web/src/styles.css` — entry/build, authenticated shell, validated fetch, truthful resource state, actually used shared controls and reviewed visual roles.
- **Follow:** `test/operator-browser.test.ts` for real Chromium/login/time-injection and disposable service setup; `test/operator-coordination.test.ts` and `test/coordination-view.test.ts` for real SQLite, runtime callbacks, approval material and receipts. Create reusable `test/fixtures/operator-web.ts`; do not import private helpers from existing tests.

### Implementation slices

**Task graph and parallelism:** `T1 → T2 → T3 → T4 → T5 → T6` is acyclic and deliberately serial: transport, DTOs, client and production fixture/build files depend on the preceding contract. No slices concurrently edit shared mutable files. UI01 has no source/test path overlap with this plan: it owns `coordination-view.ts`, core coordination, service/state/codex and native fixtures, all read-only here. Demonstrated shared mutable paths in the published UI01 plan are `package.json`, `docs/SPEC.md` and `docs/acceptance.md`; the lead serializes/reconciles those edits. `package-lock.json` is a precautionary build/dependency coordination path, not a demonstrated UI01 planned edit. UI02 exclusively changes existing `src/standalone/operator.ts` (HTTP transport/auth dispatch, shared document navigation), `src/standalone/cli.ts` (production wiring), `biome.json`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and `README.md`; later UI03–UI06 may share these HTTP/wiring/build seams and must start from their merged foundation. New contracts/API/web modules are UI02-owned. Existing `OperatorAuth` and `OperatorRouteRegistry` are consumed unchanged, and UI01's curated `CoordinationView` remains a read/call seam, not a shared mutable source path. Do not claim UI01 delivery from its published plan.

#### 1. Record complete retained-control ownership and freeze DTO contracts

**Task ID:** `T1`
**Depends on:** `none`
**Prerequisites:** Verified open/ready issue, actual Planning claim, no blockers/competing implementation PR; baseline above.
**Files and symbols:** New `docs/design/ui02-foundation.md` (API/security/route and control-inventory contract); new `src/operator/contracts.ts` (`sessionSchema`, `workspaceSchema`, `projectSchema`, `taskSchema`, `assignmentHistorySchema`, `operatorCommandSchema`, `commandReceiptSchema`, `apiErrorSchema`); new `test/operator-contracts.test.ts`.
**Test:** Zod public schemas reject extra `actor`, `credentialRef`, raw `payload`, malformed UUID, fractional/zero revision, imported-content edit variant and arbitrary command type. Accept fixed UUID fixtures, task-create `ready:false/true`, all allowed command variants, null/missing approval material for denial and bounded exact material for approval. Parse valid read fixtures; reject an unexpected row field and invalid state/revision. Red is missing schema exports or permissive unknown payloads.
**Implementation:**
1. Inventory **rendered** controls and destinations individually, plus non-rendered `LocalOperatorUi.submit` cases as supported-programmatic/not-current-UI. Record old route, exact command, new owner/destination, current API readiness and evidence required before removal. Required rows: project create/setup/configure/name/lead/instructions/pause → UI06 #744; profile create/configure/instructions/capabilities/revoke → UI06; routing enable/guidance/candidates/set/clear credential reference → UI06; GitHub configure selections/readiness/repositories/set/clear reference, preview+activation, refresh, conflicting placement → UI06; local task draft/start/edit/readiness → UI03 #741; imported source identity/body/status/Project fields/native blockers/source review and hold resolution → UI04 #742 with source configuration retained in UI06; capacity/global/project override → UI06; dependency add/remove, apply current instruction/profile revisions and Stop/Resume → UI04, advanced recovery evidence/control coverage → UI06; message, retained assignment history/results and result-recipient reconciliation → UI04; plain question and exact approval/deny → UI05 #743 (same durable request shown in task detail); login/logout → UI02; all cross-navigation → UI03/UI04; final control/read parity/accessibility/evidence → UI07 #745. Programmatic assignment create, assignment apply/dependency variants and imported-blockers.set are inventoried separately; do not newly expose imported-blockers.set.

nodes.body:
> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Agent Brief

**Category:** enhancement

**Summary:** Deliver overview, task lists, Kanban and task creation.

**Current behavior:**
Existing project/task forms provide basic task creation and readiness controls; the reviewed attention-first overview and shared List/Board experience are absent.

**Desired behavior:**
Implement overview, project and cross-project filtered task views, List/Board parity and the substantial local-task composer against authenticated service commands.

**Key interfaces:**
Operator task/project read models; DomainCommands task creation/readiness; dependency and admission eligibility views; shared UI foundation.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- [ ] Overview separates urgent action requests from normal progress and links to the complete Inbox; waiting on a dependency alone does not imply operator action.
- [ ] List and Board show the same filtered task set, preserve filters, and open the same task detail without changing task state.
- [ ] Cards identify project, lead, source and wait/intervention reason; Ready-but-blocked, stopping and uncertain states remain visible and reachable by keyboard and phone column navigation.
- [ ] Composer supports project, outcome, optional context/links, permitted explicit assignee and dependencies; references confer no repository access.
- [ ] Save draft and Create and start invoke the appropriate persisted domain commands; configuration, pause, capacity and dependencies are explained without claiming execution merely from creation.
- [ ] Input survives validation/network failures. On-device unfinished recovery is distinct from a confirmed durable task; imported titles/bodies cannot be edited through the local composer.
- [ ] Automated service/browser checks cover shared filters, draft/start and held states, empty/error layouts and phone/laptop action visibility.

**Out of scope:**
No arbitrary drag-and-drop transitions, silent GitHub writes, new readiness policy or Inbox response forms.

**Shared boundaries and validation:**
Use the approved specification, acceptance criteria and design handoff linked from #736. React + Vite, same-origin service APIs and selective Radix controls are the approved architecture. Preserve server-owned policy and runtime trust limits. Run proportional automated tests and pinned npm ci / npm run check for implementation; the implementation owner performs required browser/live validation. These briefs authorise scoped planning outcomes, not immediate dispatch, deployment, merge or cutover. Keep all children unassigned in Backlog; dependency readiness is distinct from the ready-for-agent specification label. X01-X08 remain deferred.

<!-- to-plan:implementation-plan:v2 -->

**Revision:** 1
**Supersedes:** none
**Replan report:** none

## Implementation plan

**Issue:** https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/issues/741
**Planned against:** `main` at `3b98566ba5ea81d73f53f1b7983e441721b64500`
**Publication mode:** Autonomous
**Local state:** Clean before this scratch draft; ignored build/dependency state excluded by path

The dedicated planning checkout is detached at the SHA above. The authoritative source is the complete issue/Agent Brief at https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/issues/741#issuecomment-5941786967, semantic source digest `sha256:f4676a96f7f1fa844084866ba2d6c4533d58a8fe3eba1dc7bd03f84b2c5518a9`, with parent #736, SPEC, acceptance and design handoff. Root verified #740 closed, PR #748 merged and Project Done, with its delivered code in this baseline. #741 is OPEN, ready-for-agent, exclusively assigned to chrisbanes in Planning, with no incomplete blocker, open implementation PR or existing marked plan. The direct user-authorized Planning boundary supersedes the older keep-unassigned-in-Backlog brief for this dispatch; it is not a fictional GitHub timeline event. Root owns publication and all remote transitions.

### Approach

Replace the `/app` overview/project placeholders with an attention preview and shared cross-project/project List/Board views. Add a substantial local composer using a transactional extension of `task.create`, so selected dependencies and an explicit assignee are recorded before Ready can admit execution. Keep one task identity and one recorded command outcome through lost responses, reload and reconciliation. Retain the existing task detail and Inbox operational destinations until their owning children deliver replacements.

### Guardrails

- Server `DomainCommands`, `DomainStore` and existing service admission retain policy ownership. No second admission/policy engine, framework, assignment routing algorithm or execution-state authority. References are passive context and confer no repository access. Only existing same-project tasks are dependency candidates; imported native relationships remain source-owned.
- Keep Host, exact Origin, sessions, CSRF, cookies, bounded JSON and same-origin asset/API protections. No credentials, references to credentials, retained private instructions, repository/workspace/control paths, raw recovery/process payloads or exceptions in new projections. Reuse UI02 global retained-revision exclusions and its 128-lookup fail-closed rule; do not weaken exact-material approval/denial or captured-history policy.
- Save draft records `ready=false`; Create and start records `ready=true`, including in paused or unconfigured projects. Neither reports Running from a receipt or bypasses pause, capacity, dependency, Stop, ownership, uncertainty or configuration holds. Imported title/outcome/readiness cannot be changed by local composer commands.
- No arbitrary drag transitions, Inbox response forms, silent GitHub writes, new readiness policy, native structured-input fallback, new real Codex/TypeSafe turn, deployment, cutover, production/global settings or login changes. #739 remains paused after its failed bounded native probe; do not import its unmerged code. #737's external-delivery interface is not in main. X01–X08 remain deferred and the installed Haze prototype stays intact.
- All legacy routes/forms remain operational. Both list rows and board cards open `/task/:id` in this slice, preserving Runtime/Coordination links and imported read-only behavior. #742 owns unified task detail and #743 owns complete Inbox; `/app/inbox` must retain a clearly labelled link to `/coordination`. #744 owns setup/configuration/recovery replacement controls. No old control removal or final UI07/parent acceptance claim.
- For a wrong factual seam in this approved plan, allow one focused diagnosis and at most two repair edit-and-validation cycles. Ordinary implementation, test-first, integration, fixtures, formatting, documentation, CI and review repairs do not consume this budget. Stop for an overlapping baseline change, exhausted factual-seam budget or changed design/contract. Return concrete evidence to the lead. Material product/privacy/permission/execution-guarantee changes require human review; routine contract-realizing implementation choices stay within this plan.

### Planning decisions

- The lead settled the atomic creation seam after inspection: existing `task.create` persists only title/outcome/ready, while `dependency.add` and `assignment.create` already enforce project/profile/recipient policy. Add optional fields to that command and reuse private `apply` branches inside its existing transaction; never recursively call `execute`/`executeParsed`. No schema migration or independent receipt workflow is needed. The service's initial routing loop skips a task with existing assignments (`service.ts`, `for (const task of domain.readyTasksWithLead())`), so a permitted explicit assignee naturally bypasses TypeSafe.
- Context and passive HTTP(S) links become deterministic labelled sections of the existing persisted outcome/assignment brief, under its 16,000-character bound. There is no new competing brief store, link fetch or imported-content editor. Omitted optional command fields remain omitted, preserving existing canonical receipt hashes. A supplied empty dependency array is still a distinct payload from omission; reconciliation uses the exact original payload.
- A single curated paginated task-list producer feeds a shared browser aggregate. Each page is bounded to 100 tasks and carries a catalog-membership fingerprint over ordered task ID/project identity pairs. The client accepts a complete aggregate only when every page has the same fingerprint and an advancing cursor. This is a membership consistency check, not a snapshot engine: observations can span time, and neither `observedAt` nor a completed aggregate claims immutable state or provider sync. Changed membership, repeated cursor, malformed page or the 100-page/10,000-task cap fails the read, preserving a previous good aggregate as explicitly stale.
- Task-card lead identity uses the retained same-task/project `DomainStore.leadBindings()` row when present, projecting only its profile identity and safe captured name from `profileRevision(profileId, profileRevision)`. Before a binding exists, fall back to the currently configured project lead. Label this Task lead; the existing project summary `leadProfileId` and current safe profile label describe Configured project lead separately when relevant. Project reconfiguration does not silently change the task binding or its result recipient. Do not copy `readTask`'s current-project display shortcut into the new summary.
- Board grouping is a pure presentation of execution/readiness/admission facts. Priority is Stopping, Uncertain, Running/Starting, Done, Cancelled, Paused, Draft, Waiting, then Ready. Ready-but-blocked remains Ready and appears in Waiting with its reason. Selected/queued remain distinct labels within Ready unless a concrete wait/hold applies. Source status never determines a column. List/Board use one filtered array and one detail-link function.
- Attention preview derives from current open questions/approvals, unresolved result destinations, current-version rejected completion, actual unresolved execution uncertainty and current-version `lead-review` routing with no assignment. A Stop hold alone is not urgency: `OperatorApi.execution` prioritizes Stopping when `holds.stop` is true, even without uncertainty, and Stop records its hold before cancellation observation. Normal Stopping/Stop observation belongs in Work; Stop plus actual `holds.uncertainty`, an unconfirmed retained ownership/request, or a separate current action request qualifies for attention. Inspect the existing selected request/intent/recovery facts as well as execution state, because Stopping can mask actual uncertainty. Historical routing fallback messages alone are not urgent. Dependency, ordinary capacity and project pause waits alone belong in progress. The preview links to complete existing Inbox/Coordination controls; it neither responds nor invents new resolution policy.
- Versioned bounded `sessionStorage` holds only unfinished composer fields and, before submission, the exact frozen command/IDs/key needed for explicit reconciliation. Use a 256 KiB UTF-8 envelope cap covering the validated input plus <=64 KiB HTTP command, with the producer/consumer accounting specified in T4. Validated frozen recovery must be successfully persisted and read back before any POST. Failure sends zero POSTs and preserves current input in memory plus any last successfully saved unfinished record; it never promises persisted newer edits. This supports same-tab reload recovery, not a durable Ensemble task or cross-device storage. It stores no session/CSRF/login/API credential, private service instructions or fetched API caches. There is no automatic write replay or replacement key after uncertainty. A confirmed receipt survives an unsuccessful following read.

### Implementation context

- **Existing:** `src/core/domain.ts` — `commandSchema`, `DomainStore.executeParsed`, `apply`, `admission`, `routingCandidates`, `dependencies`, `capacityLimits`, `DomainCommands.execute`. One `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` saves mutation and original receipt; matching retries replay before current policy/version checks, and `onChange` runs after commit. `assignment.create` captures current profile/instruction revisions and uses `ensureLeadBindingWithinTransaction` for the result recipient. `dependency.add` advances task version and rejects self/cyclic/foreign/imported-dependent edges.
- **Existing:** `src/standalone/operator-api.ts` — `OperatorApi.execute` supplies actor=operator, projects original receipts, maps conflicts, and rejects imported edits; `exclusions`/`safe`, `selection`, `execution`, `identity`, `readProject`, `readTask`, `source` own curated privacy and actual selected-generation presentation. `readTask` finds the retained binding for recipient policy but its displayed lead profile uses current project configuration; the new task summary must instead prefer the retained same-task binding and captured `profileRevision` name. Reuse existing privacy/read owners, never spread their raw rows.
- **Existing:** `src/operator/contracts.ts` — strict Zod schemas shared by server/browser, including `projectSchema`, `executionSchema`, `operatorCommandSchema`, `commandReceiptSchema`, `apiErrorSchema`; current task summary lacks lead/admission/attention detail and project profiles are not proof of permitted selection.
- **Existing:** `src/standalone/operator-web.ts` — `OperatorWebBoundary.shell/read/knownApi`; `src/standalone/operator.ts` — `LocalOperatorHttp.handleWeb` owns authenticated route dispatch, passing read paths to the boundary; `src/standalone/cli.ts` mounts one production listener. Extend transport only where the new routes/query require it; no CLI/service wiring rewrite.
- **Existing:** `web/src/app.tsx` — `App`, `ProjectNavigation`, `RouteLink` own shell/auth/navigation; its current route state records pathname only. `web/src/api.ts` — `OperatorClient.command` returns recorded/conflict/rejected/unknown with submitted material. `web/src/resource.ts` — `ResourceController`/`useOperatorResource` abort obsolete reads and retain stale data only for matching resource scope.
- **Existing:** `web/src/components.tsx`, `styles.css`, `tokens.css` — semantic fonts/controls/phone drawer; `design/DESIGN.md` gives overview, composer, List/Board and phone composition. Use native labelled selects/checkboxes/textareas and existing Radix Dialog only when useful; no new dependency is required.
- **Follow:** `test/fixtures/operator-web.ts:createOperatorFixture` uses real temporary SQLite, deterministic fake runtime, one real listener and awaited cleanup. `test/operator-api.test.ts` has original receipt/reopen, post-commit unknown, dependency, imported projection and global privacy cases. `test/operator-web-browser.test.ts` has Playwright semantic/focus/layout/security checks and portable `test/temp.ts` screenshot output. `test/domain.test.ts` has transaction/replay fixtures; `test/scheduler.test.ts` has actual fake-runtime admission/capacity fixtures.
- **New:** `web/src/tasks.ts` owns pure filter/column/detail-link logic and complete task-list aggregation; `task-views.tsx` renders overview/list/board. `composer-state.ts` owns small validated unfinished-input/submission state; `task-composer.tsx` owns form interaction. New tests `test/operator-task-list.test.ts`, `test/operator-task-composer.test.ts`, `test/operator-task-browser.test.ts`; new contract/evidence docs `docs/design/ui03-tasks.md`, `docs/evidence/ui03-tasks.md`.

### Implementation slices

**Task graph and parallelism:** Serial acyclic graph `T1 → T2 → T3 → T4 → T5 → T6`; each prerequisite is the preceding completed slice. No concurrent implementation writers: contracts/API/app/tests overlap, and every consumer needs the preceding interface. Keep all integration decisions with the lead. Root will create `/tmp/ensemble-drain-ui03-741-20261002` on `cb/issue-741-overview-composer` from verified main after reviewed publication/handoff. Every implementation/validation command below has working directory `/tmp/ensemble-drain-ui03-741-20261002`, never the planning checkout. #737/#739 retain paused branches without active resource leases; #740 is merged with its clean checkout detached, so no overlapping active implementation writer is admitted. Set `PATH=/private/tmp/ensemble-ui02-npm-bin:/tmp/ensemble-node.T1JoRI/node-v24.21.0-darwin-arm64/bin:$PATH`; verify `node --version` gives v24.21.0 and `npm --version` gives 12.2.0 and run `npm ci` once before tests. If those temporary paths are unavailable, use an already provisioned equivalent matching `.node-version` and `packageManager`, never silently use another version. Build before Node tests. `npm run build` runs service TypeScript and Vite, so each focused command includes it.

#### 1. Atomic rich task creation preserves policy and original receipts

**Task ID:** `T1`
**Depends on:** `none`
**Prerequisites:** Clean approved baseline and pinned dependency setup.
**Files and symbols:** Edit `src/core/domain.ts:commandSchema/apply` and `src/operator/contracts.ts:operatorCommandSchema`; edit `src/standalone/operator-api.ts:execute` only for supported error projection. Add cases in existing `test/domain.test.ts`, `test/operator-contracts.test.ts`, `test/operator-api.test.ts`, `test/scheduler.test.ts`.
**Test:** First add the literal regression `task.create atomically records dependencies and explicit assignment before readiness wakeup`. Existing schema rejects enriched input, so expected red is successful-valid-input/creation assertion failure. Seed one active project with configured lead, permitted worker and open local blocker, routing enabled with deterministic counting routing client. Create `{ready:true, blockerTaskIds:[blocker], initialAssignment:{assignmentId,profileId:worker}}`. Assert one task/edge/assignment/outer receipt, final task version 2, correct captured revisions/lead result recipient, zero routing calls, zero runtime turns while blocker holds, and that the post-commit wakeup observer can already read edge and assignment. After blocker Done, exactly one eligible fake turn uses the chosen worker. Save-draft version has zero turns and `ready=false`. Invalid foreign/self/duplicate/129th blocker, revoked/unpermitted profile, duplicate assignment identity or unauthorized actor rolls back task/edges/binding/assignment/receipt completely. Repeat exact command concurrently, after task mutation/profile revocation and after reopen: one original receipt and no duplicate effects; changed payload conflicts. Include legacy omitted-field receipt seeded before extension, and simulate post-commit wakeup failure then exact replay to original receipt. Keep existing Stop/ownership/capacity behavior covered by scheduler suite.
**Implementation:** Add optional `blockerTaskIds` (UUID array, unique, max 128) and `initialAssignment` (strict `{assignmentId:UUID, profileId:UUID}`), without defaults adding absent fields. In `task.create` private apply branch, create the local task within current transaction, apply each existing `dependency.add` branch with actor/operator/project/current in-transaction task version, then apply existing `assignment.create` branch with the frozen assignment ID, chosen profile, deterministic `Task: title\nOutcome: outcome` brief, `resultDestination:"lead"`, `requesterAssignmentId:null`. Return final task row. No inner transaction/receipt/onChange. A dependency may target an imported task already in the same project, following its existing external closure rules; no imported dependent/native override. Existing policy rejects revoked/unpermitted profiles even after options were fetched. Keep receipt DTO unchanged: task ID/project/version/state/ready prove the original recorded task outcome, and command contains the initial assignment ID for later reads. Map only positively identified pre-commit policy errors to existing safe conflict/forbidden/invalid-input outcomes; unknown failures remain `command-outcome-unknown`, with no raw error text. Do not classify a post-commit wakeup exception as confirmed rejection.
**Validate:** Run `npm run build && node --test dist/test/domain.test.js dist/test/operator-contracts.test.js dist/test/operator-api.test.js dist/test/scheduler.test.js`; expect atomic rollback/replay/admission assertions and existing policy regressions green.
**Complete when:** Rich creation is one atomic durable command; all selected setup is visible before any wakeup, and receipt replay remains original across restart/current-policy changes.

#### 2. Curated bounded task catalog and permitted composer options

**Task ID:** `T2`
**Depends on:** `T1`
**Prerequisites:** T1 creation contract green.
**Files and symbols:** Add `DomainStore.taskCatalog` in `src/core/domain.ts`; new exported `taskListPageSchema`, `TaskListPage`, `taskListQuerySchema`, `composerOptionsSchema` in `src/operator/contracts.ts`; new `OperatorApi.readTaskListPage`/`readComposerOptions` and private summary helper in `src/standalone/operator-api.ts`; extend `OperatorWebBoundary.read/knownApi` and `LocalOperatorHttp.handleWeb` query handoff in `src/standalone/operator-web.ts`/`operator.ts`. Add `test/operator-task-list.test.ts`; extend existing contracts/HTTP/API tests.
**Test:** Literal red `task catalog pages exclude private retained revisions and classify dependency waits separately from attention`: first new route returns 404 or contract rejects expected page. Real SQLite fixture contains two projects and local/imported tasks, ready dependency wait, pause, starting/running, current question/approval, unresolved result, old fallback and current lead-review operation. Add paired literal regression `normal Stop observation stays Work while Stop with actual uncertainty needs attention`: one task has Stop=true with a confirmed active running/submitting request and no uncertainty/action request; another has Stop=true plus actual uncertainty/unconfirmed retained ownership. Both project execution state Stopping; only the latter has uncertainty attention, and both remain accessible cards. Assert no phantom urgency from Stop alone, dependency/capacity/pause or historic fallback; explicit current action codes; every title/project/lead/source is safe or unavailable. Current source status is separate from execution. Add literal public-seam regression `task summary retains captured lead after project lead reconfiguration`: create profiles A/B and a project led by A, create a task and retain its same-task lead binding using existing commands, then configure project lead B and rename/revise A. The public task-list summary still identifies A with its safe captured revision name; project configuration identifies B; original result recipient/binding is unchanged. An otherwise identical task without a retained binding reports B. Reopen and repeat; unsafe or unavailable captured name remains unavailable rather than falling back to B. Exercise 101 tasks: first 100 plus next page, same fingerprint, no omissions/duplicate IDs; add/remove/transfer task between pages changes fingerprint. Invalid cursor/limit/unknown query/duplicate params reject; unknown cursor with unchanged catalog is invalid rather than restarting. More than 10,000 rows produces explicit unavailable, never truncates a claimed complete result. Seed old private profile/project revisions, credential values/references, task paths and exhausted 128-revision budget; assert existing global/task exclusions fail closed with identities/state retained. Options include only active lead + configured active candidates (unique) and same-project dependency summaries; revoked/foreign/all-workspace-only profiles absent. 401 new reads and wrong-Origin/CSRF enriched writes mutate nothing.
**Implementation:** `taskCatalog` is a read-only SQLite join returning only ordered `{id,projectId}` identities, bounded with `LIMIT 10001`; it adds no table/migration. Compute SHA-256 over canonical ordered identity pairs; fixed 100 default, validated limit 1..100 and optional UUID cursor. Return strict envelope `{data:{tasks:[summary],nextCursor:UUID|null,catalogFingerprint:64hex},observedAt}`. Reject excessive catalog; select page before expensive task projections. Each summary contains task ID/project ID/title/version/domain state/readiness, existing safe project summary (including current configured `leadProfileId`) and task lead `{profileId,name}|null`, existing `executionSchema`, structured existing admission reasons, numeric capacity observation (global/project usage/limits), nullable curated source identity/repository/number/URL/external state, and bounded enumerated attention codes/counts. For task lead, select only `d.leadBindings()` matching this task and project; if present, use its retained `profileId` and safe captured `d.profileRevision(binding.profileId, binding.profileRevision).name`. Otherwise use the current project lead and safe current profile name, or null if unconfigured. Missing/inconsistent captured revision fails name projection closed; it must not replace the retained identity with current configuration. Existing `exclusions`/`safe` apply to both labels. No new core read interface or rebinding policy is needed. Use `admission`/`capacityLimits`/`selection`/`execution`/coordination current facts; no raw diagnostic strings/material/histories. Do not emit an attention code from `holds.stop` or state=Stopping alone. Use `selection`'s actual request/intent/record to retain uncertainty attention when Stop precedence masks it: `holds.uncertainty`, held/unconfirmed request, or retained writer/capacity ownership without the same confirmed active running/submitting intent qualify under the existing execution uncertainty rules. Confirmed active execution under normal Stop observation does not. Separate current action requests still qualify independently. Derive source links from validated safe GitHub repository/issue identity. Derive current-version lead-review only from `view.routing.attempts` and absence of assignments; rejected completion only for current task version. `readComposerOptions(projectId)` is a separate GET `/api/operator/projects/:id/composer-options`, projecting active lead plus `routingCandidates` IDs without instructions/capabilities/credential details, and same-project task ID/title/state/source summaries bounded to 10,000 with unavailable rather than hidden omission; existing core write checks remain authoritative. Keep existing project/task endpoints unchanged. Read query uses strict validated URLSearchParams; JSON writes keep existing 64 KiB protection.
**Validate:** Run `npm run build && node --test dist/test/operator-task-list.test.js dist/test/operator-contracts.test.js dist/test/operator-api.test.js dist/test/operator-web-http.test.js dist/test/operator-web-integration.test.js`; expect pagination/privacy/attention/options/auth/receipt cases green.
**Complete when:** Authenticated new read seams produce complete bounded identities and safe current reasons/options, with explicit unavailable/invalid/incomplete failures and no policy expansion.

#### 3. Shared filtered overview, List and keyboard/phone Board

**Task ID:** `T3`
**Depends on:** `T2`
**Prerequisites:** T2 curated DTOs and query semantics green.
**Files and symbols:** New `web/src/tasks.ts:loadTaskList/filterTasks/taskColumn/taskDetailHref/parseTaskFilters`; new `web/src/task-views.tsx:Overview/TaskViews/TaskRow/TaskCard/TaskBoard`; edit `web/src/app.tsx:App/ProjectNavigation/RouteLink`, `components.tsx:ResourceStatus`, `styles.css` and `OperatorWebBoundary.shell` for `/app/tasks` and `/app/tasks/new`. Add pure/client cases in `test/operator-task-list.test.ts` and UI cases in new `test/operator-task-browser.test.ts`.
**Test:** Literal red `List and Board preserve identical filtered task IDs and never submit commands` using new production view routes (initially missing). Pure fixture has nine column cases, local/imported tasks and malicious title text. Apply project/state/source/readiness/query filters, toggle views and assert same exact IDs and detail hrefs; unknown query values normalize safely, no state mutation. Client scripted 100+1 pages validates shared fingerprint/cursor; changed fingerprint, repeated/backwards cursor, malformed DTO or 101st page rejects with no fresh partial data; late aborted response cannot replace newer scope. Browser set filters, List→Board→Back/Forward/reload, project→cross-project and refresh; assert query values survive and only active filtered state is represented. Phone visits Ready, Waiting, Stopping and Uncertain using named column tabs and Previous/Next; keyboard activates every column/card, sees real state/reasons and same detail. Paired browser case uses T2's normal Stop and Stop+actual-uncertainty tasks: both are reachable in Stopping List/Board, normal Stop appears only under Work, uncertain Stop additionally appears under Needs attention with its actual reason. Overview open question appears under Needs attention and dependency-only task under Work; View Inbox reaches complete legacy Coordination link. Request observer records zero command POSTs for filters/view/card navigation.
**Implementation:** Gather bounded pages sequentially under one ResourceController abort/generation; dedupe/reject inconsistent identity order, require one catalog fingerprint and no more than 100 pages/10,000 tasks. Store page observation range; show fresh capture time/range and explicit refresh/stale notice, never provider-sync claim. Replace only whole aggregate on successful completion. Share one loaded aggregate across overview/project/cross-project and apply one pure filter pipeline before rendering either view; project path adds immutable project constraint. URL-backed filters are `project` UUID (cross-project), `state` declared column, `source` local/github, `ready` yes/no, `q` max 512, `view` list/board. Parse pathname+search in App and popstate; preserve query while toggling and navigate with canonical URLs. Use nine stable columns and precedence from Planning decisions; original execution labels/holds/readiness/admission stay visible on cards/rows. All tasks have one detail href `/task/:id`; no controls that mutate status. Render task/project/task-lead/source/wait-reason with unavailable labels. Task lead uses T2's retained identity; current project configuration, when shown, is labelled Configured project lead rather than replacing Task lead. Capacity observation explains potential wait, not new admission truth. Overview shows current action preview separately from normal progress, useful no-project/no-task/no-attention states and complete Inbox link. Extend ResourceStatus with resource label so task failures are not called project failures. Desktop named column links scroll to labelled regions; phone shows one labelled column with counts/tabs and previous/next, keeping all columns reachable. Reuse token typography, visible focus and normal links, with no decorative metrics/new UI library.
**Validate:** Run `npm run build && node --test dist/test/operator-task-list.test.js dist/test/operator-client.test.js dist/test/operator-task-browser.test.js`; expect aggregate/filter/navigation parity and real browser access cases green.
**Complete when:** One filtered aggregate drives all views; every state is reachable and navigation changes no domain/provider state.

#### 4. Bounded unfinished-input and frozen-submission recovery

**Task ID:** `T4`
**Depends on:** `T3`
**Prerequisites:** T3 shared data/navigation stable.
**Files and symbols:** New `web/src/composer-state.ts:composerInputSchema/composerRecoverySchema/encodeOutcome/ComposerState/readRecovery/writeRecovery`; edit `web/src/api.ts:OperatorClient.command` only to preserve safe field-path validation detail if needed. New `test/operator-task-composer.test.ts`; extend `test/operator-client.test.ts`.
**Test:** Literal red `frozen recovery persistence is a prerequisite to every task creation POST`. Seed matching valid unfinished input, inject frozen-record encoding/setItem/readback failure, then submit and reload: zero POSTs/tasks/edges/assignments, current input remains in memory, original valid unfinished bytes remain unchanged when the storage write failed, and reload restores only that last successfully saved input. Add newer unsaved edit + quota failure: preserve that edit in memory with explicit recovery-unavailable/last-saved-input notice; reload restores the older persisted input, never claims the rejected edit was saved. Verify valid 16,000-character ASCII outcome plus 512-character title, valid multibyte/control-escaped boundary input, context/links and 128 dependencies fit the agreed envelope when the serialized HTTP command is <=65,536 bytes. Test exact envelope cap and one-byte-over rejection, malformed/corrupt/unknown-version records, quota and readback mismatch. Separate literal red `unknown task creation freezes original command across reload and cannot rekey after authentication failure`: successfully persist frozen recovery, let real fixture POST commit but drop its response, reload and assert exact key/task/assignment IDs/payload, zero automatic POST, and explicit retry sends identical bytes yielding one durable task/edge/assignment. Subsequent 401/403/503/validation/conflict or absent list row cannot discard an earlier unknown. Exact receipt unlocks confirmed state once; failing following GET retains confirmed original saved/Ready outcome. First-attempt definite pre-commit rejection preserves editable input; change generates fresh key on next logical submission, never mutates frozen unknown. Validate whitespace title/outcome, invalid HTTP(S) links, duplicate/foreign dependency choices, 16,001-character combined outcome and 65,537-byte command; focus-error data preserves all input. Logout/expiry clears visible private state; no storage secret/CSRF/session/API cache or automatic replay.
**Implementation:** Strict composer input has project UUID, title max512, nonblank desired outcome max16,000, optional context max16,000, max32 HTTP(S) links each max2048, optional permitted profile UUID and unique max128 dependency UUIDs; `encodeOutcome` appends fixed labelled Context and Reference links sections only when supplied, preserving outcome text and validating total <=16,000. Validate actual `TextEncoder` byte length of the serialized HTTP command <=65,536 before submission; character bounds alone do not prove this. Freeze one `task.create` payload with crypto UUID key/task ID and optional assignment ID when validated submit begins. Storage key `ensemble.ui03.composer.v1` stores schema version/input and status `unfinished|unknown` with exact validated command only for unknown, bounded to 262,144 UTF-8 bytes (256 KiB), using the same byte counter and strict schema in encoder and decoder. Bound agreement: a valid combined outcome caps total raw outcome/context/link text at 16,000 UTF-16 code units, whose JSON encoding is at most 96,000 bytes; title adds at most 3,072 bytes, 128 UUID dependencies and 32 link delimiters plus fixed input keys/IDs add less than 10 KiB. The preserved input is therefore <110 KiB; command contributes <=64 KiB and fixed envelope metadata <2 KiB, totaling <176 KiB, below 256 KiB. Unfinished invalid/unsubmitted input may exceed the snapshot bound; retain it in memory with recovery-unavailable notice and preserve the last successfully saved record. No broad browser cache.

For first submission, encode and runtime-validate the frozen record, successfully setItem it, and read back/validate matching bytes and exact command before calling `OperatorClient.command`. Encoding/quota/storage/readback failure sends ZERO POSTs, returns to editable in-memory input and displays an explicit submission-not-sent/recovery-unavailable notice. Do not delete or replace a valid previous unfinished record on an encoding or failed storage write; label it last successfully saved input. If a write succeeded but readback cannot validate it, still send zero POSTs and do not claim which new edits will restore. Never issue a command POST while the only known persisted record is editable unfinished input. Pending and unknown prohibit duplicate submit, editing/rekeying and switching project into a new submission. Deliberate Reconcile submission requires the same validated frozen persistence precondition and calls the exact same key/payload; inability to persist after an earlier unknown keeps the in-memory command frozen and sends zero POSTs. Once any attempt is unknown, later non-receipt failure keeps unknown frozen; exact matching recorded receipt is the only completion signal. Validate receipt kind=domain, key, task ID/project ID, original open/ready outcome and expected positive final version against frozen creation; a structurally valid but mismatched receipt is unknown, never confirmation. Include wrong-key/task/project/ready receipts in the red test. First-attempt definitive rejection retains editable input and writes unfinished recovery; future altered logical attempt uses fresh IDs/key. Storage restoration occurs only after authenticated session bootstrap; expiry/logout hides/unmounts private composer state and prevents unauthenticated recovery access. Retained sessionStorage may be recovered after authentication in the same tab, explicitly labelled on-device unfinished/unknown, never saved task. Confirmed receipt clears its recovery entry and records original result independently of current task read. No generic recovery engine, confirmation flow or timers/background write retry.
**Validate:** Run `npm run build && node --test dist/test/operator-task-composer.test.js dist/test/operator-client.test.js dist/test/operator-contracts.test.js`; expect state-machine/encoding/bounds/field-error/replay cases green.
**Complete when:** Unfinished input and uncertain submission are distinguishable, bounded and recoverable without duplicate creation or a false absence/success claim.

#### 5. Substantial composer and truthful persisted outcome presentation

**Task ID:** `T5`
**Depends on:** `T4`
**Prerequisites:** T4 encoding/recovery/state green, T1 atomic producer and T2 options available.
**Files and symbols:** New `web/src/task-composer.tsx:TaskComposer/CreationReceipt`; wire `/app/tasks/new` and New task actions in `app.tsx`/`task-views.tsx`; add labelled textarea/select/error elements in `components.tsx` where shared, composer action-bar/layout styles in `styles.css`. Extend `test/operator-task-composer.test.ts` and `test/operator-task-browser.test.ts`.
**Test:** Literal red `Save draft and Create and start record real task outcomes without claiming running`. Real service browser selects project/title/outcome/context/two links/permitted worker/open same-project blocker. Save draft: API receipt ready=false and exact encoded outcome/dependency/assignee persisted; zero turns. Separate Create and start: ready=true, existing blocker/pause/configuration/capacity reason visible, never optimistic Running. Exercise enabled eligible fake-runtime fixture and assert Running only after actual read indicates running. Change project clears stale options/selections with explanation; delayed old options cannot replace new project's choices; revoke selected profile before POST rejects atomically with input intact. Browser seeds matching valid unfinished input, makes frozen storage fail, submits and reloads: zero command requests/task effects, visible input retained until reload, and matching last successfully saved input restored. A newer unsaved edit/quota case explicitly reports recovery unavailable and restores only older saved input. Separately persist frozen recovery successfully, drop response after real committed POST, reload, assert on-device unknown notice and disabled alternate creation, authenticate if needed and reconcile once, one durable task/edge/assignment. Trigger invalid fields, 409, confirmed rejection, current-read failure and expiry with unsent input; labels/errors/entered values and correct unknown/recorded distinction persist. Open imported card detail, assert source title/body read-only and no local-composer Edit path; direct imported configure still rejected. Long laptop/phone composer scrolls while both action buttons remain reachable and do not occlude last input.
**Implementation:** Full labelled project/title/outcome/context/reference links/optional assignee/dependency form with outcome as substantial multiline primary content. Project route preselects project; cross-project route requires selection. Fetch validated composer options per project with scoped abort/generation, show unavailable/loading/stale states and no unverified profile choices. Dependencies are existing same-project task selections; show imported identity if present and explain references do not grant access. Show accountable project lead and default allocation/routing choice; explicit active permitted profile bypasses routing only, not admission. Primary Create and start and secondary Save draft remain enabled for paused projects once form/options valid, with before-submit explanation of pause/configuration/dependency/capacity/ownership eligibility; do not reinterpret disabled mockup as domain rule. Connect T4 submission state to one enriched command only after its frozen-persistence/readback precondition; storage failure is an inline submission-not-sent error with current input preserved, not a command attempt or a saved newer draft. Inline field validation focuses first invalid control; service error codes are safe text, not raw exceptions. On recorded receipt show durable draft or Ready confirmation with task link, then refresh list/current task; current read supplies actual execution/wait reasons. If read fails, keep recorded confirmation and mark execution status unavailable; original receipt does not become stale/unknown. Unfinished recovered fields have explicit Resume unfinished input/Discard unfinished input controls; discard is available only before any uncertain submission. Imported tasks never enter composer as edits. Keep local task.configure in legacy detail available until #742 replaces detail.
**Validate:** Run `npm run build && node --test dist/test/operator-task-composer.test.js dist/test/operator-task-browser.test.js dist/test/operator-api.test.js dist/test/operator-web-integration.test.js`; expect draft/start/policy/input/reload/receipt/browser cases green.
**Complete when:** The real authenticated composer records exactly one domain command, preserves failures, and presents actual durable outcome separately from current execution.

#### 6. Integrated service/browser qualification and accurate evidence

**Task ID:** `T6`
**Depends on:** `T5`
**Prerequisites:** T1–T5 green.
**Files and symbols:** Finish `test/operator-task-browser.test.ts`, relevant HTTP/integration tests and existing `test/fixtures/operator-web.ts` only for bounded UI03 fixture setup; update `docs/design/ui02-foundation.md` retained inventory, `docs/SPEC.md` implementation-status paragraph, `docs/acceptance.md` implemented evidence reference; add `docs/design/ui03-tasks.md`, `docs/evidence/ui03-tasks.md`. Update `README.md` only its implemented UI access/limitations if affected; leave product/ADR contracts unchanged.
**Test:** Literal red `UI03 critical journeys remain usable at laptop phone and scaled layout` at 1366×820, 390×844 and 683×410 (scale factor2 as existing approximation, not native zoom proof). One bounded browser journey signs in, creates draft, creates ready dependent task, observes wait, navigates filtered List/Board to same detail, returns with filters, resolves blocker using existing permitted fixture/domain command, observes eligible fake turn and retained Stop/uncertainty without bypass. Keep paired normal-Stop-in-Work and actual-uncertain-Stop-in-attention cases reachable in Stopping List/Board at laptop and phone layouts. Include no-project/empty/no-match/error/stale/populated/composer-unknown states, failed-frozen-storage zero-POST reload and successful-persistence committed/lost-response exact-key reconciliation; keyboard Tab/Shift+Tab/Enter/Space, board previous/next/tab navigation and mobile drawer Escape/focus restoration. Assert controls intersect viewport and hit-test unoccluded, no document horizontal overflow, literal malicious text, readable type/contrast/focus, same-origin-only requests, zero CSP violations/page errors. New GETs reject unauthorized access; enriched commands reject actor/extra authority/invalid JSON/body sizes/wrong Origin/CSRF; after expiry no private rendered task/composer data. Restart exact creation receipts and unknown reconciliation; retain source ownership tests. Evidence screenshot path uses `test/temp.ts`, outside removed service fixture, and cleanup awaits listener/auth/service/runtime/browser closures and removes temp DB/workspaces.
**Implementation:** Use real StandaloneService/SQLite and built production React/API/listener, deterministic runtime/routing only. No static HTML/mock-client result substitutes and no new actual runtime/model call: #741 changes presentation and durable domain creation, while native bridge qualification remains separately paused. Extend existing fixtures minimally, not with new scenario framework. Capture realistic populated overview/List/Board, each held board column, long composer, confirmed draft/Ready, unknown/recovered, empty and error screenshots at relevant viewports. Record exact versions, commands, counts, failures/repairs, screenshot paths and cleanup evidence. State observed coverage as UI03 delivery evidence; distinguish static design approval, fake-runtime service integration, unaffected earlier real-runtime evidence and still-unproved UI01/runtime-question/final integrated UI acceptance. Inventory marks new composer/list/board delivered while retaining `/task` local configure and Runtime/Coordination destinations and their future owners; no route deletion.
**Validate:** Run `npm run build && node --test dist/test/operator-task-browser.test.js dist/test/operator-web-http.test.js dist/test/operator-web-integration.test.js dist/test/operator-api.test.js dist/test/domain.test.js dist/test/scheduler.test.js`, then `npm run check` and `git diff --check`. Expect all new journeys and existing auth/privacy/approval/source/recovery tests pass with no failure/cancellation/skip; retained screenshots survive awaited teardown and no fixture listener/browser/runtime remains. Root performs independent final review and CI/remote delivery.
**Complete when:** Every acceptance row below has checked evidence, documentation truthfully separates delivered UI03 from remaining child/release work, and implementation owner has completed/cleaned integration validation without user test handoff.

### Acceptance coverage

| Acceptance criterion | Slice | Verification |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Overview urgency is distinct from normal/dependency/Stop-observation progress and links complete Inbox | T2, T3, T6 | task-catalog attention classification and paired normal-Stop/uncertain-Stop service/browser cases; real overview/Inbox journey |
| Cross-project and project List/Board identical filtered sets and preserved filters/detail destination; navigation changes no state | T3, T6 | shared exact-ID filtering, URL/popstate/reload and zero-command navigation browser cases |
| Cards identify project/task lead/source/reasons; Ready-blocked, Stopping and Uncertain remain visible | T2, T3, T6 | curated mixed catalog, retained-lead/project-reconfiguration public-summary regression and nine-column keyboard/phone traversal |
| Composer project/outcome/context/links/permitted explicit assignee/dependencies; no repository access from references | T1, T2, T4, T5 | atomic same-project/profile-policy tests, deterministic outcome encoding, real composer selections and passive-link/no external request check |
| Save draft/start use persisted domain commands; configuration/pause/capacity/dependency holds explained without creation-as-running | T1, T5, T6 | atomic wakeup/admission/rollback, fake runtime draft/held/eligible journeys, original receipt/current-read separation |
| Validation/network failures preserve input; device recovery distinct from durable task | T4, T5, T6 | byte-bound agreement and failed-frozen-persistence zero-POST/last-saved-input cases; persisted committed/lost-response exact-key replay; auth failure/confirmed receipt plus failed GET/reload browser cases |
| Imported titles/bodies cannot be edited via composer | T1, T5, T6 | imported policy regression, read-only legacy detail and absent Edit/composer route |
| Automated service/browser checks cover filters, held states, empty/error, phone/laptop actions | T1–T6 | listed real SQLite/listener/browser cases at three viewports, full pinned check and teardown evidence |

### Final validation

- From the isolated implementation checkout root, with verified pinned Node/npm PATH and installed dependencies: `npm run check`, then `git diff --check`. All type checks, lint, formatting, service/Vite builds and full Node/browser tests must pass. Existing four unchanged lint warnings and Vite dependency directive warnings may be retained if unchanged and recorded accurately. Do not change dependency versions or install a frontend library for this scope.
- Planning reused current trusted baseline evidence: pinned UI02 full check 347/347 and required Ubuntu CI `check` SUCCESS at run 36952300096/job110667666081 for PR #748's merged source. Read-only planning did not rerun/install baseline. Implementation must run pinned `npm ci` and its complete check; CI runs the same check and installs Chromium. Use available cached pinned Chromium locally; if absent, explicitly provision the package's Chromium in authorized implementation environment and record version. No real Codex/TypeSafe call is needed for this presentation/domain-command slice.
- Implementation owner runs and cleans all required service/browser evidence. Root owns fresh final-head independent review, applicable required CI, source/plan/claim refresh, publication, PR/merge actions and final acceptance. UI03 completion cannot close parent #736 or qualify native structured questions, external delivery, deployment or cutover.

### Review focus

- Atomic creation must not leak a Ready interval before dependencies/assignee; preserve omitted-field hashes, one outer receipt, original replay after revoked settings and post-commit uncertainty.
- Catalog consistency must not admit partial/stale pages as complete; group/filter identity and safe prose must be shared, source status separate, and catalog fingerprint must contain only identity data. Task lead must remain the retained same-task binding after project-lead reconfiguration, with its captured safe name; current project lead is separate configuration, not a replacement identity.
- Recovery producer/consumer byte bounds must cover every valid composer/HTTP payload. Successful validated frozen persistence/readback is a POST precondition; failed storage sends nothing and distinguishes current in-memory edits from last successfully saved input. An unknown submission remains frozen after later authentication or validation failure; confirmed receipt remains confirmed after refresh failure. SessionStorage is unfinished-device recovery only.
- Privacy and attention must use current public policy facts without exposing retained instructions or presenting historic resolved routing failures or normal Stop observation as current operator work. Stop precedence cannot hide actual unresolved uncertainty or a separate current action request.
