content.title: UI04: Deliver unified task detail and readable histories

nodes.body:
> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Agent Brief

**Category:** enhancement

**Summary:** Deliver unified task detail, readable histories, review evidence and search.

**Current behavior:**
Task information is split among local, runtime and coordination pages. Captured assistant history renders expanded lists with explicit retention/incompleteness notices.

**Desired behavior:**
Implement a unified task workspace, source/execution separation, assignment-grouped activity and preserved reading/reply state, retaining every supported execution and recovery control. Include the reviewed evidence, contextual feedback, assignment-context and delivery disclosures, plus search of retained work and its shared desktop/phone navigation.

**Key interfaces:**
CoordinationTaskView; ConversationHistoryAssignmentRead; task and assignment identity; runtime control commands; GitHub source and remote-write receipts.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- [ ] Task detail combines lead, assignments, results, requests and execution controls while keeping unresolved questions/approvals/holds outside collapsed history.
- [ ] Group by durable assignment; opening a group shows a bounded recent preview and result with earlier retained content reachable. Long-message disclosure, Expand/Collapse all and chronological captured-history view work.
- [ ] Incoming updates preserve expanded groups, scroll anchor and unfinished reply; follow new content only at the bottom, otherwise offer an explicit jump.
- [ ] Retain provenance, redaction, retention limits and incomplete-capture notices; previews use source text rather than generated summaries.
- [ ] Imported title/body are read-only with Edit on GitHub; show identity/link, last successful sync, stale/failure and refresh separately from Ensemble execution and source-owned native dependencies.
- [ ] Message lead and permitted Post comment to GitHub show distinct destinations; remote outcomes remain pending/confirmed/failed/uncertain under existing permission and reconciliation rules.
- [ ] Approval and execution controls retain exact-material validation and dependency/Stop/ownership holds; laptop and phone preserve usable scroll/reply/action areas.
- [ ] Browser checks cover long history updates, reply preservation, imported ownership, failed sync and uncertain remote writes.

- [ ] Supplied criteria show supported/failed/unverified/stale evidence with recorded result, assignment and revision relationships, without inferring an overall pass. Before/after captures retain labels and revision context; missing, unavailable, redacted and mismatched captures are explicit on desktop and phone.
- [ ] “Ask lead for changes” opens an editable local-message draft bound to the exact result, criterion or artifact and names the lead destination. Confirmed sends show a receipt, confirmed failures retain input for retry, and unknown outcomes reconcile before resending without duplication. Feedback never approves/rejects, changes task state or posts to GitHub.
- [ ] Changes since the recorded viewing reference distinguish new results, superseded evidence and source-requirement revisions; no baseline, unavailable comparison and failed refresh are explicit. Viewing does not approve work or clear holds.
- [ ] Captured brief supplier/version, instruction/profile revisions and source references remain distinct from current requirements. Show capture gaps; available references are not labelled read without evidence, and secrets/full-runtime visibility are not exposed or implied.
- [ ] Recorded files/commits/result diffs and PR/check/finding relationships retain checked head/revision and recorded repair ownership. No PR, stale/changed head and merged-but-incomplete task states remain truthful. Provider refresh performs no write; existing exact approvals and independent holds remain effective.
- [ ] Search is reachable in shared desktop and phone navigation. Permitted retained task/decision/result matches each carry project, parent task and record type, including similar cross-project matches. Open the exact section/revision with historical material labelled; return preserves query, filters, selected match and reading position, plus the originating workspace view. Show no matches, partial coverage and failures distinctly; do not promise complete transcript capture or expose review-only state specimens as product navigation.
- [ ] Deterministic browser/service/persistence checks cover these review/search journeys, keyboard access, failure/uncertain outcomes and preserved disclosures/drafts. #745 retains assembled integration and final evidence delivery to #736.

**Out of scope:**
No fabricated full runtime transcript, native dependency override, model-generated summaries or new external-write permissions. Integrate the delivery interface merged in #738; do not duplicate it. #737 is no longer a whole-ticket prerequisite. Browser fixtures may verify delivery presentation while #737's recovery/live qualification continues; #745/#697 retain final real external-delivery integration.

**Shared boundaries and validation:**
Use the approved specification, acceptance criteria and design handoff linked from #736. React + Vite, same-origin service APIs and selective Radix controls are the approved architecture. Preserve server-owned policy and runtime trust limits. Run proportional automated tests and pinned npm ci / npm run check for implementation; the implementation owner performs required browser/live validation. These briefs authorise scoped planning outcomes, not immediate dispatch, deployment, merge or cutover. Current Project status and assignment are authoritative; this amendment does not dispatch work. X01-X08 remain deferred.


## Approved amendment — 3 October 2026

Chris approved the bounded preview and prerequisite changes above. Preserve reading position, replies, provenance and all service permissions/holds.

## Reviewed task, evidence and search amendment — 3 October 2026

Chris agreed to carry the reviewed Pen extensions into the specification, acceptance checks and delivery briefs. Status: **design reviewed; implementation deferred**. Static canvas review is not implemented capability, runtime evidence or Chris's final acceptance of the integrated UI.

Product behaviour is recorded in `docs/SPEC.md`, “Task overview and evidence — design direction, 3 October 2026”; qualification is recorded in `docs/acceptance.md`, “Task overview and evidence design review — 3 October 2026”. The revised visual source is `design/design.pen`, with node identities, connected journeys and state boundaries in `design/DESIGN.md`. The 1 October immutable handoff links in #736 are historical and do not include these extensions; the amended documents and design currently reside in the design checkout and their publication remains outstanding. Screen preview exports are removed; the two fictional comparison captures remain as source assets. Pen MCP still renders placeholders after relocation, so comparison-image loading remains unverified.

#742 owns task review, captured context, recorded changes/delivery, search and the shared desktop/phone navigation required to reach search. #745 owns integrated qualification. #736 retains the overall scope and Chris's final integrated visual/usability acceptance. Do not reopen completed #741 scope or create a separate search ticket. Current assignments, Project status and native dependencies remain authoritative; this amendment does not dispatch implementation or reopen deferred integrations.

> **Superseded on 3 October 2026:** #738 has merged. Chris approved removing #737 as a whole-ticket prerequisite for #742. Use the merged interface and deterministic browser fixtures for presentation; retain final external-delivery integration in #745/#697. This historical blocker no longer pauses all UI04 work.

<!-- run-github-project:planning-blocker:v1 -->
UI04 planning is blocked by the missing S07a external-delivery interface.

Verified against main at 3b98566ba5ea81d73f53f1b7983e441721b64500: the baseline has no DeliveryStore, DeliveryCoordinator or GitHubDeliveryProvider. S07a #737 owns these interfaces in unmerged PR #738. The reviewed UI03 candidate adds task views and creation, not external delivery.

The approved Agent Brief requires separate Message lead/Post comment to GitHub destinations, existing permission and reconciliation rules, truthful pending/confirmed/failed/uncertain outcomes, and uncertain-write browser coverage. It explicitly prohibits implementing a duplicate when a prerequisite is missing. UI04 cannot satisfy those criteria against this baseline.

Record #737 as a native prerequisite. Resume planning after its accepted delivery interface is available in the implementation base, then revalidate source, overlap and API contracts against that verified base. No new permission or stakeholder contract is proposed.

Actual Planning status and the exclusive chrisbanes assignment are preserved. No implementation plan, branch, PR or partial implementation was created for #742. Backlog and all existing dependencies remain outside this action.

<!-- to-plan:implementation-plan:v2 -->

**Revision:** 1
**Supersedes:** none
**Replan report:** none

## Implementation plan

**Issue:** https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/issues/742
**Planned against:** `main` at `516b9ccce061c47cd2ad7c6a199e35a7e4ea48a7`
**Publication mode:** Autonomous
**Local state:** Clean
**Epoch closure:** null

### Approach

Publish the already-approved 3 October source first, preserving newer UI08 documentation. Build one React task workspace on the authenticated same-origin operator boundary, backed by the existing coordination/runtime/delivery stores and a small additive review-record store. Retain source and result revisions instead of manufacturing missing evidence from conversation text. Add search over permitted retained tasks, decisions and results, with exact record navigation and preserved return state.

Authoritative requirements are the Agent Brief at https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/issues/742#issuecomment-5941788992 and the 3 October amendments in the issue body; `docs/SPEC.md` “Task overview and evidence — design direction, 3 October 2026”; `docs/acceptance.md` “Task overview and evidence design review — 3 October 2026”; and the reviewed interaction handoff in `design/DESIGN.md`. The historical planning-blocker comment is superseded by the merged #738 delivery interface. The reviewed source is preserved at `f535d97b8b87fa525790cc68dd7a0c25ff5a74a1`; T1 publishes its approved source before dependent implementation. The visual fixtures are fictional illustrations, not runtime evidence.

### Guardrails

- Preserve server authentication, origin/CSRF checks, runtime validation, idempotency, exact material/revision approvals, readiness/dependency/source/Stop/ownership holds and existing runtime trust/recovery limits. Browser state establishes no execution or provider success.
- Imported title/body/native dependencies/Project fields remain source-owned. No locally editable competing specification, generated summaries/criteria, inferred reads/repair ownership, overall pass or automatic acceptance from check counts. Missing evidence remains missing.
- No new external-write grant, provider implementation, runtime capability, separate frontend service, UI05 structured-question implementation, X01–X08 work, deployment, cutover or installed Haze change. Existing structured requests remain unresolved and reachable through the delivered service/retained control seam until UI05 implements their forms.
- Continue ordinary implementation, test/fixture, documentation and CI repairs with the delivery owner under the progress gate. A wrong approved seam or factual assumption permits one focused diagnosis and at most two plan-mismatch repair cycles; ordinary defects do not consume those cycles. Preserve work and stop on material contract/architecture/authority changes or exhausted grants. No per-stage user approval for already-approved scope.
- Root owns GitHub mutation, final integration and acceptance. Reuse the delivery record and still-valid evidence. Require one fresh independent full integrated review before push, assessing correctness/standards, reuse/clarity/efficiency, and overengineering separately; keep repairs with the delivery owner.

### Planning decisions

- `CoordinationTaskView` already supplies results, messages, requests, assignments and delivery. `OperatorApi.readTask` supplies safe task/source/execution data but omits delivery and review records. Extend the curated operator projection rather than exposing raw store/runtime objects or scraping legacy HTML.
- Review metadata is optional and additive to a real revision-bound `ensemble_report_result` callback. Store explicit result/assignment/work revision, supplied criterion/source-snapshot anchors, recorded validation/provenance/scope, artifact roles/pairing, changes and attributed decisions. A recorded outcome is shown with its provenance; an agent claim is not independently verified. Existing results retain their summaries and visibly lack optional records. Invalid cross-task/revision links fail before any result/receipt commit; result and associated records commit atomically and callback replay compares the entire material.
- Requirements snapshots store only supplied, sanitized source/local content. Extract only literal supported structured/checklist content as criterion records, with immutable source-snapshot/position anchors and documented extraction coverage; never invent criteria or align changed criteria by guessed semantic similarity. Without supported structured records, say “No structured criterion records; consult the supplied brief” because prose can contain supplied criteria. Current requirements and assignment-captured requirements remain separate. Source snapshot changes explicitly supersede earlier coverage; new scope remains unverified even where an earlier scope passed.
- Capture assignment supplier and brief/version at assignment creation, and each work's instruction/profile/source revisions at preparation, using actual local creation/routing/delegation identities. Reconstruct only facts already retained for older assignments and label other capture gaps. Available references do not imply read. Keep private instruction text/credential values out of the operator review/search records; expose safe revision/reference facts and public supplied brief only under current exclusions.
- Use the trusted installation's existing single operator as the viewing-reference principal, not a CSRF token or a new account model. Persist a bounded viewed snapshot only through an authenticated explicit record-view command after the UI successfully opens that exact result/source set; routine polling/refresh does not advance it. Preserve the previous reference while the current workspace is open. First visit has no baseline; viewing has no approval/completion/hold effect. “Viewed” records opened material, not proof the operator read it.
- Artifact records are references, not an attachment platform. Support sanitized HTTP(S) original links and bounded authenticated previews of recorded regular PNG/JPEG files inside that task's service-owned workspace. Resolve the recorded artifact ID server-side, require canonical containment within the currently bound task workspace, open with O_NOFOLLOW and check the opened handle is a regular file with the allowed MIME/size and recorded identity/version. Revalidate current task/workspace binding, record revision/availability and redaction before and after asynchronous reads; detect pathname replacement or identity/version drift and return explicit mismatch/unavailable rather than serving substituted material. Reject traversal, symlinks, oversized/unsupported files and cross-task lookup; no arbitrary client file path or remote proxy fetch. Failed preview preserves original metadata and explicit availability/redaction/mismatch state. Result diff is retained sanitized text or an attributed recorded reference, never a live diff silently substituted for a historical revision.
- Local contextual feedback extends the existing durable message with an optional exact result/criterion/artifact/source/work reference, validated and persisted in the same inbox/receipt transaction. Destination remains the accountable task lead and input remains editable after confirmed rejection. Unknown outcome reconciles the original key and exact payload; no fresh-key retry until resolved. Local receipt proves message persistence only.
- Direct GitHub posting must use the #738 delivery coordinator/store, never fabricate a runtime thread/turn. Implement a narrow authenticated operator `issue.comment` caller resolved server-side from the current task/source identity and policy/material versions, retaining the same grants/approval modes, holds, task/target serialization, prepared intent and provider reconciliation. Construct actor/caller/target server-side; clients never choose actor, repository/issue binding, assignment or work IDs. Restrict operator actor to issue.comment at every store/service/effect boundary and explicitly backward-parse legacy persisted runtime callers without converting them to operators. Operator posting grants no bypass or additional permission; unavailable grant/exact approval disables posting with a reason. Approval-mode posting uses a real operator review/confirmation binding for the exact body/target and task/source/policy revisions; session login or a generic approval boolean never suffices. This narrow caller choice was accepted by the lead during planning.
- Search uses bounded SQLite-backed query/projection over safe retained requirement snapshots, explicit recorded decisions and results, with project/type/date/historical filters, deterministic stable record IDs and cursor ordering. Recheck current permitted projects and redaction at response and exact-record opening; omitted/unsafe/unretained records produce explicit coverage rather than complete-transcript claims. No semantic-search dependency or raw runtime transcript index.
- Retain `/task/:id`, `/coordination/task/:id`, `/coordination/assignment/:id` and `/runtime/task/:id` as supported legacy control destinations. React `/app/tasks/:id` is the unified destination; existing task links and attention entry points select it with their exact request/result/assignment anchor. Keep advanced controls linked when equivalent React controls are outside this issue. Retained HTML behavior must remain consistent and usable; no context-menu, extension or notification surface is introduced.

Cleanup operates only on the verified task-owned session/process/resource identity, gracefully first; no process-name termination. Failed or unknown launch/callback/terminal/cleanup consumes the sole attempt: stop, preserve intent/ledger/uncertainty and applicable holds, and return scoped evidence to root. No replacement task/thread/turn, no automatic retry, no broader capability claim.

### Acceptance coverage

| Acceptance criterion from #742 Agent Brief | Slice | Verification |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Unified lead/assignments/results/requests/controls; unresolved questions/approvals/holds outside collapsed history | T5 | workspace browser pending-request/collapse and control inventory |
| Durable grouping, bounded recent source-text preview/result, earlier content, long disclosure, expand/collapse and chronological view | T3, T5 | history read identities/retention and long-history browser |
| Updates retain expansion/anchor/reply; bottom following and explicit jump | T5 | append/load-earlier/off-bottom/focus assertions |
| Provenance/redaction/retention/incomplete notices; no generated preview | T2, T3, T5 | exclusion/restart tests and literal source-text browser |
| Imported read-only source identity/title/body/GitHub edit, sync staleness/failure/refresh and native dependencies separate | T2, T3, T5 | S1/S2/source failure and ownership browser |
| Message lead vs permitted GitHub post; existing pending/confirmed/failed/uncertain policy/reconciliation | T4, T5 | actor/grant/hold/provider-count/uncertainty tests |
| Exact approvals, dependencies/Stop/ownership; laptop/phone reading/reply/actions | T4, T5, T8 | stale material/hold tests and viewport/control walkthrough |
| Browser long updates, reply preservation, imported ownership, failed sync, uncertain writes | T5 | workspace fault journeys |
| Supplied supported/failed/unverified/stale evidence with result/assignment/revision; comparison labels and missing/unavailable/redacted/mismatch; no overall pass | T2, T6 | S1/R2/R3/S2 scope fixture and desktop/phone comparison |
| Ask lead exact context/local destination/editable draft; receipt/failure/unknown reconciliation, no task/GitHub/approval effects | T4, T6 | feedback replay/provider/state counts and browser anchored draft |
| Viewing-reference new/superseded/source changes; no baseline/unknown/failed refresh; viewing clears no hold | T3, T6 | view-reference restart/polling/hold tests and disclosure |
| Captured supplier/brief/version/instruction/profile/source refs vs current; gaps/read/privacy truthful | T2, T6 | production capture/privacy tests and context browser |
| Files/commits/diff/PR/check/findings/head/repair records; no-PR/stale/merged incomplete; read-only refresh/exact holds | T2, T3, T6 | changes/delivery fixtures and provider-write count |
| Shared desktop/phone Search; permitted attributed cross-project task/decision/results; exact historical section/revision, full return state; no-match/partial/failure | T3, T7 | search service/SQLite and keyboard/browser connected return |
| Deterministic service/persistence/browser review/search, keyboard, failures/unknown and preserved disclosure/drafts; #745 integrated delivery | T2–T8 | named focused suites plus complete check and evidence handoff |

### Final validation

- Execute V then `npm run check` in the implementation checkout. Preserve exact check result, source tree/head and browser evidence inventory.
- Implementation owner performs required screenshot/keyboard checks and the finite changed-runtime-callback validation below; no incremental testing handed to Chris. Root retains external mutation ownership, canonical shared-resource grant and immediate pre-attempt readiness/authority check.
- Refresh live issue/plan/base/overlap state before root publication or dispatch. This local draft has not been published; parent owns the refresh/publication/active-plan digest chain.
- #745/#697 retain real integrated external-delivery qualification; the closed #737 supplies its completed reusable proof and documented recovery limits rather than an outstanding whole-ticket gate. #736 retains Chris's final integrated visual/usability acceptance. Design image loading and any actual-device/keyboard-overlay gap must remain labelled until actually verified.

### Review focus

- Atomic source/result/evidence relationships and replay hashing must prevent cross-task associations or silent historical retargeting.
- Operator delivery must not impersonate runtime authority or widen a grant; recheck policy/material/identity/holds after awaits and retain uncertain intent through restart.
- Sanitization and artifact traversal/symlink bounds must apply before storage/projection/search and when opening retained references.
- Navigation/auth/update state must preserve exact historical selections without retaining private content after expiry or implying that viewing/check/merge clears independent controls.
- Keep review/search storage and rendering bounded; avoid a generic workflow engine, attachment service, semantic index or duplicated UI primitives.

content.title: UI05: Deliver the Inbox and durable structured questions

nodes.body:
> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Agent Brief

**Category:** enhancement

**Summary:** Deliver the Inbox and durable structured questions.

**Current behavior:**
Durable plain-text questions, approvals and operator attention exist, but the complete cross-project Inbox and structured request model/form flow are missing.

**Desired behavior:**
Implement a dedicated action Inbox and extend the durable interaction model, SQLite persistence and qualified runtime transport to structured questions shown consistently in Inbox and task detail.

**Key interfaces:**
CoordinationInteraction; CoordinationStore.requestQuestion/answerQuestion; CoordinationView; operator attention; qualified native input adapter and assignment/request identity.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- [ ] Inbox contains unresolved operator actions ordered by agreed urgency then age, with project/task/requester context; routine results remain outside it.
- [ ] Individual/grouped questions support free text, single/multiple choice, descriptions, constraints and explicit recommendations/custom text where permitted. Preselection never submits an answer.
- [ ] Validate answers against the stored question schema. Persist before acknowledging and deliver to the exact requesting assignment/runtime request; ordinary messages and approvals remain separate actions.
- [ ] Schema migration preserves existing plain-text interactions. Restart/replay tests prevent duplicate responses or continuations and reject stale/cancelled/already answered or conflicting submissions.
- [ ] Pending/recorded/failed/stale/cancelled/offline/unsupported states are distinct; failed input is retained, unsupported requests remain unresolved, and holds from pause/Stop/dependencies/ownership remain enforced.
- [ ] Desktop queue/detail scroll independently; phone queue/detail/form navigation preserves input and position; response controls never cover content and confirmation does not auto-select the next item.
- [ ] Meet acceptance A12 and UI01/UI02 with deterministic persistence/fault/browser tests for the full form model and a bounded live round trip for qualified native shapes, reusing still-valid #739 and assembled UI evidence. A fixture or plain-text substitute cannot establish native round-trip support.

**Out of scope:**
No new approval authority, silent chat fallback, auto-answering recommendations, runtime replacement or waiver of transport qualification.

**Shared boundaries and validation:**
Use the approved specification, acceptance criteria and design handoff linked from #736. React + Vite, same-origin service APIs and selective Radix controls are the approved architecture. Preserve server-owned policy and runtime trust limits. Run proportional automated tests and pinned npm ci / npm run check for implementation; the implementation owner performs required browser/live validation. These briefs authorise scoped planning outcomes, not immediate dispatch, deployment, merge or cutover. Current Project status and assignment are authoritative; this amendment does not dispatch work. X01-X08 remain deferred.


## Approved amendment — 3 October 2026

The full Ensemble question model and UI support individual/grouped free text, single/multiple choice, descriptions, constraints and recommendations/custom text where permitted. Qualify those form behaviours with deterministic service/SQLite/browser tests or Ensemble's own question tools. Native runtime acceptance is limited to the shapes qualified by #739: the observed single-choice/custom-text round trip and deterministic grouped-shape coverage. No new live proof of native free-text, multiple-selection or recommendation support is required for this MVP. Unsupported native shapes remain visibly unresolved; never fabricate an answer, silently convert to chat or claim unproved native support. Preserve durable identity, answer persistence, duplicate prevention and all holds.

<!-- to-plan:implementation-plan:v2 -->

**Revision:** 1
**Supersedes:** none
**Replan report:** none

## Implementation plan

**Issue:** https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/issues/743
**Planned against:** `main` at `6e1a70d3e0b4ab4b8957328cc67a30a7effbc23f`
**Publication mode:** Autonomous
**Local state:** Clean committed baseline; no source/test changes during planning
**Epoch closure:** null

### Approach

Extend the existing coordination interaction and receipt system with the full Ensemble form model; adapt the qualified native question model into that presentation without changing its codec or delivery protocol. Add curated typed request/answer and action-Inbox reads to the existing authenticated API. Use one response state/controller and form across Inbox and task detail, retaining the exact durable request and original command during uncertainty. Replace the transitional task-list Inbox with a cross-project action queue and shared request/detail/evidence navigation. Prove persistence, identity, holds, failures and desktop/phone behavior through the production service, real SQLite and production browser build; reuse #739's scoped native round trip rather than launch another runtime qualification.

### Guardrails

- Authoritative contract: [#743 Agent Brief](https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/issues/743#issuecomment-5941791161), its 3 October amendment, [parent #736](https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/issues/736), SPEC attention/human-request sections, acceptance A12/UI01/UI02, ADR-1004/1005/1007 and `design/DESIGN.md` responsive/interaction guidance. #739/#740/#742 are completed prerequisites whose required code/evidence exists in this baseline. Project status/assignment and root's fresh source/overlap checks govern dispatch; labels alone do not.
- Answers grant no approval, task completion, ownership release or unrelated permission. Keep exact-material approvals and ordinary messages separate. Preserve pause, Stop, dependency, source, power, capacity and uncertain ownership controls; recorded answer is distinct from runtime delivery and subsequent admission. No auto-answering recommendations, silent chat conversion, forced retry, runtime replacement, new routing/eval calls or new approval authority.
- Preserve the version-qualified native codec, exact typed endpoint/generation/thread/turn/item identity, request digest, answer digest, immutable reply intent, one allowed identical replay, ordered receipt, callback settlement and recovery boundary. No raw endpoint/process/configuration values in browser DTOs. Unsupported/unavailable interactions stay unresolved with truthful known/unknown context; never fabricate a native question row or infer support from a fixture.
- No new live model/runtime attempt is granted by this plan. The 3 October amendment accepts the full form model through deterministic service/SQLite/production-browser or own-tool tests and reuses #739's observed single-choice/custom-text native journey plus deterministic grouped coverage. A demonstrated changed native boundary or failure stops that dependent claim for root's concrete settlement and finite grant; do not repeat old grants or broaden native shape support.
- Keep installed Haze, deployment/cutover, historical failed fixtures/consumed ledgers and all existing holds intact. X01–X08 remain deferred/non-MVP gates. #745/#697 retain assembled external-delivery qualification; #736 retains Chris's final integrated visual/usability acceptance. Static design fixtures and browser viewport simulations do not qualify physical-phone/OS-keyboard behavior.
- Continue routine implementation and fixture corrections within unchanged requirements, coverage, architecture and authority; record the correction and renew affected evidence. A factual plan mismatch allows one focused diagnosis and two repair cycles; ordinary repairs do not consume that budget. Investigate unknown overlap; stop for material design/contract changes or exhausted grants. Reuse existing delivery records and valid checks/reviews; use an integration amendment only for a changed published integration decision needing durable consumption.

### Planning decisions

- Add a versioned full Ensemble schema in `src/core/question-forms.ts` (new). It is separate from `structured-questions.ts`, whose current 32-question grouped single-choice/custom native transport remains unchanged. Use discriminated free-text/single-choice/multiple-choice questions, stable question/option IDs, exact labels/descriptions, explicit required/text-length/selection-cardinality constraints, optional explicit recommendation/preselection and explicit custom-text permission. Validate constraints against option count and bounds, unique IDs, recommendation/preselection membership, and custom permission; do not infer recommendation from label suffixes. An answer distinguishes option IDs from custom text and maps every question exactly once; an optional unanswered question has an explicit empty value, never a missing unknown key. Multi-choice is a set of unique known options plus custom text only when allowed, subject to cardinality. Do not silently trim supplied answer text or replace IDs with display labels.
- Settled defensive bounds: at most 32 questions, 100 options/question, 512-character IDs/labels and 16000-character text fields; full request and full answer JSON each <=256 KiB UTF-8. Explicit lower per-question constraints are validated and enforced against stored schema. These are full Ensemble defensive bounds, not new native guarantees. Browser-friendly schema must not import Node crypto/Buffer; use the existing `TextEncoder` pattern for UTF-8 size. Native adaptation maps qualified labels losslessly to stable option IDs and maps selected/custom answers back through the original native validator; retain original request bytes/digest and never reinterpret an unqualified shape.
- Use additive coordination-owned persistence (a companion table keyed by `interactionId`, containing versioned schema/answer/digest and request lifecycle), retaining existing plain interactions, statuses and historic receipts. Plain rows are presented as a single required free-text question without rewriting their stored prompt/response or receipt hashes. Extend `ensemble_ask_question` to accept exactly one of its existing `{question}` argument or the new structured request; runtime JSON schema and core parsing must agree. Request, schema, attention and tool receipt commit atomically. Answer schema validation, answer data, exact recipient event, attention resolution and operator receipt commit atomically before acknowledgement; a failed group writes none of them. Native answers continue through the native command and create no ordinary inbox event.
- New submissions, including plain migrated rows, require the retained exact requesting task/assignment/work/binding/version/current logical assignment version/conversation and the retained original work/request binding, with no ambiguous identity. Work counters are scoped by assignment+conversation (`state.ts:287`, `3120`), so unrelated assignment B work cannot invalidate A. A routine same-A inbox continuation likewise does not itself supersede an open own question; keep the native newer-work guard unchanged. Permit an own-tool requesting intent's normal successful terminal (`completed`) as well as its active turn; do not require the old turn to stay running. Terminal completion does not allocate a new work revision: `state.ts:3120` allocates on admission and `state.ts:3793` only marks terminal completed. The assignment stays pending/running unless its own report-result completed it. Reject task non-open, completed assignment, replaced logical conversation/version, explicit request supersession, cancelled/unavailable request, stale revision or already answered new input. Replay the original same-key/same-payload receipt before current eligibility, preserving historical acknowledgements after later changes. A recorded answer may wait behind existing holds. Own answer events retain the original requesting work ID, work revision, assignment version and conversation/request revision alongside typed answers, even when later ordinary work exists. Own answers route to exactly the requesting assignment's durable inbox; `service.ts:assignmentPrompt` sends the exact structured event payload without a 16k group clipping step. New typed message/answer projections must preserve that group instead of forcing it into the old capped plain `text` field.
- Settled transport: only `/api/operator/commands` gains a stream-bound raw JSON maximum of 256 KiB plus the mechanically derived maximum envelope for strict structured/native question commands. Command envelope contains bounded literal type, UUID key/task/interaction and positive safe-integer expected revision; derive the fixed maximum from those schema maxima and JSON serialization, not an arbitrary extra allowance. Separately enforce answer JSON <=256 KiB and original 64 KiB raw request limit for every non-question command before execution/effects. All other JSON/login/logout/source-refresh and legacy URL-encoded routes retain existing limits. Canonical browser `JSON.stringify` fits valid answer+envelope; oversize raw whitespace/escapes reject with 413 before mutation. Do not clip or partly persist. Typed receipt for native answer must describe its durable interaction/revision/recorded/delivery state; it must not invent an eventId. Preserve session/Host/Origin/CSRF, post-await session revalidation and original-key reconciliation.
- Curate full forms field by field with the existing consolidated exclusion context. If exact schema identities/options/text cannot safely remain intact or exclusion coverage is unavailable, expose the whole form as unavailable and disable fresh response; do not sanitize it into an altered answerable request. Typed stored answers follow the same aggregate/nested-field policy. Safe identity/revision/state and unavailable reasons remain visible. Recheck task/privacy binding after awaited reads as current API patterns do, and dispose browser content/drafts on auth expiry/logout; late responses cannot restore private material.
- The bounded presentation seam exposes summaries in Inbox/task lists and an exact full-schema/answer read at `/api/operator/tasks/:taskId/questions/:interactionId`, using the existing same-origin authentication/exclusion/task-binding checks. One full request is read independently of the loaded queue page; no bulk256KiB form aggregation. Inbox pages use the existing100-row bound, stable urgency/age/identity ordering, small cursor/fingerprint reuse, yielding traversal and stale-response cancellation. Incomplete/unavailable outcomes are explicit and preserve last observation; there is no additional persistence or native transport. Unknown ages sort after recorded ages within their urgency class with identity tie-break and a visible unknown-age label.
- The action Inbox derives unresolved durable interactions and recorded intervention/recovery facts, not generic task-admission reasons or routine results. Execution uncertainty/intervention comes first; questions and approvals then share one age order with stable identity tie-break. Use source creation time when recorded; explicitly represent unknown intervention age instead of inventing a request timestamp. Count a native recorded-but-unconfirmed/held/unavailable answer as unresolved attention even though its base interaction status is answered. A repair known to be agent-owned alone creates no operator action; independent requests remain. Reuse current shared projection/state meaning in Overview and task entry points. Show requester/next actor as unknown where unrecorded; no inference from running activity.
- Legacy question forms retain the plain command with the same current-identity validation. For structured/native rows, replace the unusable plain text submit with an exact `/app/tasks/:id?request=:interactionId` shared-form link and truthful lifecycle status. This preserves old form-reader limits while providing the full supported form at every legacy entry; no duplicate form renderer or native-HTML transport. Web-disabled diagnostic HTML exposes unavailable structured response honestly. Approvals retain exact Review/Confirm/Deny/leave-pending semantics and existing recovery destinations; answering is irreversible after commit, while failed drafts are editable and unknown outcomes reconcile the original operation.

### Implementation context

- **Existing:** `src/core/coordination.ts` — `CoordinationStore.migrate`, `requestQuestion/requestInteraction`, `answerQuestion`, `recordRuntimeQuestion/answerRuntimeQuestion`, `interactions/operatorAttention`, replay/save receipts and delivery batches. Coordination migrations belong here, not `core/store.ts`. `requestInteraction` already atomically captures task, assignment, work and revisions; `answerQuestion` currently checks only open/revision and must gain the settled current-identity check after replay. `coordination_one_interaction_event` protects one own event.
- **Existing:** `src/core/structured-questions.ts` — bounded native schema/validator/digest; `src/standalone/native-input.ts` reexports it; `service.ts:handleUserInputRequest/flushRuntimeAnswers/runtimeAnswerEligibility` and `codex.ts` own qualified delivery. Reuse these untouched public seams; no native adapter redesign.
- **Existing:** `src/standalone/coordination-tools.ts` — runtime `ensemble_ask_question` JSON schema/dispatcher. `coordination-view.ts:readTask/answerQuestion/answerRuntimeQuestion/messageView` own command wakeup and task projection; `answerEventSchema` currently only accepts plain answers. `service.ts:assignmentPrompt` embeds exact durable events in subsequent prompts.
- **Existing:** `src/operator/contracts.ts` — shared strict task DTO/command/receipt/error schemas; `operator-api.ts:interaction/readTask/taskSummary/execute` owns exclusion-safe projection and effects; `operator.ts:readJson` stream-bounds all JSON to64KiB; `operator-web.ts` registers known read routes. New `/api/operator/inbox` summary read, exact question read and typed full/native answer discriminants wire through these boundaries. Task request summaries retain exact targets while full schema material uses the selected-request read.
- **Existing:** `web/src/task-workspace.tsx:TaskWorkspace/TaskInbox/InboxTask` — unified task, legacy request links and transitional task-oriented Inbox; `app.tsx` owns `/app/inbox`, authenticated catalog timer/header refresh and shared navigation. `task-workspace-state.ts`, `resource.ts`, `command-lifecycle.ts`, `api.ts`, `tasks.ts` supply identity-scoped state, stale reads, command freeze/replay and links. New `question-response.tsx`, `question-response-state.ts`, `inbox.tsx` own shared form/controller and queue view. Do not duplicate local/GitHub reply drafts.
- **Follow:** UI08 owned Button/Input/Textarea/NativeSelect/Badge/Alert/Card/Sheet plus tokens/styles. Use native semantic radio/checkbox groups with labels/fieldset/legend and visible focus rather than add a new component library. `test/fixtures/operator-web.ts` starts production service/real SQLite/operator/build with fake runtime; `test/fixtures/browser-diagnostics.ts` retains screenshots; `runtime-question-store/service`, `coordination`, `operator-web-http`, `operator-task-workspace-browser`, `operator-command-lifecycle` supply receipt/hold/browser precedents.

### Implementation slices

**Task graph and parallelism:** `T1 -> T2 -> T3 -> T4 -> T5`, acyclic and serial. T1/T2 share coordination/view/contracts; T3/T4 share state/app/task/styles; T5 integrates them. No independent mutable-file task set is advertised. Root owns architectural settlements, integration, all remote mutations and final acceptance. The implementation owner owns in-scope code, tests, repairs and evidence.

**Validation setup V:** All commands run from the separately assigned implementation checkout at this exact baseline, never the planning checkout. Use Node24.21.0/npm12.2.0: `export PATH=/tmp/ensemble-drain-npm-bin:/private/tmp/node-v24.21.0-darwin-arm64/bin:$PATH`, verify `node --version`/`npm --version`, then `npm ci` once. Planning verified these paths and package pins; if disposable binaries disappear resolve the same pinned versions through existing setup and record paths before checks. Planning used recent exact-tree CI evidence rather than install/build/runtime or paid calls. Baseline evidence is merged UI04's pinned check883/883 zero skips and required CI20 on `f2be0a1a`, whose executable tree equals this main baseline, plus repository evidence documents; implementation renews all changed checks. Every focused command below includes production build first.

#### 1. Durable full question model and exact own-tool responses

**Task ID:** `T1`
**Depends on:** `none`
**Prerequisites:** V and current clean source/plan/claim handoff.
**Files and symbols:** New `src/core/question-forms.ts`; `src/core/coordination.ts` schema/migration/request/answer/replay; `src/standalone/coordination-tools.ts`, `coordination-view.ts:answerEventSchema/messageView`, service prompt integration if needed; new `test/question-forms.test.ts`, `test/structured-question-store.test.ts`, `test/structured-question-service.test.ts`; existing coordination/view tests.
**Test:** Schema inputs: single/grouped free/single/multi, optional values, lower text limits, min/max selections, recommendations/custom/preselection; duplicate/unknown IDs/options, bad recommendation, nonunique selections, disallowed custom, incomplete group, over-bound fields/UTF8 aggregate all reject. Real SQLite migrate a populated old plain/approval/native database, reopen twice, preserving original prompt/response/receipt bytes and rows. Request replay creates one interaction/schema/attention; changed callback arguments reject. Independent connection observes committed full answer/event/receipt after acknowledgement. Inject transaction failure after first write and before receipt: none survives; retry succeeds once. Same-key replay returns original event before stale checks; altered key payload/new key after answer reject. New stale/cancelled/completed/replaced assignment/conversation/version/request supersession/ambiguity fail with no event. Prove three valid cases: A successful requesting terminal then answer and exactly one later own-tool inbox turn; unrelated B admitted work while A/request/version/conversation remains unchanged; same-A ordinary-message inbox continuation without explicit question supersession followed by one answer to the original request. Every answer event keeps original work/version attribution; pause/Stop/dependency/ownership combinations retain answer but no unauthorized turn. At least one legal group >16k survives typed view/event/recipient prompt unchanged.
**Implementation:** Add companion full-schema storage and additive lifecycle without rebuilding interactions. Wire mutually exclusive plain/structured own-tool arguments into the existing atomic request operation, and structured answer into the existing exact event/receipt transaction. Share logical-identity eligibility with new plain submissions using their actually retained nonnull bindings; never retag historic work or invent missing identities. Existing interaction requesting fields are NOT NULL in this baseline. Preserve historic replay before fresh checks; a demonstrated nullable/corrupt legacy binding blocks only fresh response and is reported to root with evidence. Typed `question-answer` event union reads both old plain and new versioned structured payloads; readable UI response does not replace exact stored transport. Preserve own/native command separation and scheduler controls.
**Validate:** `npm run build && node --test dist/test/question-forms.test.js dist/test/structured-question-store.test.js dist/test/structured-question-service.test.js dist/test/coordination.test.js dist/test/coordination-view.test.js dist/test/runtime-question-store.test.js dist/test/runtime-question-service.test.js`; all schema/atomic/restart/identity/hold/prompt assertions pass without extra native effects.
**Complete when:** Own-tool full forms persist and answer atomically to the exact recipient, old data/replay survives, and normal completion plus rejection/hold cases have meaningful service evidence.

#### 2. Curated request/answer transport and action-Inbox read

**Task ID:** `T2`
**Depends on:** `T1`
**Prerequisites:** V; full schema and durable responses exist.
**Files and symbols:** `src/operator/contracts.ts`, `src/standalone/operator-api.ts`, `operator.ts:readJson`, `operator-web.ts`, `coordination-view.ts`; new `test/operator-inbox.test.ts`; extend `operator-contracts/api/web-http/web-integration/client` and runtime-question service tests.
**Test:** Strict DTO/command/receipt parsing and wrong task/request revision; qualified native adaptation round trips exact stored labels/custom input and grouped32 questions without new codec semantics. Generic unsupported native hold has honest unknown identity/reason and remains unresolved with no synthetic answer. Exclusion change/unavailable context disables whole form; nested options/recommendation/answer containing excluded material never leak or become altered valid options. Expiry and binding change after awaits deny private output. HTTP valid canonical answer exactly256KiB plus maximal envelope succeeds; answer+1byte, raw max+1byte, whitespace/escape expansion over transport cap, multibyte boundary, malformed UTF8/JSON, extra fields/unsafe revision all reject before writes. Non-question command exactly old64KiB raw threshold retains behavior and +1byte rejects even under larger command reader; login/source-refresh/forms never inherit larger cap. Test persistence failure/response loss and saved-key replay return exact own/native receipt; native reply counts remain one and no ordinary inbox/turn effect is added. Two projects' intervention/question/approval queue sorts urgency then combined age/tie identity, excludes ordinary capacity/dependency waits/routine results/agent-owned repair alone, retains independent question and recorded-unconfirmed native attention. Queue projection uses100-row stable pages with cursor/fingerprint and explicit completeness/error states, no silent omissions; selected request is directly addressable even outside current page.
**Implementation:** Add summary-only task/Inbox projections, exact full-form/native selected-request reads and distinct command/receipt variants, using strict stored-schema validation. Centralize one service-derived attention item projection (identity, kind, urgency, recorded age or unknown, project/task/requester known/unknown, intervention reason, evidence/task/conversation target, response capability/status). Wire `/api/operator/inbox` and `/api/operator/tasks/:taskId/questions/:interactionId` through `OperatorWebBoundary`, using current catalog/read patterns,100-row bound, small cursor/fingerprint reuse, bounded yielding traversal and verified complete paging; preserve retained page on failed observation and disclose partial/unavailable coverage. Reuse taskSummary/Overview meaning so resolved or normal waiting records do not contradict the dedicated queue. Apply settled command-only raw reader bound with derived envelope and non-question64KiB enforcement. Return affected field paths for validation and truthful durable receipts, keeping native runtime identity server-private.
**Validate:** `npm run build && node --test dist/test/operator-inbox.test.js dist/test/operator-contracts.test.js dist/test/operator-api.test.js dist/test/operator-web-http.test.js dist/test/operator-web-integration.test.js dist/test/operator-client.test.js dist/test/runtime-question-service.test.js`; sorting/privacy/boundary/receipt/auth/native-count assertions pass.
**Complete when:** Authenticated browser can obtain complete or explicitly bounded honest action records and submit full/native answers under exact limits/policy without unconfirmed or duplicate effects.

#### 3. Shared response form, lifecycle and all task/legacy entry points

**Task ID:** `T3`
**Depends on:** `T2`
**Prerequisites:** V; DTOs/commands/receipts ready.
**Files and symbols:** New `web/src/question-response.tsx`, `question-response-state.ts`; `task-workspace.tsx`, `task-workspace-state.ts`, `api.ts`, `command-lifecycle.ts`, `components.tsx`, `styles.css`; `src/standalone/operator-coordination.ts:questionSection` plain/shared destination; new `test/operator-question-browser.test.ts`, response-state tests; retained control/coordination browser tests.
**Test:** Production-browser desktop and phone create a mixed group via real own-tool callback, open same exact request in task detail and later Inbox. Labels/descriptions/recommendations/constraints/custom text are literal; radio arrows/checkbox Space/Tab work; preselection sends zero commands until explicit submit. Invalid group focuses first bad question and displays per-question error; changing one question cannot accidentally submit only part. Confirmed receipt shows recorded answer and independent delivery/hold state, no next-selection effect. 400/409/413/503/network loss retain entered fields; unknown operation freezes exact original key/bytes and reconciles before editing/retrying, never retargets after new revision. Fresh-key stale/cancelled/answered/offline/unsupported each visibly distinct and cannot submit. Auth expiry/logout disposes private drafts and late completion cannot restore them; newer authenticated scope starts clean. Typed group >16k displays every answer without clipping. Legacy plain controls enforce same stale/identity/replay policy; native/full legacy rows have shared exact links and never usable plain substitute. Ordinary message and approvals keep separate destinations; exact approval material/denial/leave-pending and independent holds remain reachable.
**Implementation:** One auth-scoped durable-request state owner keyed by task/interaction/schema revision, shared across route entries with per-entry reading state. Preserve failed editable draft separately from immutable pending/unknown command and receipt; never migrate old draft silently onto changed schema. Use owned controls with accessible grouping/error focus and explicit submission. Render request, requesting assignment/conversation link, evidence link and known/unknown reason; integrate outside task history disclosure. Legacy forms link full/native rows to the shared React request, retaining plain path and other advanced controls. **Validate:** `npm run build && node --test dist/test/operator-question-browser.test.js dist/test/question-response-state.test.js dist/test/operator-task-workspace-browser.test.js dist/test/operator-command-lifecycle.test.js dist/test/operator-coordination.test.js dist/test/operator-control-inventory.test.js`; all exact-command/draft/focus/retained-control assertions pass; retain populated/error/unsupported/recorded production captures.
**Complete when:** One form/state contract works in shared task and legacy entry paths, preserves drafts and exact reconciliation, and never implies answer receipt means continuation or approval.

#### 4. Cross-project Inbox, queue/detail/evidence and responsive return

**Task ID:** `T4`
**Depends on:** `T3`
**Prerequisites:** V; shared forms and action records integrated.
**Files and symbols:** New `web/src/inbox.tsx`; `app.tsx`, `task-workspace.tsx:TaskInbox` replacement, shared route/state/navigation, `tasks.ts`, `resource.ts`, `styles.css`; new `test/operator-inbox-browser.test.ts`; existing task/search/Overview browser cases.
**Test:** Two projects with execution uncertainty, action-needed failure, different-age question/approval, normal capacity/dependency waiting, routine completion, known agent repair and unknown responsibility. Queue shows only unresolved actions in agreed order with project/task/requester/evidence and explicit unknown values. New action arrives through existing timer/header refresh; loading/failure preserves old content and its observation time, no false empty or inferred success. Native recorded-unconfirmed stays visible. Desktop1366x900 queue/detail scroll independently with persistent header/actions; focus and both scroll anchors survive insertion/update. Phone390x844 and390x480 queue->request->form->evidence/task->back restore selected request, filter, queue/detail/form reading position and draft. 44px controls and safe-area/persistent submit reserve real content height; last field/error remains visible and clickable without overlap. Confirmation remains selected despite queue removal and never auto-opens another item. Keyboard/back-forward/deep reload and invalid/missing request keep exact destination/unavailable explanation. Overview, cross-project/project List/Board, search exact decision, direct request task URL and legacy links use the shared request; task evidence return restores Inbox origin. Logout/expiry drops private queue/content/state, late reads cannot restore it.
**Implementation:** Dedicated action queue with project/kind filters and stable request/intervention keys, selected detail pane and phone hierarchy; reuse resource refresh/cancellation and existing navigation history origins. State changes in queue never mutate service state. Retain recorded confirmation snapshot after item resolves; explicit return/next selection is user-owned. Recovery/intervention uses existing exact destinations/counterparts. Remove transitional task admission-reason rendering from Inbox; keep all tasks discoverable outside it. Preserve source-faithful evidence and unknown requester/intervention metadata rather than invented summaries.
**Validate:** `npm run build && node --test dist/test/operator-inbox-browser.test.js dist/test/operator-question-browser.test.js dist/test/operator-task-browser.test.js dist/test/operator-task-workspace-browser.test.js dist/test/operator-search-browser.test.js dist/test/operator-foundation-browser.test.js`; all order/filter/selection/anchor/focus/overflow/auth assertions pass. Capture populated, empty, retained-refresh-failure, pending/recorded/stale/unsupported desktop/phone states and reduced-height form.
**Complete when:** Action-only Inbox and shared request/evidence round trip work responsively without covering content, losing draft/position or auto-selecting another action.

#### 5. Integrated persistence/fault/browser evidence and native reuse handoff

**Task ID:** `T5`
**Depends on:** `T4`
**Prerequisites:** V; all focused checks passed.
**Files and symbols:** New `docs/evidence/ui05-inbox-questions.md`; update implemented-versus-planned SPEC/acceptance/README and retained-control inventory only for delivered behavior. In-scope code/tests for integration repairs; no parallel delivery plan.
**Test:** Production service/real SQLite/production browser/fake-runtime full mixed-form journey from own-tool request through Inbox and task answer, independent durable readback and exact subsequent assignment prompt. Restart before commit, after commit before response, after event batching/admission, and around native intent/write/receipt using existing bounded native fixtures; assert one original event/receipt/eligible continuation or native reply, no duplicate effects and all independent holds retained. Run pause/Stop/dependency/ownership combinations plus failure/session-expiry/unsupported states deterministically, not new model attempts. Inspect captured desktop/phone keyboard/layout evidence and reach every retained applicable entry. Run complete pinned check and proportionate fresh integrated independent review with ship/fix-first/rethink verdict; root owns acceptance and remote delivery.
**Implementation:** Evidence table attributes each criterion to exact test/command/source SHA, SQLite identity/receipt/effect counts and production screenshots with hashes/viewport. Native reuse explicitly cites `docs/evidence/ui01-runtime-input.md`, `ui01-service-2026-10-02.json`, [#739 T6 outcome](https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/issues/739#issuecomment-5959595667), source `f0002f0a1b1dd899eb5423c8321565dafa324265`, Codex0.159.0 executable hash and observed single-choice/custom synchronous false/null protocol. Explain native codec/adapter/service delivery unchanged and deterministic curated/browser integration now exercised; grouped shapes remain deterministic, free/multi/recommendation native unproved/unsupported. Reuse UI04/UI08 evidence only for unchanged seams and renew changed request/navigation checks. Record missing/unknown surfaces and physical-device limits, explicit recovery/irreversible answer behavior and existing parent release/human gates. No blanket claim that UI05 closes #736/#745/#697.
**Validate:** `npm run check` then `git diff --check`; typecheck/lint/format/production builds/all tests pass with zero failures or skipped required coverage, no fixed expected test count beyond baseline883. Focused evidence and final source/runtime identities are internally consistent; fixture listeners/browser/fake-runtime resources close through existing lifecycle helpers and retained screenshot evidence survives fixture cleanup.
**Complete when:** Every acceptance row has concrete current evidence, unchanged native qualification is justified without a new grant, limitations are explicit, and root accepts the reviewed executor/delivery candidate.

### Acceptance coverage

| #743 criterion / acceptance contract | Slice | Verification |
| --- | --- | --- |
| AC1 action-only cross-project urgency then age; project/task/requester context; no routine results | T2,T4 | action projection and two-project production Inbox order/normal-wait/agent-repair/unknown responsibility assertions |
| AC2 individual/grouped free/single/multi; descriptions/constraints/explicit recommendation/custom; no automatic submit | T1,T3 | schema cases and mixed real own-tool group; browser radios/checkboxes/preselection zero commands/field errors |
| AC3 stored-schema validation; atomic persistence before acknowledgement; exact assignment/native recipient; message/approval distinction | T1,T2,T3 | separate connection readback/failure rollback/exact event prompt; native receipt/count and distinct UI destinations |
| AC4 plain migration/restart/replay; no duplicate response/continuation; reject stale/cancelled/answered/conflicting | T1,T2,T5 | populated old DB preservation, same-key original receipt, fresh-key rejection, terminal-to-inbox and restart/admission fault matrix |
| AC5 pending/recorded/failed/stale/cancelled/offline/unsupported; retain failed input/unresolved unsupported; all holds | T1,T2,T3,T5 | no-effect hold/runtime suites; draft/frozen-key/error states and unsupported unknown-context intervention |
| AC6 independent desktop scroll; phone queue/detail/form restore; controls reserve content; no automatic next | T4 | independent anchors, connected back/forward/evidence return, 390x480 last-field/44px bounds and retained selected confirmation |
| AC7/A12 exact conversation link, full form deterministic service/SQLite/UI, native qualified round trip reuse | T1-T5 | own-tool production journey and exact prompt/receipt; attributed #739 evidence reuse with unchanged codec/runtime seam; current form/browser evidence |
| UI01 complete Ensemble form preservation, per-question validation/custom/recommendation/failed draft and recorded result | T1,T3,T4 | schema mixed-group validation plus task/Inbox desktop/phone production form paths |
| UI02 native exact identity/restart/replay/holds/unsupported/API-version/round trip | T2,T5 | existing native store/service/runtime tests plus curated command/DTO integration; exact #739 source/runtime reuse, no added live or unsupported shape claim |
| Shared entry behavior/recovery/privacy | T2-T5 | Overview/List/Board/search/direct/legacy/control inventory; original-command reconciliation; expiry and post-await binding tests |

### Final validation

No live runtime/model/paid operation is authorized here. Escalate only demonstrated changed qualified boundary/failure with evidence and finite proposed grant.

## Agent Brief

**Key interfaces:**
Integrated authenticated operator UI; runtime question transport; source/execution controls; acceptance A12, UI01-UI03 and the reviewed task/evidence/search checks; existing service/auth/policy test suites.

Static canvas fixtures do not establish persistence, message delivery, source comparison, permissions or provider qualification.

- [ ] Keep exact-material approvals, independent dependency/recovery holds, source ownership and existing message-versus-GitHub destinations effective across the new disclosures. Viewing is not approval; a merged PR is not task completion; unknown outcomes reconcile before retry.
- [ ] Include the latest reviewed Pen/handoff revision and its recorded comparison-image loading gap; do not claim those images passed saved-design visual validation until loading is verified. Reuse unaffected evidence in the shared #745/#697 inventory; deterministic coverage handles combinations, with bounded live checks for changed integration boundaries or demonstrated gaps. - [ ] Consume shadcn reconciliation #765 before final qualification. Check the reviewed Dark/Neutral/Default foundation, Inter/JetBrains Mono roles and shared control treatments across all applicable existing surfaces, including alternate/login/setup/recovery entry points. Include #765's desktop/phone visual and keyboard/focus evidence; preserve supported behaviour and service policy. Reuse unaffected runtime/provider evidence.

**Out of scope:**
No deployment, merge, installed Haze cutover, relaxation of acceptance or deferred integrations. Final human acceptance and overall release closure remain on #736.

**Shared boundaries and validation:**
Use the approved specification, acceptance criteria and design handoff linked from #736. React + Vite, same-origin service APIs and selective Radix controls are the approved architecture. Preserve server-owned policy and runtime trust limits. Run proportional automated tests and pinned npm ci / npm run check for implementation; the implementation owner performs required browser/live validation. These briefs authorise scoped planning outcomes, not immediate dispatch, deployment, merge or cutover. Current Project status and assignment are authoritative; this amendment does not dispatch work. X01-X08 remain deferred.


## Approved amendment — 3 October 2026

#745 and #697 share one attributable evidence inventory. Reuse still-valid #739/#743 evidence and one bounded assembled UI/service/runtime journey across both gates. #697 adds the missing delivery/provider integration checks; it does not repeat the same UI journey merely because it is a later gate. Cover pause, Stop, restart, replay, failure and session-expiry combinations deterministically unless a changed integration boundary or demonstrated failure requires a bounded live check. Record the source/runtime identities and why reused evidence still applies. Final visual/usability acceptance remains with Chris on #736.

The full Ensemble question model and UI support individual/grouped free text, single/multiple choice, descriptions, constraints and recommendations/custom text where permitted. Qualify those form behaviours with deterministic service/SQLite/browser tests or Ensemble's own question tools. Native runtime acceptance is limited to the shapes qualified by #739: the observed single-choice/custom-text round trip and deterministic grouped-shape coverage. Chris agreed to carry the reviewed Pen extensions into the specification, acceptance checks and delivery briefs. Status: **design reviewed; implementation deferred**. Static canvas review is not implemented capability, runtime evidence or Chris's final acceptance of the integrated UI.

#742 owns task review, captured context, recorded changes/delivery, search and the shared desktop/phone navigation required to reach search. #745 owns integrated qualification. #736 retains the overall scope and Chris's final integrated visual/usability acceptance. Do not reopen completed #741 scope or create a separate search ticket. - `web/src/app.tsx`, `task-composer.tsx`, `task-views.tsx`, `task-workspace.tsx`/`task-workspace-state.ts`, `inbox.tsx`, `question-response.tsx`/`question-response-state.ts`, `search.tsx`, `command-lifecycle.ts`, `settings.tsx`, `recovery.tsx` own shared entries, presentation and state. ### Implementation slices

**Task graph and parallelism:** T1 → T2/T3/T4; T5 depends on T1–T4; T6 depends on T1–T5. Acyclic. #### 1. Build shared inventory and offline browser/native qualification seam

nodes.body:
> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Agent Brief

**Category:** enhancement

**Summary:** Complete setup, configuration and recovery UI coverage.

**Current behavior:**
The existing operator exposes project/profile/routing/source configuration and runtime recovery operations. The design handoff does not depict every such screen.

**Desired behavior:**
Use the foundation control inventory to bring remaining setup, configuration and recovery surfaces into the same design system without removing supported behavior.

**Key interfaces:**
Existing project/profile/source configuration commands; routing controls; instruction revision application; runtime recovery evidence and session handling.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- [ ] Every inventoried operation has an implemented reachable destination or an explicit reviewed scope disposition; compare against the inventory before declaring completion.
- [ ] Project/lead/profile/repository/routing/source setup and updates retain validation, access rules, revision checks and clear human-readable labels.
- [ ] Configuration changes preserve recorded assignment revisions until explicitly applied under existing rules; revocation and paused/held state remain legible.
- [ ] Recovery shows evidence and uncertainties, never offers a force-unlock or treats acknowledgement/time as proof of termination.
- [ ] Desktop complex forms retain input and provide inline errors; phone layouts explain current state and the next supported step even for desktop-first recovery.
- [ ] Apply tokens and accessible controls consistently, with browser regression checks for critical setup, permission failure, session expiry and recovery paths.

**Out of scope:**
No expansion of recovery authority, native Codex/ChatGPT integration, deployment changes, credential disclosure or unsupported new setup capabilities.

**Shared boundaries and validation:**
Use the approved specification, acceptance criteria and design handoff linked from #736. React + Vite, same-origin service APIs and selective Radix controls are the approved architecture. Preserve server-owned policy and runtime trust limits. Run proportional automated tests and pinned npm ci / npm run check for implementation; the implementation owner performs required browser/live validation. These briefs authorise scoped planning outcomes, not immediate dispatch, deployment, merge or cutover. Keep all children unassigned in Backlog; dependency readiness is distinct from the ready-for-agent specification label. X01-X08 remain deferred.

<!-- to-plan:implementation-plan:v2 -->

**Revision:** 1
**Supersedes:** none
**Replan report:** none

## Implementation plan

**Issue:** https://github.com/chrisbanes/ensemble/issues/744
**Planned against:** `main` at `ac128e8fa35ac45cecfc50489bd7941c1c2c956f`
**Publication mode:** Autonomous
**Local state:** Clean before this scratch draft; no source/test edits

### Approach

Complete Settings, guided project/profile setup, routing/source configuration, capacity and curated recovery in the existing React shell. Extend the strict same-origin presentation boundary around existing domain/service commands. Configuration forms accept explicit private replacement input but never fetch captured instructions, credential references or repository paths into JSON. Keep the existing exact-value editors reachable for supported edits that cannot round-trip through the curated boundary. Keep task/assignment controls at their inventoried UI04/UI05 destinations; this ticket does not implement their future detail or Inbox views.

**Controlled baseline refresh:** The prior local publication hold is closed. Root verified PR #750 merged and issue #741 closed/Done; this clean detached checkout is its actual squash main SHA above. The complete `3b98566ba5ea81d73f53f1b7983e441721b64500..ac128e8fa35ac45cecfc50489bd7941c1c2c956f` delta and affected actual contracts, routes, consumers, inventory and teardown were inspected. This draft reuses delivered behavior and passed affected build/focused checks; it does not substitute an abandoned candidate SHA. Root retains sole publication and refreshes live readiness immediately before publishing. An overlapping later baseline still requires controlled replan.

### Guardrails

- `DomainCommands`, `DomainStore`, `StandaloneService`, existing repository verification, source observation/placement policy and supervision remain the mutation/policy authorities. Fix actor as `operator` server-side; reject actor, arbitrary activation, recovery release/receipt, imported-blocker overrides and broad payloads in public schemas. Source selections/references never grant repository access. No generic action registry, new setup capability, delivery-stage framework or separate browser-state system for legacy forms.
- Public reads and receipts contain only strict curated fields. Exclude all current/retained instructions, declared credential refs/values, repository/workspace/control paths and raw diagnostic/recovery/process rows. Use the existing bounded exclusion lookup and sanitization, failing closed if exclusions cannot be established. Private replacement input is write-only, stays in authenticated in-memory form state, is never echoed in receipts/errors, and never enters URLs, browser storage, logs, analytics or frontend environment/build values. Keep existing authenticated HTML exact-value editors; do not remove them before UI07 parity approval.
- OMIT preserves a supported optional field; an explicit empty instruction string or `null` credential ref clears it. Never resubmit empty/redacted display text as saved configuration. Routing guidance/candidates and GitHub selection/readiness/repository arrays require complete explicit replacements under their existing command schemas; do not invent partial merging, infer missing paths or silently clear arrays. Retained editors provide exact/partial existing-value edits. Lead/profile IDs come from actual validated resources, with unavailable names labelled honestly.
- Project/profile/routing/GitHub expected versions are the loaded revisions selected for that submission. Assignment configured snapshots, current project/profile revisions and the selected admitted execution generation remain distinct. Updates do not apply assignment revisions; the existing exact-version Apply control does. Revocation affects subsequent actions independently of snapshots. Project pause, task Stop and unresolved ownership/capacity holds remain independent.
- A domain/configuration submission freezes its exact validated key, create IDs, payload and expected versions before sending. An unknown response locks changes to that form/command; deliberate reconciliation sends those same bytes with the same key. A current-state read is not a receipt. Matching receipt replay returns the original recorded outcome after later changes/reopen; different payload with the same key conflicts. No automatic replay, new-key retry of unknown work, revision substitution or current-state receipt reconstruction. Keep frozen private commands only for the current authenticated session; clear them and cached private reads on expiry/logout. No cross-session private draft recovery is claimed.
- Capacity has the existing keyed command and **no invented configuration version/CAS**. Lowering caps holds new admission without killing active turns. Refresh is an observation request, not a durable domain-command receipt or proof of successful provider sync. Recovery pages are read-only evidence: no force unlock, timer/acknowledgement waiver, proof-of-termination inference or new recovery authority. Advanced original evidence and Apply/Stop/Resume remain linked at the retained routes.
- Preserve exact Host/Origin/CSRF, sessions/cookie/expiry, no CORS/forwarded trust, 64 KiB JSON request bounds, strict DTOs and single production listener. Keep UI03/UI04/UI05, native structured-input, paused S07a fixtures, X01–X08, global config/login changes, deployment, release/cutover and real Codex/TypeSafe model calls outside this ticket. Only disposable SQLite/listener/Chromium/fake-runtime and fake-provider fixtures are authorized; no real external GitHub fixture writes.
- The bounded mechanical-repair allowance applies only when an approved **factual seam is wrong** while behavior, interfaces, ownership and validation remain fixed: one focused diagnosis and at most two repair edit/validation cycles. Ordinary implementation/integration/test/fixture/CI defects and normal test-first cycles do not consume this budget. Discovery grants no repository access. No generic registry/framework or new setup capability.
- Strict curated JSON excludes current/retained instructions, routing/discovery/delivery refs, env keys/nonempty values, repository/workspace/control paths and raw diagnostics/recovery/process rows. Bounded exclusions fail closed. Private explicit replacement input is write-only/session-memory; never echoed or stored in URL/browser storage/log/analytics/build/env.
